views.name: admin_due_tasks
views.definition:
SELECT t.id,
    t.contact_id,
    t.title,
    t.due_at,
    t.status,
    t.priority,
    t.assigned_to,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    c.phone
   FROM follow_up_tasks t
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = t.contact_id
  WHERE t.status = 'open'::text
  ORDER BY (
        CASE t.priority
            WHEN 'urgent'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'high'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'normal'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), t.due_at, t.created_at DESC;

views.name: admin_followup_queue
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    phone,
    lifecycle_stage,
    follow_up_status,
    consultation_status,
    next_follow_up_at,
    updated_at,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM follow_up_tasks t
          WHERE t.contact_id = c.id AND t.status = 'open'::text), 0::bigint) AS open_tasks
   FROM contacts c
  WHERE (follow_up_status = ANY (ARRAY['new'::text, 'needs_follow_up'::text, 'contacted'::text, 'consultation_scheduled'::text])) OR next_follow_up_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY next_follow_up_at, updated_at DESC;

views.name: admin_refuel_interest
views.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.contact_id,
    r.email,
    r.first_name,
    r.source,
    r.status,
    r.created_at,
    r.updated_at,
    c.last_name,
    c.phone,
    c.lifecycle_stage
   FROM refuel_interest r
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = r.contact_id
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;

views.name: admin_dashboard_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT count(*) AS total_contacts,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE lifecycle_stage = 'assessment_lead'::text) AS assessment_leads,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE lifecycle_stage = 'webinar_lead'::text) AS webinar_leads,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE lifecycle_stage = 'applicant'::text) AS applicants,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE lifecycle_stage = 'client'::text) AS clients,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE follow_up_status = 'needs_follow_up'::text) AS needs_follow_up,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE consultation_status = 'scheduled'::text) AS consultations_scheduled,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE next_follow_up_at IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_up_at <= (now() + '24:00:00'::interval) AND follow_up_status <> 'closed'::text) AS followups_due_24h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM workflow_records w
          WHERE w.contact_id = contacts.id AND w.workflow_type = 'vitality_assessment'::text AND w.status = 'completed'::text))) AS completed_assessments,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM workflow_records w
          WHERE w.contact_id = contacts.id AND w.workflow_type = 'enrollment'::text AND w.status = 'completed'::text))) AS completed_enrollments,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM webinar_registrations r
          WHERE r.contact_id = contacts.id AND r.status <> 'cancelled'::text))) AS webinar_registrations,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM webinar_registrations r
          WHERE r.contact_id = contacts.id AND (r.status = ANY (ARRAY['seat_reserved'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'attended'::text]))))) AS webinar_confirmed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM refuel_interest r
          WHERE r.contact_id = contacts.id AND r.status <> 'unsubscribed'::text))) AS refuel_interest
   FROM contacts;

views.name: admin_contact_overview
views.definition:
SELECT c.id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    c.phone,
    c.city,
    c.state,
    c.country,
    c.lifecycle_stage,
    c.follow_up_status,
    c.consultation_status,
    c.assigned_to,
    c.next_follow_up_at,
    c.first_source,
    c.last_source,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at,
    va.status AS vitality_status,
    va.completion_percent AS vitality_completion,
    va.current_step AS vitality_step,
    en.status AS enrollment_status,
    en.completion_percent AS enrollment_completion,
    en.current_step AS enrollment_step,
    wr.status AS webinar_status,
    wr.payment_status AS webinar_payment_status,
    wr.registered_at AS webinar_registered_at,
    wr.primary_goal AS webinar_primary_goal,
    ri.status AS refuel_status,
    ri.created_at AS refuel_joined_at,
    ( SELECT max(n.created_at) AS max
           FROM contact_notes n
          WHERE n.contact_id = c.id) AS last_note_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM follow_up_tasks t
          WHERE t.contact_id = c.id AND t.status = 'open'::text) AS open_tasks,
    ( SELECT max(a.created_at) AS max
           FROM contact_activity a
          WHERE a.contact_id = c.id) AS last_activity_at
   FROM contacts c
     LEFT JOIN workflow_records va ON va.contact_id = c.id AND va.workflow_type = 'vitality_assessment'::text AND va.status <> 'abandoned'::text
     LEFT JOIN workflow_records en ON en.contact_id = c.id AND en.workflow_type = 'enrollment'::text AND en.status <> 'abandoned'::text
     LEFT JOIN webinar_registrations wr ON wr.contact_id = c.id
     LEFT JOIN refuel_interest ri ON ri.contact_id = c.id;

views.name: my_mobile_health_sync_status
views.definition:
SELECT b.id AS batch_id,
    b.provider_key,
    p.name AS provider_name,
    b.device_id,
    b.status,
    b.source_cursor,
    b.records_received,
    b.records_imported,
    b.records_blocked,
    b.records_duplicate,
    b.started_at,
    b.completed_at,
    b.error_message
   FROM health_mobile_sync_batches b
     JOIN health_integration_providers p ON p.provider_key = b.provider_key
  WHERE b.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  ORDER BY b.started_at DESC
 LIMIT 25;

views.name: admin_mobile_health_sync_summary
views.definition:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))::integer AS batches_24h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval))::integer AS batches_7d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed'::text)::integer AS failed_batches,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'partial'::text)::integer AS partial_batches,
    COALESCE(sum(records_received) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)), 0::bigint) AS records_received_7d,
    COALESCE(sum(records_imported) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)), 0::bigint) AS records_imported_7d,
    COALESCE(sum(records_blocked) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)), 0::bigint) AS records_blocked_7d,
    COALESCE(sum(records_duplicate) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)), 0::bigint) AS records_duplicate_7d
   FROM health_mobile_sync_batches
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'health.private.view'::text);

views.name: admin_mobile_health_connections
views.definition:
SELECT hc.id AS connection_id,
    hc.contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    hc.provider_key,
    p.name AS provider_name,
    hc.status,
    hc.connected_at,
    hc.last_sync_at,
    hc.last_successful_sync_at,
    hc.last_error,
    hc.sync_cursor,
    count(b.id)::integer AS batch_count,
    max(b.started_at) AS latest_batch_at
   FROM health_integration_connections hc
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = hc.contact_id
     JOIN health_integration_providers p ON p.provider_key = hc.provider_key
     LEFT JOIN health_mobile_sync_batches b ON b.connection_id = hc.id
  WHERE (hc.provider_key = ANY (ARRAY['apple_health'::text, 'health_connect'::text])) AND private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'health.private.view'::text) AND private.staff_can_access_contact(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), hc.contact_id)
  GROUP BY hc.id, hc.contact_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, hc.provider_key, p.name, hc.status, hc.connected_at, hc.last_sync_at, hc.last_successful_sync_at, hc.last_error, hc.sync_cursor
  ORDER BY hc.last_sync_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.last_name, c.first_name;

views.name: my_privacy_center
views.definition:
SELECT user_id,
    contact_id,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('provider_key', hc.provider_key, 'provider_name', p.name, 'status', hc.status, 'connected_at', hc.connected_at, 'last_sync_at', hc.last_sync_at, 'last_successful_sync_at', hc.last_successful_sync_at) ORDER BY p.name) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM health_integration_connections hc
             JOIN health_integration_providers p ON p.provider_key = hc.provider_key
          WHERE hc.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND hc.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))), '[]'::jsonb) AS health_connections,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('request_id', r.id, 'request_type', r.request_type, 'scope', r.scope, 'status', r.status, 'requested_at', r.requested_at, 'reviewed_at', r.reviewed_at, 'completed_at', r.completed_at) ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM member_privacy_requests r
          WHERE r.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))), '[]'::jsonb) AS privacy_requests,
    ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
           FROM health_observations ho
          WHERE ho.contact_id = ca.contact_id) AS stored_health_observation_count,
    ( SELECT max(ho.observed_at) AS max
           FROM health_observations ho
          WHERE ho.contact_id = ca.contact_id) AS latest_health_observation_at
   FROM client_access ca
  WHERE user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND status = 'active'::text
  ORDER BY updated_at DESC
 LIMIT 1;

views.name: admin_privacy_request_queue
views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS request_id,
    r.contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    r.request_type,
    r.scope,
    r.status,
    r.member_note,
    r.staff_note,
    r.assigned_to,
    sd.display_name AS assigned_to_name,
    r.requested_at,
    r.reviewed_at,
    r.completed_at,
    r.updated_at
   FROM member_privacy_requests r
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = r.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = r.assigned_to
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'staff.manage'::text)
  ORDER BY (
        CASE r.status
            WHEN 'submitted'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'in_review'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'approved'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'processing'::text THEN 4
            ELSE 5
        END), r.requested_at;

views.name: admin_contact_next_step
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS contact_id,
    cj.id AS journey_id,
    cj.journey_key,
    jd.name AS journey_name,
    cj.status AS journey_status,
    cj.current_step_key,
    s.id AS step_id,
    s.name AS current_step_name,
    s.step_type,
    s.status AS current_step_status,
    s.due_at,
    cj.progress_percent,
    ce.temperature,
    ce.intent_score,
    a.id AS appointment_id,
    a.appointment_type,
    a.status AS appointment_status,
    a.scheduled_start,
    a.time_zone AS appointment_time_zone,
    a.format AS appointment_format,
    ea.id AS activation_id,
    ea.program_code,
    ea.program_name,
    ea.payment_status,
    ea.agreement_status,
    ea.access_status,
    ea.payment_url,
    ea.agreement_url
   FROM contacts c
     JOIN contact_journeys cj ON cj.contact_id = c.id AND (cj.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'paused'::text, 'nurture'::text]))
     JOIN journey_definitions jd ON jd.journey_key = cj.journey_key
     LEFT JOIN contact_journey_steps s ON s.journey_id = cj.id AND s.step_key = cj.current_step_key
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.id,
            x.contact_id,
            x.journey_id,
            x.journey_step_id,
            x.appointment_type,
            x.status,
            x.provider,
            x.provider_event_id,
            x.scheduled_start,
            x.scheduled_end,
            x.time_zone,
            x.format,
            x.location_url,
            x.requested_availability,
            x.client_notes,
            x.staff_notes,
            x.assigned_to,
            x.created_by,
            x.created_at,
            x.updated_at,
            x.completed_at
           FROM journey_appointments x
          WHERE x.journey_id = cj.id AND (x.status = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'scheduled'::text]))
          ORDER BY x.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) a ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.id,
            x.contact_id,
            x.journey_id,
            x.journey_step_id,
            x.program_code,
            x.program_name,
            x.billing_choice,
            x.commitment_months,
            x.amount_cents,
            x.currency,
            x.payment_provider,
            x.provider_customer_id,
            x.provider_subscription_id,
            x.provider_payment_id,
            x.payment_url,
            x.payment_status,
            x.agreement_status,
            x.agreement_url,
            x.agreement_signed_at,
            x.access_status,
            x.metadata,
            x.created_by,
            x.created_at,
            x.updated_at,
            x.paid_at
           FROM journey_enrollment_activations x
          WHERE x.journey_id = cj.id
          ORDER BY x.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) ea ON true
     LEFT JOIN contact_engagement ce ON ce.contact_id = c.id;

views.name: admin_journey_pipeline
views.definition:
SELECT cj.id AS journey_id,
    cj.contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    c.phone,
    jd.name AS journey_name,
    cj.journey_key,
    cj.status AS journey_status,
    cj.current_step_key,
    s.name AS current_step_name,
    s.status AS current_step_status,
    s.due_at AS current_step_due_at,
    s.due_at IS NOT NULL AND s.due_at < now() AND (s.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_progress'::text, 'blocked'::text])) AS stalled,
    cj.progress_percent,
    ce.intent_score,
    ce.temperature,
    cj.assigned_to,
    cj.last_activity_at,
    cj.next_action_at,
    cj.started_at
   FROM contact_journeys cj
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = cj.contact_id
     JOIN journey_definitions jd ON jd.journey_key = cj.journey_key
     LEFT JOIN contact_journey_steps s ON s.journey_id = cj.id AND s.step_key = cj.current_step_key
     LEFT JOIN contact_engagement ce ON ce.contact_id = cj.contact_id;

views.name: admin_contact_journey_summary
views.definition:
SELECT cj.contact_id,
    cj.id AS journey_id,
    cj.journey_key,
    jd.name AS journey_name,
    cj.status AS journey_status,
    cj.current_step_key,
    s.name AS current_step_name,
    s.status AS current_step_status,
    s.due_at AS current_step_due_at,
    cj.progress_percent,
    cj.assigned_to,
    cj.last_activity_at,
    cj.next_action_at,
    COALESCE(ce.intent_score, 0) AS intent_score,
    COALESCE(ce.temperature, 'cold'::text) AS temperature,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM contact_journey_steps x
          WHERE x.journey_id = cj.id AND (x.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'skipped'::text, 'waived'::text]))) AS completed_steps,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM contact_journey_steps x
          WHERE x.journey_id = cj.id) AS total_steps
   FROM contact_journeys cj
     JOIN journey_definitions jd ON jd.journey_key = cj.journey_key
     LEFT JOIN contact_journey_steps s ON s.journey_id = cj.id AND s.step_key = cj.current_step_key
     LEFT JOIN contact_engagement ce ON ce.contact_id = cj.contact_id
  WHERE cj.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'paused'::text, 'nurture'::text]);

views.name: my_privacy_exports
views.definition:
SELECT id AS export_id,
    privacy_request_id,
    status,
    manifest,
    file_size_bytes,
    checksum,
    expires_at,
    created_at,
    ready_at,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'ready'::text AND storage_path IS NOT NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()) THEN storage_path
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS available_storage_path
   FROM member_privacy_exports e
  WHERE user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  ORDER BY created_at DESC;

views.name: admin_privacy_operations_summary
views.definition:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'submitted'::text)::integer AS submitted_requests,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'in_review'::text)::integer AS in_review_requests,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'::text)::integer AS approved_requests,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'processing'::text)::integer AS processing_requests,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE request_type = 'data_export'::text AND (status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'declined'::text])))::integer AS open_export_requests,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE request_type = 'health_data_delete'::text AND (status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'declined'::text])))::integer AS open_health_delete_requests,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE request_type = 'account_delete'::text AND (status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'declined'::text])))::integer AS open_account_delete_requests
   FROM member_privacy_requests r
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'staff.manage'::text);

views.name: admin_enrollment_readiness
views.definition:
WITH payment_totals AS (
         SELECT pr.activation_id,
            COALESCE(sum(pr.amount_cents) FILTER (WHERE (pr.transaction_type = ANY (ARRAY['payment'::text, 'adjustment'::text])) AND pr.status = 'recorded'::text), 0::bigint) AS gross_paid_cents,
            COALESCE(sum(pr.amount_cents) FILTER (WHERE (pr.transaction_type = ANY (ARRAY['refund'::text, 'reversal'::text])) AND pr.status = 'recorded'::text), 0::bigint) AS refunded_cents
           FROM payment_records pr
          WHERE pr.activation_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY pr.activation_id
        ), agreement_rollup AS (
         SELECT ca.activation_id,
            count(*)::integer AS agreement_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ca.status = 'signed'::text)::integer AS signed_agreements,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ca.status = 'waived'::text)::integer AS waived_agreements,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ca.status = 'declined'::text)::integer AS declined_agreements,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ca.status <> ALL (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text]))::integer AS incomplete_agreements,
            COALESCE(sum(ca.required_client_signatures), 0::bigint)::integer AS required_signatures,
            COALESCE(sum(( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM agreement_acceptances aa
                  WHERE aa.client_agreement_id = ca.id AND (aa.signer_role = ANY (ARRAY['primary_client'::text, 'secondary_client'::text])))), 0::numeric)::integer AS collected_signatures
           FROM client_agreements ca
          WHERE ca.activation_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY ca.activation_id
        )
 SELECT a.id AS activation_id,
    a.contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    a.program_code,
    a.program_name,
    a.billing_choice,
    a.amount_cents AS agreed_amount_cents,
    a.currency,
    a.payment_status,
    COALESCE(pt.gross_paid_cents, 0::bigint) AS gross_paid_cents,
    COALESCE(pt.refunded_cents, 0::bigint) AS refunded_cents,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(pt.gross_paid_cents, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(pt.refunded_cents, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS net_paid_cents,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(a.amount_cents, 0) - GREATEST(COALESCE(pt.gross_paid_cents, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(pt.refunded_cents, 0::bigint), 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS remaining_balance_cents,
    a.agreement_status,
    COALESCE(ar.agreement_count, 0) AS agreement_count,
    COALESCE(ar.signed_agreements, 0) AS signed_agreements,
    COALESCE(ar.waived_agreements, 0) AS waived_agreements,
    COALESCE(ar.declined_agreements, 0) AS declined_agreements,
    COALESCE(ar.incomplete_agreements, 0) AS incomplete_agreements,
    COALESCE(ar.required_signatures, 0) AS required_signatures,
    COALESCE(ar.collected_signatures, 0) AS collected_signatures,
    a.access_status,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN a.payment_status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'waived'::text]) THEN 'payment_incomplete'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN a.payment_status <> 'waived'::text AND a.amount_cents IS NOT NULL AND GREATEST(COALESCE(pt.gross_paid_cents, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(pt.refunded_cents, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) < a.amount_cents THEN 'payment_amount_short'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(ar.declined_agreements, 0) > 0 THEN 'agreement_declined'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN a.agreement_status <> ALL (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text]) THEN 'agreement_incomplete'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(ar.collected_signatures, 0) < COALESCE(ar.required_signatures, 0) THEN 'required_signatures_missing'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (a.payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'waived'::text])) AND (a.agreement_status = ANY (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text])) AND (a.access_status <> ALL (ARRAY['ready'::text, 'active'::text])) THEN 'access_not_ready'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS blockers,
    (a.payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'waived'::text])) AND (a.agreement_status = ANY (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text])) AND COALESCE(ar.declined_agreements, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(ar.collected_signatures, 0) >= COALESCE(ar.required_signatures, 0) AS ready_for_access,
    a.created_at,
    a.updated_at
   FROM journey_enrollment_activations a
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = a.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN payment_totals pt ON pt.activation_id = a.id
     LEFT JOIN agreement_rollup ar ON ar.activation_id = a.id
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'finance.view'::text) AND private.staff_can_access_contact(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), a.contact_id);

    count(*) FILTER (WHERE 'payment_incomplete'::text = ANY (blockers))::integer AS payment_incomplete,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE 'payment_amount_short'::text = ANY (blockers))::integer AS payment_amount_short,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE 'agreement_incomplete'::text = ANY (blockers))::integer AS agreement_incomplete,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE 'required_signatures_missing'::text = ANY (blockers))::integer AS signatures_missing,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE 'agreement_declined'::text = ANY (blockers))::integer AS agreement_declined,

           FROM client_agreements ca_1
          WHERE ca_1.activation_id = a.id AND (ca_1.status <> ALL (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text]))), 0) AS incomplete_agreements,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(ca_1.required_client_signatures)::integer AS sum
           FROM client_agreements ca_1
          WHERE ca_1.activation_id = a.id), 0) AS required_signatures,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
           FROM agreement_acceptances aa
             JOIN client_agreements ca_1 ON ca_1.id = aa.client_agreement_id
          WHERE ca_1.activation_id = a.id AND (aa.signer_role = ANY (ARRAY['primary_client'::text, 'secondary_client'::text]))), 0) AS collected_signatures,
    (a.payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'waived'::text])) AND (a.agreement_status = ANY (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text])) AS enrollment_requirements_complete
   FROM journey_enrollment_activations a
     JOIN client_access ca ON ca.contact_id = a.contact_id

  ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
 LIMIT 1;

views.name: admin_work_queue
views.definition:
SELECT t.id AS task_id,
    t.contact_id,
    t.title,
    t.due_at,
    t.status,
    t.priority,
    t.assigned_to,
    sd.display_name AS assigned_name,
    sd.role AS assigned_role,
    t.task_type,
    t.instructions,
    t.journey_id,
    t.journey_step_id,
    t.journey_action_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    c.phone,
    c.lifecycle_stage,
    cj.journey_key,
    jd.name AS journey_name,
    s.step_key,
    s.name AS journey_step_name,
        CASE
            WHEN lower(t.title) ~~ '%vitality report%'::text OR s.step_key = 'report_review'::text THEN 'Report Review'::text
            WHEN lower(t.title) ~~ '%weekly check-in%'::text OR t.task_type = 'review'::text AND COALESCE(s.step_key, ''::text) <> 'report_review'::text THEN 'Check-In Review'::text
            WHEN lower(t.title) ~~ '%coaching session%'::text THEN 'Coaching'::text
            WHEN t.task_type = 'scheduling'::text OR lower(t.title) ~~ '%schedule%'::text THEN 'Scheduling'::text
            WHEN t.task_type = 'call'::text OR lower(t.title) ~~ 'call:%'::text OR lower(t.title) ~~ '%follow-up call%'::text THEN 'Calls'::text
            WHEN t.task_type = 'email'::text OR lower(t.title) ~~ 'email:%'::text THEN 'Email'::text
            WHEN t.task_type = 'sms'::text OR lower(t.title) ~~ 'text:%'::text THEN 'Text'::text
            WHEN s.step_key = 'payment_agreement'::text OR lower(t.title) ~~ '%payment%'::text OR lower(t.title) ~~ '%enrollment%'::text THEN 'Enrollment'::text
            WHEN (s.step_key = ANY (ARRAY['onboarding_health_questionnaire'::text, 'backend_activation'::text, 'coach_setup'::text])) OR lower(t.title) ~~ '%onboarding%'::text OR lower(t.title) ~~ '%member access%'::text THEN 'Onboarding'::text
            WHEN lower(t.title) ~~ '%reminder%'::text THEN 'Reminders'::text
            ELSE 'Follow-Up'::text
        END AS work_category,
        CASE
            WHEN t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < now() THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < (date_trunc('day'::text, now()) + '1 day'::interval) THEN 'today'::text
            WHEN t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < (now() + '72:00:00'::interval) THEN 'soon'::text
            ELSE 'upcoming'::text
        END AS due_bucket,
    t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < now() AS overdue,
    t.created_at
   FROM follow_up_tasks t
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = t.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = t.assigned_to
     LEFT JOIN contact_journeys cj ON cj.id = t.journey_id
     LEFT JOIN journey_definitions jd ON jd.journey_key = cj.journey_key
     LEFT JOIN contact_journey_steps s ON s.id = t.journey_step_id
  WHERE t.status = 'open'::text;

views.name: admin_staff_onboarding_readiness
views.definition:
SELECT s.user_id,
    s.display_name,
    s.role,
    s.status,
    s.onboarding_status,
    s.phone,
    c.email,
    count(sa.id) FILTER (WHERE sa.required)::integer AS required_agreements,
    count(sa.id) FILTER (WHERE sa.required AND sa.status = 'signed'::text)::integer AS signed_required_agreements,
    count(sa.id) FILTER (WHERE sa.required AND sa.status = 'waived'::text)::integer AS waived_required_agreements,
    count(sa.id) FILTER (WHERE sa.required AND (sa.status <> ALL (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text])))::integer AS incomplete_required_agreements,
    count(sa.id) FILTER (WHERE sa.required AND sa.status = 'declined'::text)::integer AS declined_required_agreements,
    bool_or(sa.agreement_key = 'revitalized-nation-coach-nda'::text AND sa.status = 'signed'::text) AS coach_nda_signed,
    max(sa.signed_at) FILTER (WHERE sa.agreement_key = 'revitalized-nation-coach-nda'::text) AS coach_nda_signed_at,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN s.status <> 'active'::text THEN 'staff_inactive'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN s.role = 'coach'::text AND NOT COALESCE(bool_or(sa.agreement_key = 'revitalized-nation-coach-nda'::text AND (sa.status = ANY (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text]))), false) THEN 'coach_nda_incomplete'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN count(sa.id) FILTER (WHERE sa.required AND (sa.status <> ALL (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text]))) > 0 THEN 'required_agreement_incomplete'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN count(sa.id) FILTER (WHERE sa.required AND sa.status = 'declined'::text) > 0 THEN 'required_agreement_declined'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS blockers,
    s.status = 'active'::text AND count(sa.id) FILTER (WHERE sa.required AND (sa.status <> ALL (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text]))) = 0 AS onboarding_ready
   FROM staff_access s
     LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = s.user_id
     LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = p.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_agreements sa ON sa.staff_user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'staff.view'::text)
  GROUP BY s.user_id, s.display_name, s.role, s.status, s.onboarding_status, s.phone, c.email
  ORDER BY (
        CASE s.onboarding_status
            WHEN 'blocked'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'pending'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'complete'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), s.display_name;

            a.scheduled_end,
            a.time_zone,
            a.format,

            'journey'::text AS source
           FROM client_access ca
             JOIN journey_appointments a ON a.contact_id = ca.contact_id
             LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = a.assigned_to
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND a.status = 'scheduled'::text AND a.scheduled_start >= now()
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ca.user_id,
            cs.id AS appointment_id,
            'coaching_session'::text AS appointment_type,
            cs.status,
            cs.scheduled_start,
            cs.scheduled_end,

    a.status,

    s.status,

        CASE
            WHEN s.acceptance_signed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1

            WHEN s.acceptance_signed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END AS signatures_remaining,
    s.sent_at,
    s.viewed_at,
    s.signed_at
   FROM my_staff_agreements s
     JOIN staff_agreements sa ON sa.id = s.staff_agreement_id
     JOIN agreement_templates at ON at.id = sa.agreement_template_id;

    advisor_context_audit,
    ai_advisor_usage,
    advisor_answer_sources,
    advisor_feedback,
    ai_advisor_personalization,
    up_next,
    family_calendar_30d,
    weekly_progress_story,
    home_priority_summary,
    next_best_actions,
    device_summary,
    notification_preferences_v2,
    app_runtime,
    app_routes,
    sync_status,
    sync_cursor,
    bootstrap_generated_at,
    mobile_health_sync_status,
    privacy_center,
    privacy_exports,
    enrollment_readiness,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s.*) ORDER BY s.agreement_scope, s.sent_at) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_signature_center s), '[]'::jsonb) AS signature_center
   FROM my_app_bootstrap_v26 b;

views.name: my_goals
views.definition:
SELECT g.id,
    g.contact_id,
    g.household_id,
    g.membership_id,
    g.scope,
    g.goal_key,
    g.title,
    g.description,
    g.target_value,
    g.target_unit,
    g.baseline_value,
    g.target_date,
    g.priority,
    g.status,
    g.created_by_user_id,
    g.created_by_type,
    g.completed_at,
    g.created_at,
    g.updated_at
   FROM client_goals g
     JOIN client_access ca ON ca.contact_id = g.contact_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  ORDER BY (
        CASE g.status
            WHEN 'active'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'paused'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'completed'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), g.priority, g.created_at DESC;

views.name: my_recent_progress
views.definition:
SELECT pe.id,
    pe.contact_id,
    pe.metric_key,
    mc.label,
    mc.category,
    mc.unit,
    mc.value_type,
    pe.value_numeric,
    pe.value_boolean,
    pe.recorded_at,
    pe.source,
    pe.note
   FROM progress_entries pe
     JOIN progress_metric_catalog mc ON mc.metric_key = pe.metric_key
     JOIN client_access ca ON ca.contact_id = pe.contact_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  ORDER BY pe.recorded_at DESC
 LIMIT 100;

views.name: my_client_assignments
views.definition:
SELECT a.id,
    a.title,
    a.instructions,
    a.assignment_type,
    a.due_at,
    a.status,
    a.completed_at,
    a.member_note,
    a.created_at,
    sd.display_name AS assigned_by_name
   FROM client_assignments a
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = a.assigned_by
     JOIN client_access ca ON ca.contact_id = a.contact_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND a.status <> 'cancelled'::text
  ORDER BY (
        CASE a.status
            WHEN 'assigned'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'in_progress'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'completed'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), a.due_at, a.created_at DESC;

views.name: my_coach
views.definition:
SELECT cca.contact_id,
    cca.coach_user_id,
    cca.role,
    cca.status,
    sd.display_name AS coach_name
   FROM client_coach_assignments cca
     JOIN client_access ca ON ca.contact_id = cca.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = cca.coach_user_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND cca.status = 'active'::text;

views.name: admin_client_coaching_summary
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    ca.status AS access_status,
    cm.id AS membership_id,
    cm.program_code,
    pc.name AS program_name,
    cca.coach_user_id,
    sd.display_name AS coach_name,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_goals g
          WHERE g.contact_id = c.id AND g.status = 'active'::text) AS active_goals,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_habits h
          WHERE h.contact_id = c.id AND h.status = 'active'::text) AS active_habits,
    ( SELECT max(ch.submitted_at) AS max
           FROM client_checkins ch
          WHERE ch.contact_id = c.id AND (ch.status = ANY (ARRAY['submitted'::text, 'reviewed'::text]))) AS last_checkin_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_assignments a
          WHERE a.contact_id = c.id AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['assigned'::text, 'in_progress'::text]))) AS open_assignments,
    ( SELECT max(pe.recorded_at) AS max
           FROM progress_entries pe
          WHERE pe.contact_id = c.id) AS last_progress_at
   FROM contacts c
     JOIN client_access ca ON ca.contact_id = c.id
     LEFT JOIN client_memberships cm ON cm.id = ca.membership_id
     LEFT JOIN program_catalog pc ON pc.program_code = cm.program_code
     LEFT JOIN client_coach_assignments cca ON cca.contact_id = c.id AND cca.role = 'primary'::text AND cca.status = 'active'::text
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = cca.coach_user_id;

views.name: my_habits
views.definition:
SELECT h.id,
    h.contact_id,
    h.membership_id,
    h.title,
    h.category,
    h.frequency,
    h.target_per_period,
    h.unit,
    h.status,
    h.starts_on,
    h.ends_on,
    h.created_by,
    h.metadata,
    h.created_at,
    h.updated_at,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(hc.value) AS sum
           FROM habit_checkins hc
          WHERE hc.habit_id = h.id AND hc.checkin_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 days'::interval)), 0::numeric) AS last_7_day_value,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(hc.value) AS sum
           FROM habit_checkins hc
          WHERE hc.habit_id = h.id AND hc.checkin_date = CURRENT_DATE), 0::numeric) AS today_value
   FROM client_habits h
     JOIN client_access ca ON ca.contact_id = h.contact_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  ORDER BY h.status, h.created_at DESC;

views.name: admin_work_queue_summary
views.definition:
SELECT assigned_to,
    COALESCE(assigned_name, 'Unassigned'::text) AS assigned_name,
    count(*) AS open_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE overdue) AS overdue_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE due_bucket = 'today'::text) AS due_today_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_category = 'Report Review'::text) AS report_review_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_category = 'Check-In Review'::text) AS checkin_review_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_category = 'Scheduling'::text) AS scheduling_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_category = 'Calls'::text) AS calls_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_category = 'Coaching'::text) AS coaching_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_category = 'Enrollment'::text) AS enrollment_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_category = 'Onboarding'::text) AS onboarding_count
   FROM admin_work_queue
  GROUP BY assigned_to, assigned_name;

views.name: admin_manual_override_history
views.definition:
SELECT a.id,
    a.contact_id,
    a.journey_id,
    a.journey_step_id,
    a.entity_type,
    a.entity_id,
    a.action,
    a.permission_key,
    a.actor_user_id,
    COALESCE(sa.display_name, a.actor_user_id::text) AS actor_name,
    a.actor_role,
    a.previous_value,
    a.new_value,
    a.completion_method,
    a.reason,
    a.notes,
    a.metadata,
    a.created_at
   FROM manual_override_audit a
     LEFT JOIN staff_access sa ON sa.user_id = a.actor_user_id;

views.name: my_active_meal_plan
views.definition:
SELECT mp.id AS meal_plan_id,
    mp.title,
    mp.starts_on,
    mp.ends_on,
    mp.notes,
    mp.status,
    t.title AS template_title,
    p.name AS phase_name
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_meal_plans mp ON mp.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN meal_plan_templates t ON t.id = mp.template_id
     LEFT JOIN nutrition_phases p ON p.id = t.phase_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND mp.status = 'active'::text
  ORDER BY mp.starts_on DESC
 LIMIT 1;

views.name: my_upcoming_meals
views.definition:
SELECT i.id AS meal_item_id,
    i.meal_plan_id,
    i.scheduled_date,
    i.meal_slot,
    i.status,
    i.adherence_percent,
    COALESCE(r.title, i.custom_title) AS title,
    r.id AS recipe_id,
    r.prep_minutes,
    r.cook_minutes
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_meal_plan_items i ON i.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN recipes r ON r.id = i.recipe_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND i.scheduled_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND i.scheduled_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 6)
  ORDER BY i.scheduled_date, i.sort_order;

views.name: my_active_fitness_plan
views.definition:
SELECT fp.id AS fitness_plan_id,
    fp.title,
    fp.starts_on,
    fp.status,
    fp.notes,
    p.title AS program_title,
    p.difficulty,
    p.environment,
    p.weeks
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_fitness_plans fp ON fp.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN fitness_programs p ON p.id = fp.program_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND fp.status = 'active'::text
  ORDER BY fp.starts_on DESC
 LIMIT 1;

views.name: my_upcoming_workouts
views.definition:
SELECT a.id AS workout_assignment_id,
    a.fitness_plan_id,
    a.scheduled_date,
    a.status,
    a.notes,
    w.id AS workout_id,
    w.title,
    w.description,
    w.category,
    w.difficulty,
    w.environment,
    w.duration_minutes
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_workout_assignments a ON a.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     JOIN workout_templates w ON w.id = a.workout_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND a.scheduled_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND a.scheduled_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 6) AND a.status <> 'cancelled'::text
  ORDER BY a.scheduled_date, w.title;

views.name: my_grocery_list
views.definition:
SELECT gl.id AS grocery_list_id,
    gl.title,
    gl.status,
    gi.id AS item_id,
    gi.item,
    gi.quantity,
    gi.unit,
    gi.category,
    gi.checked,
    gi.sort_order
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_grocery_lists gl ON gl.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     JOIN grocery_list_items gi ON gi.grocery_list_id = gl.id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND gl.status = 'active'::text
  ORDER BY gl.created_at DESC, gi.checked, gi.sort_order;

views.name: admin_client_wellness_summary
views.definition:
SELECT id AS contact_id,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_meal_plans mp
          WHERE mp.contact_id = c.id AND mp.status = 'active'::text) AS active_meal_plans,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_fitness_plans fp
          WHERE fp.contact_id = c.id AND fp.status = 'active'::text) AS active_fitness_plans,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_workout_assignments wa
          WHERE wa.contact_id = c.id AND wa.status = 'assigned'::text AND wa.scheduled_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND wa.scheduled_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 7)) AS upcoming_workouts,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_meal_plan_items mi
          WHERE mi.contact_id = c.id AND mi.status = 'planned'::text AND mi.scheduled_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND mi.scheduled_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 7)) AS upcoming_meals,
    ( SELECT avg(nl.adherence_percent) AS avg
           FROM nutrition_logs nl
          WHERE nl.contact_id = c.id AND nl.log_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND nl.adherence_percent IS NOT NULL) AS nutrition_adherence_7d
   FROM contacts c
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.contact_id = c.id));

views.name: admin_client_learning_detail
views.definition:
SELECT e.id AS enrollment_id,
    e.contact_id,
    e.membership_id,
    e.course_id,
    c.title AS course_title,
    c.status AS course_status,
    e.source,
    e.status AS enrollment_status,
    e.progress_percent,
    e.started_at,
    e.completed_at,
    e.last_activity_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM learning_lessons l
             JOIN learning_modules m ON m.id = l.module_id
          WHERE m.course_id = e.course_id AND m.active AND l.status = 'published'::text AND l.requires_completion) AS required_lessons,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM lesson_progress lp
          WHERE lp.enrollment_id = e.id AND lp.status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_lessons
   FROM client_course_enrollments e
     JOIN learning_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id;

views.name: my_courses
views.definition:
SELECT e.id AS enrollment_id,
    e.course_id,
    c.title,
    c.description,
    c.estimated_minutes,
    c.thumbnail_url,
    e.status,
    e.progress_percent,
    e.last_lesson_id,
    e.last_activity_at,
    e.started_at,
    e.completed_at
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_course_enrollments e ON e.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     JOIN learning_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND e.status <> 'cancelled'::text AND c.status = 'published'::text
  ORDER BY (
        CASE e.status
            WHEN 'active'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'paused'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'completed'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), c.title;

views.name: my_course_lessons
views.definition:
SELECT ca.user_id,
    e.id AS enrollment_id,
    c.id AS course_id,
    m.id AS module_id,
    m.title AS module_title,
    m.module_order,
    l.id AS lesson_id,
    l.title AS lesson_title,
    l.description AS lesson_description,
    l.lesson_order,
    l.lesson_type,
    l.media_url,
    l.duration_seconds,
    l.requires_completion,
    COALESCE(lp.status, 'not_started'::text) AS progress_status,
    COALESCE(lp.progress_seconds, 0) AS progress_seconds,
    COALESCE(lp.completion_percent, 0) AS completion_percent,
    lp.completed_at
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_course_enrollments e ON e.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     JOIN learning_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id AND c.status = 'published'::text
     JOIN learning_modules m ON m.course_id = c.id AND m.active
     JOIN learning_lessons l ON l.module_id = m.id AND l.status = 'published'::text
     LEFT JOIN lesson_progress lp ON lp.enrollment_id = e.id AND lp.lesson_id = l.id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND e.status <> 'cancelled'::text
  ORDER BY c.title, m.module_order, l.lesson_order;

views.name: my_resources
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS resource_id,
    r.title,
    r.description,
    r.resource_type,
    r.resource_url,
    r.category,
    r.tags,
    COALESCE(cra.status, 'available'::text) AS assignment_status,
    cra.note AS assignment_note
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_memberships cm ON cm.id = ca.membership_id
     JOIN resource_library r ON r.status = 'published'::text
     LEFT JOIN program_resource_access pra ON pra.resource_id = r.id AND pra.program_code = cm.program_code AND pra.active
     LEFT JOIN client_resource_assignments cra ON cra.resource_id = r.id AND cra.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND cra.status <> 'cancelled'::text
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.status = 'active'::text AND cm.status = 'active'::text AND (pra.id IS NOT NULL OR cra.id IS NOT NULL)
  ORDER BY r.category, r.title;

views.name: admin_client_learning_summary
views.definition:
SELECT id AS contact_id,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_course_enrollments e
          WHERE e.contact_id = c.id AND e.status = 'active'::text) AS active_courses,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_course_enrollments e
          WHERE e.contact_id = c.id AND e.status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_courses,
    ( SELECT round(avg(e.progress_percent))::integer AS round
           FROM client_course_enrollments e
          WHERE e.contact_id = c.id AND (e.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'completed'::text]))) AS average_course_progress,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_resource_assignments r
          WHERE r.contact_id = c.id AND r.status = 'assigned'::text) AS assigned_resources
   FROM contacts c
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.contact_id = c.id));

views.name: admin_staff_inbox
views.definition:
SELECT p.user_id AS staff_user_id,
    c.id AS conversation_id,
    c.conversation_type,
    c.contact_id,
    c.household_id,
    c.membership_id,
    c.title,
    c.status,
    c.last_message_at,
    p.last_read_at,
    ct.first_name,
    ct.last_name,
    ct.email,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM member_messages m
          WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.sender_user_id <> p.user_id AND (p.last_read_at IS NULL OR m.created_at > p.last_read_at)) AS unread_count,
    ( SELECT "left"(m.body, 220) AS "left"
           FROM member_messages m
          WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
          ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_message_preview,
    ( SELECT m.sender_user_id
           FROM member_messages m
          WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
          ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_sender_user_id
   FROM member_conversation_participants p
     JOIN member_conversations c ON c.id = p.conversation_id
     LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = c.contact_id
  WHERE (p.user_id IN ( SELECT staff_access.user_id
           FROM staff_access)) AND p.left_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'active'::text;

views.name: my_conversations
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS conversation_id,
    c.conversation_type,
    c.title,
    c.status,
    c.last_message_at,
    p.last_read_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM member_messages m
          WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.sender_user_id <> (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (p.last_read_at IS NULL OR m.created_at > p.last_read_at)) AS unread_count,
    ( SELECT "left"(m.body, 180) AS "left"
           FROM member_messages m
          WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
          ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_message_preview
   FROM member_conversation_participants p
     JOIN member_conversations c ON c.id = p.conversation_id
  WHERE p.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND p.left_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'active'::text
  ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.created_at DESC;

views.name: my_notifications
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    notification_type,
    title,
    body,
    link_url,
    status,
    created_at,
    read_at
   FROM member_notifications
  WHERE user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND status <> 'dismissed'::text
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
 LIMIT 100;

views.name: admin_contact_conversations
views.definition:
SELECT id AS conversation_id,
    conversation_type,
    contact_id,
    household_id,
    membership_id,
    title,
    status,
    last_message_at,
    ( SELECT "left"(m.body, 220) AS "left"
           FROM member_messages m
          WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
          ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_message_preview
   FROM member_conversations c
  WHERE status = 'active'::text;

views.name: my_message_attachments
views.definition:
SELECT a.id AS attachment_id,
    a.message_id,
    m.conversation_id,
    a.storage_path,
    a.original_filename,
    a.content_type,
    a.size_bytes,
    a.created_at
   FROM member_message_attachments a
     JOIN member_messages m ON m.id = a.message_id
     JOIN member_conversation_participants p ON p.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND p.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND p.left_at IS NULL;

views.name: admin_notification_delivery_queue
views.definition:
SELECT j.id AS job_id,
    j.notification_id,
    j.user_id,
    j.contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email AS contact_email,
    c.phone,
    j.channel,
    j.provider,
    j.recipient,
    j.subject,
    j.body,
    j.status,
    j.block_reason,
    j.scheduled_for,
    j.attempt_count,
    j.last_attempt_at,
    j.provider_message_id,
    j.error_message,
    j.sent_at,
    j.created_at
   FROM notification_delivery_jobs j
     LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = j.contact_id;

views.name: admin_companion_review_queue
views.definition:
SELECT cr.id AS review_id,
    cr.request_id,
    cr.contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    r.question_type,
    qt.label AS question_type_label,
    r.question,
    r.handling_mode,
    r.status AS request_status,
    r.retrieval_confidence,
    r.answer_confidence,
    r.draft_answer,
    r.escalation_reason,
    cr.assigned_to,
    sd.display_name AS assigned_name,
    cr.status AS review_status,
    cr.review_reason,
    cr.created_at
   FROM coach_companion_reviews cr
     JOIN coach_companion_requests r ON r.id = cr.request_id
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = cr.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN coach_companion_question_types qt ON qt.question_type = r.question_type
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = cr.assigned_to
  WHERE cr.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'in_review'::text]);

views.name: my_health_connections
views.definition:
SELECT hc.id AS connection_id,
    hc.provider_key,
    p.name AS provider_name,
    p.provider_type,
    p.connection_mode,
    hc.status,
    hc.connected_at,
    hc.last_sync_at,
    hc.last_successful_sync_at,
    hc.last_error
   FROM health_integration_connections hc
     JOIN health_integration_providers p ON p.provider_key = hc.provider_key
  WHERE hc.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (hc.contact_id IN ( SELECT ca.contact_id
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))));

views.name: admin_client_health_integration_summary
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS contact_id,
    count(hc.id) FILTER (WHERE hc.status = 'connected'::text) AS connected_providers,
    max(hc.last_successful_sync_at) AS last_successful_sync_at,
    count(hc.id) FILTER (WHERE hc.status = 'attention_needed'::text) AS connections_needing_attention,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM health_observations ho
          WHERE ho.contact_id = c.id AND ho.observed_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS observations_24h
   FROM contacts c
     LEFT JOIN health_integration_connections hc ON hc.contact_id = c.id
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.contact_id = c.id))
  GROUP BY c.id;

views.name: admin_program_performance
views.definition:
SELECT pc.program_code,
    pc.name AS program_name,
    count(cm.id) FILTER (WHERE cm.status = 'active'::text) AS active_members,
    count(cm.id) FILTER (WHERE cm.status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_members,
    COALESCE(round(avg(( SELECT avg(e.progress_percent) AS avg
           FROM client_course_enrollments e
          WHERE e.membership_id = cm.id AND (e.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'completed'::text]))))), 0::numeric) AS average_course_progress,
    count(DISTINCT cs.id) FILTER (WHERE cs.status = 'completed'::text AND cs.completed_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)) AS coaching_sessions_30d,
    count(DISTINCT cc.id) FILTER (WHERE cc.submitted_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)) AS checkins_30d
   FROM program_catalog pc
     LEFT JOIN client_memberships cm ON cm.program_code = pc.program_code
     LEFT JOIN coaching_sessions cs ON cs.membership_id = cm.id
     LEFT JOIN client_checkins cc ON cc.membership_id = cm.id
  WHERE pc.active
  GROUP BY pc.program_code, pc.name
  ORDER BY pc.name;

views.name: my_challenges
views.definition:
SELECT ce.id AS enrollment_id,
    ce.scope,
    ce.status AS enrollment_status,
    ce.current_value,
    ce.completion_percent,
    ce.points_earned,
    wc.id AS challenge_id,
    wc.challenge_key,
    wc.title,
    wc.description,
    wc.target_key,
    wc.aggregation,
    wc.target_value,
    wc.unit,
    wc.starts_on,
    wc.ends_on,
    wc.points_available
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN challenge_enrollments ce ON ce.contact_id = ca.contact_id OR ca.household_id IS NOT NULL AND ce.household_id = ca.household_id
     JOIN wellness_challenges wc ON wc.id = ce.challenge_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (ce.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'completed'::text, 'paused'::text]))
  ORDER BY (
        CASE ce.status
            WHEN 'active'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'paused'::text THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END), wc.ends_on;

views.name: admin_client_challenge_summary
views.definition:
SELECT id AS contact_id,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
          WHERE ce.status = 'active'::text AND (ce.contact_id = c.id OR (ce.household_id IN ( SELECT hm.household_id
                   FROM household_members hm
                  WHERE hm.contact_id = c.id AND hm.status = 'active'::text)))) AS active_challenges,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
          WHERE ce.status = 'completed'::text AND (ce.contact_id = c.id OR (ce.household_id IN ( SELECT hm.household_id
                   FROM household_members hm
                  WHERE hm.contact_id = c.id AND hm.status = 'active'::text)))) AS completed_challenges,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(ce.points_earned), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
          WHERE (ce.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'completed'::text, 'paused'::text])) AND (ce.contact_id = c.id OR (ce.household_id IN ( SELECT hm.household_id
                   FROM household_members hm
                  WHERE hm.contact_id = c.id AND hm.status = 'active'::text)))) AS challenge_points
   FROM contacts c
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.contact_id = c.id));

views.name: admin_platform_health_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM contacts) AS total_contacts,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM contacts
          WHERE contacts.lifecycle_stage = 'assessment_lead'::text) AS assessment_leads,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM contacts
          WHERE contacts.lifecycle_stage = 'applicant'::text) AS applicants,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM contacts
          WHERE contacts.lifecycle_stage = 'client'::text) AS clients,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM contact_journeys
          WHERE contact_journeys.status = 'active'::text) AS active_journeys,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM contact_journeys cj
             JOIN contact_journey_steps s ON s.journey_id = cj.id AND s.step_key = cj.current_step_key
          WHERE cj.status = 'active'::text AND s.due_at IS NOT NULL AND s.due_at < now() AND (s.status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'skipped'::text, 'waived'::text]))) AS stalled_journeys,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM journey_enrollment_activations
          WHERE journey_enrollment_activations.payment_status = 'paid'::text) AS paid_enrollments,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_memberships
          WHERE client_memberships.status = 'active'::text) AS active_memberships,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_access
          WHERE client_access.status = 'active'::text) AS active_member_logins,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT client_coach_assignments.contact_id) AS count
           FROM client_coach_assignments
          WHERE client_coach_assignments.role = 'primary'::text AND client_coach_assignments.status = 'active'::text) AS clients_with_primary_coach,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_checkins
          WHERE client_checkins.submitted_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) AS checkins_7d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_assignments
          WHERE client_assignments.status = ANY (ARRAY['assigned'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AS open_client_assignments,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM coaching_sessions
          WHERE coaching_sessions.status = 'scheduled'::text AND coaching_sessions.scheduled_start >= now()) AS upcoming_coaching_sessions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_course_enrollments
          WHERE client_course_enrollments.status = 'active'::text) AS active_course_enrollments,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(round(avg(client_course_enrollments.progress_percent)), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM client_course_enrollments
          WHERE client_course_enrollments.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'completed'::text])) AS average_course_progress,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM challenge_enrollments
          WHERE challenge_enrollments.status = 'active'::text) AS active_challenge_enrollments,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM challenge_enrollments
          WHERE challenge_enrollments.status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_challenge_enrollments,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM health_integration_connections
          WHERE health_integration_connections.status = 'connected'::text) AS connected_health_sources,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM health_integration_connections
          WHERE health_integration_connections.status = 'attention_needed'::text) AS health_connections_needing_attention,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM member_messages
          WHERE member_messages.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval) AND member_messages.deleted_at IS NULL) AS private_messages_7d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM coach_companion_reviews
          WHERE coach_companion_reviews.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'in_review'::text])) AS companion_reviews_open,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM notification_delivery_jobs
          WHERE notification_delivery_jobs.status = 'blocked'::text) AS blocked_notification_deliveries;

views.name: admin_conversion_funnel
views.definition:
SELECT stage_order,
    stage_name,
    stage_count
   FROM ( VALUES (1,'Total Contacts'::text,( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM contacts)), (2,'Assessment Leads'::text,( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM contacts
                  WHERE contacts.lifecycle_stage = 'assessment_lead'::text)), (3,'Applicants'::text,( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM contacts
                  WHERE contacts.lifecycle_stage = 'applicant'::text)), (4,'Paid Enrollments'::text,( SELECT count(DISTINCT journey_enrollment_activations.contact_id) AS count
                   FROM journey_enrollment_activations
                  WHERE journey_enrollment_activations.payment_status = 'paid'::text)), (5,'Active Members'::text,( SELECT count(DISTINCT client_memberships.primary_contact_id) AS count
                   FROM client_memberships
                  WHERE client_memberships.status = 'active'::text))) funnel(stage_order, stage_name, stage_count);

views.name: admin_community_spaces
views.definition:
SELECT id AS space_id,
    space_key,
    name,
    description,
    space_type,
    program_code,
    household_id,
    challenge_id,
    status,
    posting_mode,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_memberships cm
          WHERE cm.space_id = s.id AND cm.status = 'active'::text) AS active_members,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_posts p
          WHERE p.space_id = s.id AND p.status = 'published'::text) AS published_posts,
    ( SELECT max(p.created_at) AS max
           FROM community_posts p
          WHERE p.space_id = s.id AND p.status = 'published'::text) AS last_post_at
   FROM community_spaces s
  ORDER BY (
        CASE space_type
            WHEN 'program'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'household'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'challenge'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), name;

views.name: admin_community_feed
views.definition:
SELECT p.id AS post_id,
    p.space_id,
    s.name AS space_name,
    s.space_type,
    p.author_user_id,
    p.author_contact_id,
    COALESCE(sa.display_name, c.first_name, 'ReVitalized Member'::text) AS author_name,
    p.post_type,
    p.title,
    p.body,
    p.status,
    p.pinned,
    p.created_at,
    p.updated_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_comments cc
          WHERE cc.post_id = p.id AND cc.status = 'published'::text) AS comment_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_reactions cr
          WHERE cr.post_id = p.id) AS reaction_count
   FROM community_posts p
     JOIN community_spaces s ON s.id = p.space_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_access sa ON sa.user_id = p.author_user_id
     LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = p.author_contact_id
  ORDER BY p.pinned DESC, p.created_at DESC;

views.name: my_community_spaces
views.definition:
SELECT s.id AS space_id,
    s.space_key,
    s.name,
    s.description,
    s.space_type,
    s.program_code,
    s.household_id,
    s.challenge_id,
    s.posting_mode,
    cm.membership_role,
    cm.status AS membership_status
   FROM community_memberships cm
     JOIN community_spaces s ON s.id = cm.space_id
  WHERE cm.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (cm.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'muted'::text])) AND s.status = 'active'::text
  ORDER BY (
        CASE s.space_type
            WHEN 'household'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'program'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'challenge'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), s.name;

views.name: my_community_feed
views.definition:
SELECT p.id AS post_id,
    p.space_id,
    s.name AS space_name,
    s.space_type,
    p.post_type,
    p.title,
    p.body,
    p.pinned,
    p.created_at,
    p.author_user_id,
    COALESCE(sa.display_name, c.first_name, 'ReVitalized Member'::text) AS author_name,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_comments cc
          WHERE cc.post_id = p.id AND cc.status = 'published'::text) AS comment_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_reactions cr
          WHERE cr.post_id = p.id) AS reaction_count
   FROM community_posts p
     JOIN community_spaces s ON s.id = p.space_id
     JOIN community_memberships cm ON cm.space_id = p.space_id AND cm.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (cm.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'muted'::text]))
     LEFT JOIN staff_access sa ON sa.user_id = p.author_user_id
     LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = p.author_contact_id
  WHERE p.status = 'published'::text AND s.status = 'active'::text
  ORDER BY p.pinned DESC, p.created_at DESC
 LIMIT 100;

views.name: admin_community_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_spaces
          WHERE community_spaces.status = 'active'::text) AS active_spaces,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_posts
          WHERE community_posts.status = 'published'::text AND community_posts.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) AS posts_7d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_comments
          WHERE community_comments.status = 'published'::text AND community_comments.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) AS comments_7d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_reactions
          WHERE community_reactions.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) AS reactions_7d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM community_memberships
          WHERE community_memberships.status = 'active'::text) AS active_space_memberships;

views.name: admin_refuel_pipeline
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    ri.status AS interest_status,
    ri.created_at AS interest_created_at,
    inv.id AS invitation_id,
    inv.status AS invitation_status,
    inv.invited_at,
    o.id AS offer_id,
    o.name AS offer_name,
    o.status AS offer_status,
    re.id AS enrollment_id,
    re.status AS enrollment_status,
    re.payment_status,
    re.activated_at
   FROM refuel_interest ri
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = ri.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN refuel_invitations inv ON inv.contact_id = c.id
     LEFT JOIN refuel_offers o ON o.id = inv.offer_id
     LEFT JOIN refuel_enrollments re ON re.contact_id = c.id AND re.offer_id = o.id;

views.name: my_refuel_access
views.definition:
SELECT re.id AS enrollment_id,
    re.status AS enrollment_status,
    re.payment_status,
    o.id AS offer_id,
    o.offer_key,
    o.name AS offer_name,
    o.description,
    o.starts_at,
    o.ends_at,
    o.price_cents,
    o.currency,
    o.billing_type
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN refuel_enrollments re ON re.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     JOIN refuel_offers o ON o.id = re.offer_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (re.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'active'::text, 'completed'::text]))
  ORDER BY re.enrolled_at DESC;

views.name: admin_refuel_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM refuel_interest
          WHERE refuel_interest.status = 'interested'::text) AS interested,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM refuel_invitations
          WHERE refuel_invitations.status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'sent'::text, 'opened'::text])) AS invited_open,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM refuel_enrollments
          WHERE refuel_enrollments.status = 'active'::text) AS active_enrollments,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM refuel_enrollments
          WHERE refuel_enrollments.payment_status = 'paid'::text) AS paid_enrollments,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM refuel_offers
          WHERE refuel_offers.status = 'published'::text) AS published_offers;

views.name: admin_staff_permission_matrix
views.definition:
SELECT sa.user_id,
    sa.display_name,
    sa.role,
    sa.status,
    pc.permission_key,
    pc.label,
    pc.category,
    pc.description,
    pc.sensitive,
    pc.sort_order,
    srpd.allowed AS role_default_allowed,
    spo.allowed AS override_allowed,
    COALESCE(spo.allowed, srpd.allowed, false) AS effective_allowed,
    spo.reason AS override_reason,
    spo.updated_at AS override_updated_at
   FROM staff_access sa
     CROSS JOIN staff_permission_catalog pc
     LEFT JOIN staff_role_permission_defaults srpd ON srpd.role = sa.role AND srpd.permission_key = pc.permission_key
     LEFT JOIN staff_permission_overrides spo ON spo.user_id = sa.user_id AND spo.permission_key = pc.permission_key
  WHERE pc.active;

views.name: my_staff_permissions_view
views.definition:
SELECT pc.permission_key,
    COALESCE(spo.allowed, srpd.allowed, false) AS allowed
   FROM staff_access sa
     CROSS JOIN staff_permission_catalog pc
     LEFT JOIN staff_role_permission_defaults srpd ON srpd.role = sa.role AND srpd.permission_key = pc.permission_key
     LEFT JOIN staff_permission_overrides spo ON spo.user_id = sa.user_id AND spo.permission_key = pc.permission_key
  WHERE sa.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND sa.status = 'active'::text AND pc.active;

views.name: admin_referral_summary
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    rp.referral_code,
    count(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_referrals,
    count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'converted'::text) AS converted_referrals,
    count(DISTINCT rr.id) FILTER (WHERE rr.status = 'pending'::text) AS pending_rewards,
    count(DISTINCT rr.id) FILTER (WHERE rr.status = 'issued'::text) AS issued_rewards
   FROM contacts c
     LEFT JOIN referral_profiles rp ON rp.contact_id = c.id
     LEFT JOIN referrals r ON r.referrer_contact_id = c.id
     LEFT JOIN referral_rewards rr ON rr.referrer_contact_id = c.id
  GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, rp.referral_code
 HAVING count(DISTINCT r.id) > 0 OR count(DISTINCT rp.id) > 0;

views.name: my_referral_summary
views.definition:
SELECT rp.referral_code,
    count(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_referrals,
    count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'converted'::text) AS converted_referrals,
    count(DISTINCT rr.id) FILTER (WHERE rr.status = 'pending'::text) AS pending_rewards,
    count(DISTINCT rr.id) FILTER (WHERE rr.status = 'issued'::text) AS issued_rewards
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN referral_profiles rp ON rp.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN referrals r ON r.referrer_contact_id = rp.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN referral_rewards rr ON rr.referrer_contact_id = rp.contact_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  GROUP BY rp.referral_code;

views.name: admin_referral_pipeline
views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS referral_id,
    r.referral_program_id,
    rp.name AS referral_program_name,
    r.referrer_contact_id,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, referrer.first_name, referrer.last_name)) AS referrer_name,
    referrer.email AS referrer_email,
    r.referred_contact_id,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, referred.first_name, referred.last_name)) AS referred_name,
    referred.email AS referred_email,
    referred.phone AS referred_phone,
    referred.lifecycle_stage,
    r.referral_code,
    r.source_channel,
    r.status,
    r.first_touch_at,
    r.converted_at,
    r.notes
   FROM referrals r
     LEFT JOIN referral_programs rp ON rp.id = r.referral_program_id
     LEFT JOIN contacts referrer ON referrer.id = r.referrer_contact_id
     JOIN contacts referred ON referred.id = r.referred_contact_id
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;

views.name: admin_staff_workload
views.definition:
SELECT user_id,
    display_name,
    role,
    status,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM contacts c
          WHERE c.assigned_to = sa.user_id AND c.lifecycle_stage <> 'inactive'::text) AS assigned_contacts,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_coach_assignments cca
          WHERE cca.coach_user_id = sa.user_id AND cca.role = 'primary'::text AND cca.status = 'active'::text) AS active_clients,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM follow_up_tasks t
          WHERE t.assigned_to = sa.user_id AND t.status = 'open'::text) AS open_tasks,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM follow_up_tasks t
          WHERE t.assigned_to = sa.user_id AND t.status = 'open'::text AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < now()) AS overdue_tasks,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM coaching_sessions cs
          WHERE cs.coach_user_id = sa.user_id AND cs.status = 'scheduled'::text AND cs.scheduled_start >= now() AND cs.scheduled_start < (now() + '7 days'::interval)) AS coaching_sessions_7d,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(i.unread_count), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM admin_staff_inbox i
          WHERE i.staff_user_id = sa.user_id) AS unread_member_messages,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM coach_companion_reviews cr
          WHERE cr.assigned_to = sa.user_id AND (cr.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'in_review'::text]))) AS companion_reviews
   FROM staff_access sa
  WHERE status = 'active'::text
  ORDER BY (
        CASE role
            WHEN 'owner'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'admin'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'coach'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'financial'::text THEN 4
            WHEN 'support'::text THEN 5
            ELSE 6
        END), display_name;

views.name: admin_referral_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referrals) AS total_referrals,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referrals
          WHERE referrals.status = 'converted'::text) AS converted_referrals,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_rewards
          WHERE referral_rewards.status = 'pending'::text) AS pending_rewards,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_rewards
          WHERE referral_rewards.status = 'issued'::text) AS issued_rewards,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_profiles
          WHERE referral_profiles.status = 'active'::text) AS active_ambassadors;

views.name: admin_referral_rewards
views.definition:
SELECT rr.id AS reward_id,
    rr.referral_id,
    rr.referrer_contact_id,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name)) AS referrer_name,
    c.email AS referrer_email,
    rr.reward_type,
    rr.reward_value,
    rr.currency,
    rr.status,
    rr.approved_at,
    rr.issued_at,
    rr.notes,
    rr.created_at
   FROM referral_rewards rr
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = rr.referrer_contact_id
  ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC;

views.name: admin_team_calendar
views.definition:
SELECT 'journey_appointment'::text AS item_type,
    ja.id AS item_id,
    ja.contact_id,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name)) AS person_name,
    c.email,
    ja.appointment_type,
    ja.status,
    ja.scheduled_start,
    ja.scheduled_end,
    ja.time_zone,
    ja.format,
    ja.location_url,
    ja.assigned_to AS staff_user_id,
    sd.display_name AS staff_name,
    ja.journey_id,
    ja.journey_step_id,
    ja.client_notes,
    ja.staff_notes,
    ja.created_at,
    ja.updated_at
   FROM journey_appointments ja
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = ja.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = ja.assigned_to
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'coaching_session'::text AS item_type,
    cs.id AS item_id,
    cs.contact_id,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name)) AS person_name,
    c.email,
    'coaching_session'::text AS appointment_type,
    cs.status,
    cs.scheduled_start,
    cs.scheduled_end,
    NULL::text AS time_zone,
    cs.format,
    cs.location_url,
    cs.coach_user_id AS staff_user_id,
    sd.display_name AS staff_name,
    NULL::uuid AS journey_id,
    cs.appointment_id AS journey_step_id,
    cs.client_agenda AS client_notes,
    NULL::text AS staff_notes,
    cs.created_at,
    cs.updated_at
   FROM coaching_sessions cs
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = cs.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = cs.coach_user_id;

views.name: admin_people_directory
views.definition:
SELECT c.id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    c.phone,
    c.city,
    c.state,
    c.country,
    c.lifecycle_stage,
    c.follow_up_status,
    c.consultation_status,
    c.assigned_to,
    sd.display_name AS assigned_name,
    c.next_follow_up_at,
    c.first_source,
    c.last_source,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at,
    ( SELECT min(COALESCE(cm.starts_at, cm.created_at)) AS min
           FROM client_memberships cm
          WHERE cm.primary_contact_id = c.id) AS enrolled_at,
    COALESCE(( SELECT max(a.created_at) AS max
           FROM contact_activity a
          WHERE a.contact_id = c.id), c.updated_at) AS last_activity_at,
    ( SELECT w.status
           FROM workflow_records w
          WHERE w.contact_id = c.id AND w.workflow_type = 'vitality_assessment'::text AND w.status <> 'abandoned'::text
          ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS vitality_status,
    ( SELECT w.status
           FROM workflow_records w
          WHERE w.contact_id = c.id AND w.workflow_type = 'enrollment'::text AND w.status <> 'abandoned'::text
          ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS enrollment_status,
    ( SELECT wr.status
           FROM webinar_registrations wr
          WHERE wr.contact_id = c.id
          ORDER BY wr.registered_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS webinar_status,
    c.record_kind
   FROM contacts c
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = c.assigned_to;

SELECT sa.user_id,
    sa.display_name,
    sa.role,
    COALESCE(scs.accepts_new_clients, true) AS accepts_new_clients,
    scs.max_active_clients,
    scs.max_sessions_per_day,
    scs.max_sessions_per_week,
    COALESCE(scs.session_buffer_minutes, 15) AS session_buffer_minutes,
    COALESCE(scs.default_session_minutes, 60) AS default_session_minutes,
    scs.time_zone,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_coach_assignments cca
          WHERE cca.coach_user_id = sa.user_id AND cca.role = 'primary'::text AND cca.status = 'active'::text) AS active_clients,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM coaching_sessions cs
          WHERE cs.coach_user_id = sa.user_id AND cs.status = 'scheduled'::text AND cs.scheduled_start >= date_trunc('week'::text, now()) AND cs.scheduled_start < (date_trunc('week'::text, now()) + '7 days'::interval)) AS scheduled_sessions_this_week,
        CASE
            WHEN scs.max_active_clients IS NULL THEN NULL::bigint
            ELSE GREATEST(0::bigint, scs.max_active_clients - (( SELECT count(*) AS count
               FROM client_coach_assignments cca
              WHERE cca.coach_user_id = sa.user_id AND cca.role = 'primary'::text AND cca.status = 'active'::text)))
        END AS remaining_client_capacity
   FROM staff_access sa
     LEFT JOIN staff_capacity_settings scs ON scs.user_id = sa.user_id
