views.name: admin_schedule_availability_issues
views.definition:
WITH scheduled AS (
         SELECT admin_team_calendar.item_type,
            admin_team_calendar.item_id,
            admin_team_calendar.contact_id,
            admin_team_calendar.person_name,
            admin_team_calendar.email,
            admin_team_calendar.appointment_type,
            admin_team_calendar.status,
            admin_team_calendar.scheduled_start,
            admin_team_calendar.scheduled_end,
            admin_team_calendar.time_zone,
            admin_team_calendar.format,
            admin_team_calendar.location_url,
            admin_team_calendar.staff_user_id,
            admin_team_calendar.staff_name,
            admin_team_calendar.journey_id,
            admin_team_calendar.journey_step_id,
            admin_team_calendar.client_notes,
            admin_team_calendar.staff_notes,
            admin_team_calendar.created_at,
            admin_team_calendar.updated_at
           FROM admin_team_calendar
          WHERE admin_team_calendar.status = 'scheduled'::text AND admin_team_calendar.staff_user_id IS NOT NULL AND admin_team_calendar.scheduled_start IS NOT NULL
        ), availability AS (
         SELECT s_1.item_id,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM staff_availability_rules ar
                  WHERE ar.user_id = s_1.staff_user_id AND ar.active AND ar.day_of_week = EXTRACT(dow FROM (s_1.scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE ar.time_zone))::integer AND (s_1.scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE ar.time_zone)::time without time zone >= ar.start_time AND (COALESCE(s_1.scheduled_end, s_1.scheduled_start + '01:00:00'::interval) AT TIME ZONE ar.time_zone) <= (date((s_1.scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE ar.time_zone)) + ar.end_time))) AS within_recurring_availability,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM staff_availability_exceptions ex
                  WHERE ex.user_id = s_1.staff_user_id AND ex.exception_type = 'unavailable'::text AND ex.starts_at < COALESCE(s_1.scheduled_end, s_1.scheduled_start + '01:00:00'::interval) AND ex.ends_at > s_1.scheduled_start)) AS hits_unavailable_exception,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM staff_availability_rules ar
                  WHERE ar.user_id = s_1.staff_user_id AND ar.active)) AS has_availability_rules
           FROM scheduled s_1
        ), daily_counts AS (
         SELECT s_1.staff_user_id,
            date(s_1.scheduled_start) AS schedule_day,
            count(*) AS day_count
           FROM scheduled s_1
          GROUP BY s_1.staff_user_id, (date(s_1.scheduled_start))
        ), weekly_counts AS (
         SELECT s_1.staff_user_id,
            date_trunc('week'::text, s_1.scheduled_start) AS week_start,
            count(*) AS week_count
           FROM scheduled s_1
          GROUP BY s_1.staff_user_id, (date_trunc('week'::text, s_1.scheduled_start))
        )
 SELECT s.item_id,
    s.item_type,
    s.staff_user_id,
    s.staff_name,
    s.person_name,
    s.scheduled_start,
    s.scheduled_end,
        CASE
            WHEN a.hits_unavailable_exception THEN 'unavailable_exception'::text
            WHEN a.has_availability_rules AND NOT a.within_recurring_availability THEN 'outside_recurring_availability'::text
            WHEN scs.max_sessions_per_day IS NOT NULL AND dc.day_count > scs.max_sessions_per_day THEN 'daily_capacity_exceeded'::text
            WHEN scs.max_sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL AND wc.week_count > scs.max_sessions_per_week THEN 'weekly_capacity_exceeded'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS issue_type,
        CASE
            WHEN a.hits_unavailable_exception THEN 'Scheduled during a staff unavailable exception.'::text
            WHEN a.has_availability_rules AND NOT a.within_recurring_availability THEN 'Scheduled outside configured recurring availability.'::text
            WHEN scs.max_sessions_per_day IS NOT NULL AND dc.day_count > scs.max_sessions_per_day THEN 'Scheduled sessions exceed the configured daily limit.'::text
            WHEN scs.max_sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL AND wc.week_count > scs.max_sessions_per_week THEN 'Scheduled sessions exceed the configured weekly limit.'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS issue_detail
   FROM scheduled s
     JOIN availability a ON a.item_id = s.item_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_capacity_settings scs ON scs.user_id = s.staff_user_id
     LEFT JOIN daily_counts dc ON dc.staff_user_id = s.staff_user_id AND dc.schedule_day = date(s.scheduled_start)
     LEFT JOIN weekly_counts wc ON wc.staff_user_id = s.staff_user_id AND wc.week_start = date_trunc('week'::text, s.scheduled_start)
  WHERE a.hits_unavailable_exception OR a.has_availability_rules AND NOT a.within_recurring_availability OR scs.max_sessions_per_day IS NOT NULL AND dc.day_count > scs.max_sessions_per_day OR scs.max_sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL AND wc.week_count > scs.max_sessions_per_week;

views.name: my_app_home
views.definition:
SELECT ca.user_id,
    ca.contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    ca.membership_id,
    cm.program_code,
    pc.name AS program_name,
    cm.status AS membership_status,
    ca.status AS access_status,
    cm.assigned_coach_id,
    sa.display_name AS assigned_coach_name,
    ( SELECT mj.journey_name
           FROM my_member_journey mj
          ORDER BY mj.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) AS journey_name,
    ( SELECT mj.current_step_name
           FROM my_member_journey mj
          ORDER BY mj.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) AS current_step_name,
    ( SELECT mj.progress_percent
           FROM my_member_journey mj
          ORDER BY mj.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) AS journey_progress_percent,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_goals g
          WHERE g.status = 'active'::text) AS active_goals,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_habits h
          WHERE h.status = 'active'::text) AS active_habits,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_challenges ch
          WHERE ch.enrollment_status = 'active'::text) AS active_challenges,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_courses mc
          WHERE mc.status = 'active'::text) AS active_courses,
    (( SELECT COALESCE(round(avg(mc.progress_percent)), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM my_courses mc
          WHERE mc.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'completed'::text])))::integer AS average_course_progress,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_resources mr) AS available_resources,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_notifications mn
          WHERE mn.status = 'unread'::text) AS unread_notifications,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_upcoming_meals mum
          WHERE mum.scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE) AS meals_today,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_upcoming_workouts muw
          WHERE muw.scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE) AS workouts_today,
    ( SELECT mc.title
           FROM my_courses mc
          WHERE mc.status = 'active'::text
          ORDER BY mc.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST, mc.title
         LIMIT 1) AS continue_course_title,
    ( SELECT muw.title
           FROM my_upcoming_workouts muw
          WHERE muw.scheduled_date >= CURRENT_DATE
          ORDER BY muw.scheduled_date, muw.title
         LIMIT 1) AS next_workout_title,
    ( SELECT mum.title
           FROM my_upcoming_meals mum
          WHERE mum.scheduled_date >= CURRENT_DATE
          ORDER BY mum.scheduled_date, mum.meal_slot
         LIMIT 1) AS next_meal_title
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = ca.contact_id
     JOIN client_memberships cm ON cm.id = ca.membership_id
     JOIN program_catalog pc ON pc.program_code = cm.program_code
     LEFT JOIN staff_access sa ON sa.user_id = cm.assigned_coach_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
 LIMIT 1;

views.definition:
SELECT sa.user_id,

           FROM staff_permission_catalog pc
          WHERE pc.active) AS effective_permissions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM staff_agreements ag
          WHERE ag.staff_user_id = sa.user_id AND ag.required AND (ag.status <> ALL (ARRAY['signed'::text, 'waived'::text]))) AS pending_required_agreements,
    ( SELECT max(ag.signed_at) AS max
           FROM staff_agreements ag
          WHERE ag.staff_user_id = sa.user_id AND ag.status = 'signed'::text) AS last_staff_agreement_signed_at,
    sa.contact_scope
   FROM staff_access sa
     LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = sa.user_id
     LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = p.contact_id;

views.name: my_family_hub_summary
views.definition:
SELECT ca.user_id,
    ca.contact_id,
    ca.household_id,
    h.household_name,
    h.household_type,
    h.status AS household_status,
    count(hm.id) FILTER (WHERE hm.status = 'active'::text) AS active_members,
    count(hm.id) FILTER (WHERE hm.status = 'active'::text AND hm.is_primary = false) AS additional_members,
    count(hm.id) FILTER (WHERE hm.status = 'active'::text AND hm.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND hm.date_of_birth > (CURRENT_DATE - '18 years'::interval)) AS minors,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_goals cg
          WHERE cg.household_id = ca.household_id AND cg.scope = 'household'::text AND cg.status = 'active'::text) AS active_family_goals
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN households h ON h.id = ca.household_id
     LEFT JOIN household_members hm ON hm.household_id = h.id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  GROUP BY ca.user_id, ca.contact_id, ca.household_id, h.household_name, h.household_type, h.status;

views.name: my_coaching_sessions
views.definition:
SELECT cs.id AS session_id,
    cs.contact_id,
    cs.membership_id,
    cs.coach_user_id,
    sd.display_name AS coach_name,
    cs.appointment_id,
    cs.session_number,
    cs.status,
    cs.scheduled_start,
    cs.scheduled_end,
    cs.format,
    cs.location_url,
    cs.client_agenda,
    cs.completed_at,
    cs.created_at
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN coaching_sessions cs ON cs.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = cs.coach_user_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  ORDER BY cs.scheduled_start DESC NULLS LAST, cs.created_at DESC;

views.name: my_payment_history
views.definition:
SELECT be.id AS event_id,
    be.event_type,
    be.provider,
    be.amount_cents,
    be.currency,
    be.status,
    be.occurred_at
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN billing_events be ON be.contact_id = ca.contact_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (be.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['payment_succeeded'::text, 'payment_failed'::text, 'refund'::text, 'manual_adjustment'::text]))
  ORDER BY be.occurred_at DESC;

views.name: my_daily_action_center
views.definition:
SELECT user_id,
    contact_id,
    CURRENT_DATE AS action_date,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('habit_id', h.id, 'title', h.title, 'category', h.category, 'frequency', h.frequency, 'target', h.target_per_period, 'unit', h.unit, 'today_value', COALESCE(( SELECT hc.value
                   FROM habit_checkins hc
                  WHERE hc.habit_id = h.id AND hc.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND hc.checkin_date = CURRENT_DATE
                 LIMIT 1), 0::numeric), 'completed_today', COALESCE(( SELECT hc.value >= h.target_per_period
                   FROM habit_checkins hc
                  WHERE hc.habit_id = h.id AND hc.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND hc.checkin_date = CURRENT_DATE
                 LIMIT 1), false)) ORDER BY h.title) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM client_habits h
          WHERE h.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND h.status = 'active'::text AND h.starts_on <= CURRENT_DATE AND (h.ends_on IS NULL OR h.ends_on >= CURRENT_DATE)), '[]'::jsonb) AS habits,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m.*) ORDER BY m.meal_slot, m.title) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_upcoming_meals m
          WHERE m.scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE), '[]'::jsonb) AS meals,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(w.*) ORDER BY w.title) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_upcoming_workouts w
          WHERE w.scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE), '[]'::jsonb) AS workouts,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ch.*) ORDER BY ch.ends_on, ch.title) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_challenges ch
          WHERE ch.enrollment_status = 'active'::text), '[]'::jsonb) AS challenges,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(c.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_courses c
          WHERE c.status = 'active'::text
          ORDER BY c.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.title
         LIMIT 1) AS continue_course,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_habits h
          WHERE h.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND h.status = 'active'::text AND h.starts_on <= CURRENT_DATE AND (h.ends_on IS NULL OR h.ends_on >= CURRENT_DATE)) AS habit_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM habit_checkins hc
             JOIN client_habits h ON h.id = hc.habit_id
          WHERE hc.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND hc.checkin_date = CURRENT_DATE AND h.status = 'active'::text AND hc.value >= h.target_per_period) AS habits_completed_today,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_upcoming_meals m
          WHERE m.scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE) AS meal_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_upcoming_workouts w
          WHERE w.scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE) AS workout_count
   FROM client_access ca
  WHERE user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
 LIMIT 1;

views.name: my_progress_snapshot
views.definition:
SELECT user_id,
    contact_id,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_goals g
          WHERE g.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND g.status = 'active'::text) AS active_goals,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_goals g
          WHERE g.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND g.status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_goals,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_habits h
          WHERE h.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND h.status = 'active'::text) AS active_habits,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM habit_checkins hc
          WHERE hc.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND hc.checkin_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6)) AS habit_checkins_last_7_days,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
          WHERE ce.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND ce.status = 'active'::text) AS active_challenges,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
          WHERE ce.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND ce.status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_challenges,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(ce.points_earned), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
          WHERE ce.contact_id = ca.contact_id) AS challenge_points,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_workout_assignments wa
          WHERE wa.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND wa.status = 'completed'::text AND wa.scheduled_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 29)) AS workouts_completed_30d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_meal_plan_items mi
          WHERE mi.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND mi.status = 'completed'::text AND mi.scheduled_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 29)) AS meals_completed_30d,
    ( SELECT round(avg(mi.adherence_percent), 1) AS round
           FROM client_meal_plan_items mi
          WHERE mi.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND mi.adherence_percent IS NOT NULL AND mi.scheduled_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 29)) AS meal_adherence_30d,
    ( SELECT max(pe.recorded_at) AS max
           FROM progress_entries pe
          WHERE pe.contact_id = ca.contact_id) AS last_progress_at
   FROM client_access ca
  WHERE user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
 LIMIT 1;

views.name: my_app_access
views.definition:
SELECT ca.user_id,
    ca.contact_id,
    ca.membership_id,
    cm.program_code,
    pc.name AS program_name,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND me.entitlement_key = 'community'::text)) AS community_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM client_course_enrollments cce
          WHERE cce.membership_id = cm.id AND cce.status <> 'cancelled'::text)) AS courses_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND (me.entitlement_key = ANY (ARRAY['nutrition_plans'::text, 'tracking'::text])))) AS nutrition_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND (me.entitlement_key = ANY (ARRAY['fitness_plans'::text, 'tracking'::text])))) AS fitness_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND me.entitlement_key = 'health_challenges'::text)) AS challenges_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND me.entitlement_key = 'ai_advisor'::text)) AS ask_revitalized_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND me.entitlement_key = 'family_profiles'::text)) AS family_hub_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND me.entitlement_key = 'biometrics'::text)) AS biometrics_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND me.entitlement_key = 'group_coaching'::text)) AS group_coaching_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND me.entitlement_key = 'private_coaching'::text)) AS private_coaching_enabled,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM my_refuel_access mra)) AS refuel_enabled,
    ( SELECT me.limit_value
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text AND me.entitlement_key = 'family_profiles'::text
         LIMIT 1) AS family_profile_limit,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM membership_entitlements me
          WHERE me.membership_id = cm.id AND me.status = 'active'::text) AS entitlement_count,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM referral_profiles rp
          WHERE rp.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND rp.status = 'active'::text)) AS ambassador_center_enabled
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_memberships cm ON cm.id = ca.membership_id
     JOIN program_catalog pc ON pc.program_code = cm.program_code
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.status = 'active'::text AND cm.status = 'active'::text
 LIMIT 1;

views.name: my_course_progress_summary
views.definition:
SELECT cce.id AS enrollment_id,
    cce.course_id,
    lc.title AS course_title,
    cce.status,
    cce.progress_percent,
    cce.started_at,
    cce.completed_at,
    count(ll.id) FILTER (WHERE ll.requires_completion AND ll.status = 'published'::text) AS required_lessons,
    count(lp.id) FILTER (WHERE lp.status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_lessons,
    max(lp.last_activity_at) AS last_lesson_activity_at
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_course_enrollments cce ON cce.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     JOIN learning_courses lc ON lc.id = cce.course_id
     LEFT JOIN learning_modules lm ON lm.course_id = lc.id AND lm.active
     LEFT JOIN learning_lessons ll ON ll.module_id = lm.id AND ll.status = 'published'::text
     LEFT JOIN lesson_progress lp ON lp.enrollment_id = cce.id AND lp.lesson_id = ll.id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND cce.status <> 'cancelled'::text
  GROUP BY cce.id, cce.course_id, lc.title, cce.status, cce.progress_percent, cce.started_at, cce.completed_at
  ORDER BY (
        CASE cce.status
            WHEN 'active'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'paused'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'completed'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), lc.title;

views.name: my_assignment_summary
views.definition:
SELECT ca.user_id,
    ca.contact_id,
    count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'assigned'::text) AS assigned_count,
    count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'in_progress'::text) AS in_progress_count,
    count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_count,
    count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['assigned'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AND a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.due_at < now()) AS overdue_count,
    count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['assigned'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AND a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.due_at >= now() AND a.due_at < (now() + '7 days'::interval)) AS due_next_7_days,
    min(a.due_at) FILTER (WHERE (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['assigned'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AND a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.due_at >= now()) AS next_due_at
   FROM client_access ca
     LEFT JOIN client_assignments a ON a.contact_id = ca.contact_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  GROUP BY ca.user_id, ca.contact_id;

views.name: my_coaching_requests
views.definition:
SELECT ja.id AS appointment_id,
    ja.status,
    ja.requested_availability,
    ja.client_notes,
    ja.scheduled_start,
    ja.scheduled_end,
    ja.time_zone,
    ja.format,
    ja.location_url,
    ja.assigned_to,
    sd.display_name AS assigned_coach_name,
    ja.created_at,
    ja.updated_at
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN journey_appointments ja ON ja.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = ja.assigned_to
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ja.appointment_type = 'coaching_session'::text
  ORDER BY ja.created_at DESC;

views.name: my_message_threads
views.definition:
SELECT conversation_id,
    conversation_type,
    title,
    status,
    last_message_at,
    last_read_at,
    unread_count,
    last_message_preview,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('message_id', m.id, 'sender_user_id', m.sender_user_id, 'sender_contact_id', m.sender_contact_id, 'body', m.body, 'message_type', m.message_type, 'created_at', m.created_at, 'edited_at', m.edited_at) ORDER BY m.created_at) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT mm.id,
                    mm.conversation_id,
                    mm.sender_user_id,
                    mm.sender_contact_id,
                    mm.body,
                    mm.message_type,
                    mm.edited_at,
                    mm.deleted_at,
                    mm.metadata,
                    mm.created_at
                   FROM member_messages mm
                  WHERE mm.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND mm.deleted_at IS NULL
                  ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 50) m), '[]'::jsonb) AS messages
   FROM my_conversations c;

views.name: my_weekly_summary
views.definition:
SELECT user_id,
    contact_id,
    CURRENT_DATE - 6 AS period_start,
    CURRENT_DATE AS period_end,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM habit_checkins hc
          WHERE hc.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND hc.checkin_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND hc.checkin_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS habit_checkins,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT hc.checkin_date) AS count
           FROM habit_checkins hc
          WHERE hc.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND hc.checkin_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND hc.checkin_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS active_habit_days,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_workout_assignments wa
          WHERE wa.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND wa.status = 'completed'::text AND wa.scheduled_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND wa.scheduled_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS workouts_completed,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_meal_plan_items mi
          WHERE mi.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND mi.status = 'completed'::text AND mi.scheduled_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND mi.scheduled_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS meals_completed,
    ( SELECT round(avg(mi.adherence_percent), 1) AS round
           FROM client_meal_plan_items mi
          WHERE mi.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND mi.adherence_percent IS NOT NULL AND mi.scheduled_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND mi.scheduled_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS meal_adherence,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM progress_entries pe
          WHERE pe.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND pe.recorded_at::date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND pe.recorded_at::date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS progress_entries,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_goals g
          WHERE g.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND g.status = 'completed'::text AND g.completed_at::date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND g.completed_at::date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS goals_completed,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
          WHERE ce.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND ce.status = 'completed'::text AND ce.completed_at::date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND ce.completed_at::date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS challenges_completed,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(ce.points_earned), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
          WHERE ce.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND ce.completed_at::date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND ce.completed_at::date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS challenge_points_earned,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_course_enrollments cce
          WHERE cce.contact_id = ca.contact_id AND cce.status = 'completed'::text AND cce.completed_at::date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND cce.completed_at::date <= CURRENT_DATE) AS courses_completed
   FROM client_access ca
  WHERE user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
 LIMIT 1;

views.name: my_activity_timeline
views.definition:
SELECT occurred_at,
    activity_type,
    title,
    detail,
    activity_key,
    source_type,
    source_id
   FROM ( SELECT mn.created_at AS occurred_at,
            'notification'::text AS activity_type,
            mn.title,
            mn.body AS detail,
            mn.notification_type AS activity_key,
            'notification'::text AS source_type,
            mn.id AS source_id
           FROM my_notifications mn
        UNION ALL
         SELECT g.completed_at AS occurred_at,
            'goal_completed'::text AS activity_type,
            g.title,
            'Goal completed'::text AS detail,
            g.goal_key AS activity_key,
            'goal'::text AS source_type,
            g.id AS source_id
           FROM my_goals g
          WHERE g.status = 'completed'::text AND g.completed_at IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT cce.completed_at AS occurred_at,
            'course_completed'::text AS activity_type,
            lc.title,
            'Course completed'::text AS detail,
            NULL::text AS activity_key,
            'course'::text AS source_type,
            cce.course_id AS source_id
           FROM client_access ca
             JOIN client_course_enrollments cce ON cce.contact_id = ca.contact_id
             JOIN learning_courses lc ON lc.id = cce.course_id
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND cce.status = 'completed'::text AND cce.completed_at IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ce.completed_at AS occurred_at,
            'challenge_completed'::text AS activity_type,
            wc.title,
            ('Challenge completed · '::text || ce.points_earned::text) || ' points'::text AS detail,
            wc.challenge_key AS activity_key,
            'challenge'::text AS source_type,
            ce.challenge_id AS source_id
           FROM client_access ca
             JOIN challenge_enrollments ce ON ce.contact_id = ca.contact_id
             JOIN wellness_challenges wc ON wc.id = ce.challenge_id
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ce.status = 'completed'::text AND ce.completed_at IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT pe.recorded_at AS occurred_at,
            'progress_logged'::text AS activity_type,
            pmc.label AS title,
                CASE
                    WHEN pe.value_numeric IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(BOTH FROM to_char(pe.value_numeric, 'FM999999990.99'::text)) ||
                    CASE
                        WHEN pmc.unit IS NOT NULL THEN ' '::text || pmc.unit
                        ELSE ''::text
                    END
                    WHEN pe.value_boolean IS NOT NULL THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN pe.value_boolean THEN 'Yes'::text
                        ELSE 'No'::text
                    END
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS detail,
            pe.metric_key AS activity_key,
            'progress'::text AS source_type,
            pe.id AS source_id
           FROM client_access ca
             JOIN progress_entries pe ON pe.contact_id = ca.contact_id
             JOIN progress_metric_catalog pmc ON pmc.metric_key = pe.metric_key
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))) activity
  WHERE occurred_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY occurred_at DESC;

views.name: my_coaching_hub
views.definition:
SELECT ca.user_id,
    ca.contact_id,
    ca.membership_id,
    cm.program_code,
    pc.name AS program_name,
    cm.assigned_coach_id,
    sd.display_name AS assigned_coach_name,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(a.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_member_upcoming_appointment a
         LIMIT 1) AS next_appointment,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(s.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_assignment_summary s
         LIMIT 1) AS assignment_summary,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a.*) ORDER BY (
                CASE a.status
                    WHEN 'assigned'::text THEN 1
                    WHEN 'in_progress'::text THEN 2
                    ELSE 3
                END), a.due_at, a.created_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_client_assignments.id,
                    my_client_assignments.title,
                    my_client_assignments.instructions,
                    my_client_assignments.assignment_type,
                    my_client_assignments.due_at,
                    my_client_assignments.status,
                    my_client_assignments.completed_at,
                    my_client_assignments.member_note,
                    my_client_assignments.created_at,
                    my_client_assignments.assigned_by_name
                   FROM my_client_assignments
                  WHERE my_client_assignments.status = ANY (ARRAY['assigned'::text, 'in_progress'::text])
                  ORDER BY (
                        CASE my_client_assignments.status
                            WHEN 'assigned'::text THEN 1
                            WHEN 'in_progress'::text THEN 2
                            ELSE 3
                        END), my_client_assignments.due_at, my_client_assignments.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 8) a), '[]'::jsonb) AS current_assignments,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cs.*) ORDER BY cs.scheduled_start DESC NULLS LAST) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_coaching_sessions.session_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.contact_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.membership_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.coach_user_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.coach_name,
                    my_coaching_sessions.appointment_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.session_number,
                    my_coaching_sessions.status,
                    my_coaching_sessions.scheduled_start,
                    my_coaching_sessions.scheduled_end,
                    my_coaching_sessions.format,
                    my_coaching_sessions.location_url,
                    my_coaching_sessions.client_agenda,
                    my_coaching_sessions.completed_at,
                    my_coaching_sessions.created_at
                   FROM my_coaching_sessions
                  ORDER BY my_coaching_sessions.scheduled_start DESC NULLS LAST
                 LIMIT 6) cs), '[]'::jsonb) AS recent_sessions,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(mt.*) ORDER BY mt.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_conversations.conversation_id,
                    my_conversations.conversation_type,
                    my_conversations.title,
                    my_conversations.status,
                    my_conversations.last_message_at,
                    my_conversations.last_read_at,
                    my_conversations.unread_count,
                    my_conversations.last_message_preview
                   FROM my_conversations
                  ORDER BY my_conversations.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST
                 LIMIT 6) mt), '[]'::jsonb) AS conversations,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(mc.unread_count), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM my_conversations mc) AS unread_messages,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM my_coaching_entitlements ce) AS coaching_entitlement_count
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN client_memberships cm ON cm.id = ca.membership_id
     JOIN program_catalog pc ON pc.program_code = cm.program_code
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = cm.assigned_coach_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
 LIMIT 1;

views.name: my_ambassador_center
views.definition:
SELECT ca.user_id,
    ca.contact_id,
    rp.referral_code,
    rp.status AS referral_profile_status,
    rp.display_name,
    count(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_referrals,
    count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'converted'::text) AS converted_referrals,
    count(DISTINCT rr.id) FILTER (WHERE rr.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text])) AS pending_rewards,
    count(DISTINCT rr.id) FILTER (WHERE rr.status = 'issued'::text) AS issued_rewards,
    COALESCE(sum(rr.reward_value) FILTER (WHERE rr.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text])), 0::numeric) AS pending_reward_value,
    COALESCE(sum(rr.reward_value) FILTER (WHERE rr.status = 'issued'::text), 0::numeric) AS issued_reward_value,
    max(rr.currency) FILTER (WHERE rr.reward_value IS NOT NULL) AS reward_currency,
    count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'referred'::text) AS referred_count,
    count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'engaged'::text) AS engaged_count,
    count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'applicant'::text) AS applicant_count,
    count(DISTINCT rr.id) FILTER (WHERE rr.status = 'approved'::text) AS approved_reward_count,
        CASE
            WHEN rp.referral_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'https://revitalizedacademy.com/enroll?ref='::text || rp.referral_code
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS share_url,
        CASE
            WHEN rp.referral_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'I wanted to share ReVitalized Academy with you. You can learn more and get started here: https://revitalizedacademy.com/enroll?ref='::text || rp.referral_code
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS share_message
   FROM client_access ca
     LEFT JOIN referral_profiles rp ON rp.contact_id = ca.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN referrals r ON r.referrer_contact_id = ca.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN referral_rewards rr ON rr.referrer_contact_id = ca.contact_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  GROUP BY ca.user_id, ca.contact_id, rp.referral_code, rp.status, rp.display_name;

views.name: my_referral_activity
views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS referral_id,
    r.status,
    r.source_channel,
    r.first_touch_at,
    r.converted_at,
    c.first_name AS referred_first_name,
        CASE
            WHEN c.last_name IS NULL OR TRIM(BOTH FROM c.last_name) = ''::text THEN NULL::text
            ELSE "left"(c.last_name, 1) || '.'::text
        END AS referred_last_initial,
    rr.status AS reward_status,
    rr.reward_type,
    rr.reward_value,
    rr.currency,
    rr.approved_at,
    rr.issued_at
   FROM client_access ca
     JOIN referrals r ON r.referrer_contact_id = ca.contact_id
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = r.referred_contact_id
     LEFT JOIN referral_rewards rr ON rr.referral_id = r.id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  ORDER BY r.first_touch_at DESC;

views.name: my_app_bootstrap
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT to_jsonb(h.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_app_home h
         LIMIT 1) AS home,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(a.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_app_access a
         LIMIT 1) AS access,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(c.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_coach c
         LIMIT 1) AS coach,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(ap.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_member_upcoming_appointment ap
         LIMIT 1) AS upcoming_appointment,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(b.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_billing_summary b
         LIMIT 1) AS billing,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ag.*) ORDER BY ag.sent_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_agreements ag), '[]'::jsonb) AS agreements,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(f.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_family_hub_summary f
         LIMIT 1) AS family_hub,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(a.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_ambassador_center a
         LIMIT 1) AS ambassador,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n.*) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_notifications.id,
                    my_notifications.notification_type,
                    my_notifications.title,
                    my_notifications.body,
                    my_notifications.link_url,
                    my_notifications.status,
                    my_notifications.created_at,
                    my_notifications.read_at
                   FROM my_notifications
                  ORDER BY my_notifications.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 10) n), '[]'::jsonb) AS recent_notifications,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c.*) ORDER BY c.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_courses.enrollment_id,
                    my_courses.course_id,
                    my_courses.title,
                    my_courses.description,
                    my_courses.estimated_minutes,
                    my_courses.thumbnail_url,
                    my_courses.status,
                    my_courses.progress_percent,
                    my_courses.last_lesson_id,
                    my_courses.last_activity_at,
                    my_courses.started_at,
                    my_courses.completed_at
                   FROM my_courses
                  ORDER BY my_courses.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST, my_courses.title
                 LIMIT 5) c), '[]'::jsonb) AS courses,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r.*) ORDER BY r.category, r.title) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_resources.resource_id,
                    my_resources.title,
                    my_resources.description,
                    my_resources.resource_type,
                    my_resources.resource_url,
                    my_resources.category,
                    my_resources.tags,
                    my_resources.assignment_status,
                    my_resources.assignment_note
                   FROM my_resources
                  ORDER BY my_resources.category, my_resources.title
                 LIMIT 8) r), '[]'::jsonb) AS resources,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(np.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_notification_preferences np
         LIMIT 1) AS notification_preferences,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cs.*) ORDER BY cs.scheduled_start DESC NULLS LAST) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_coaching_sessions.session_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.contact_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.membership_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.coach_user_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.coach_name,
                    my_coaching_sessions.appointment_id,
                    my_coaching_sessions.session_number,
                    my_coaching_sessions.status,
                    my_coaching_sessions.scheduled_start,
                    my_coaching_sessions.scheduled_end,
                    my_coaching_sessions.format,
                    my_coaching_sessions.location_url,
                    my_coaching_sessions.client_agenda,
                    my_coaching_sessions.completed_at,
                    my_coaching_sessions.created_at
                   FROM my_coaching_sessions
                  ORDER BY my_coaching_sessions.scheduled_start DESC NULLS LAST
                 LIMIT 8) cs), '[]'::jsonb) AS coaching_sessions,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i.*) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_invoices.invoice_id,
                    my_invoices.invoice_number,
                    my_invoices.status,
                    my_invoices.amount_due_cents,
                    my_invoices.amount_paid_cents,
                    my_invoices.currency,
                    my_invoices.due_at,
                    my_invoices.paid_at,
                    my_invoices.hosted_invoice_url,
                    my_invoices.created_at
                   FROM my_invoices
                  ORDER BY my_invoices.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 8) i), '[]'::jsonb) AS invoices,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ph.*) ORDER BY ph.occurred_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_payment_history.event_id,
                    my_payment_history.event_type,
                    my_payment_history.provider,
                    my_payment_history.amount_cents,
                    my_payment_history.currency,
                    my_payment_history.status,
                    my_payment_history.occurred_at
                   FROM my_payment_history
                  ORDER BY my_payment_history.occurred_at DESC
                 LIMIT 10) ph), '[]'::jsonb) AS payment_history,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(dac.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_daily_action_center dac
         LIMIT 1) AS daily_actions,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(ps.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_progress_snapshot ps
         LIMIT 1) AS progress_snapshot,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cps.*) ORDER BY cps.course_title) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_course_progress_summary cps), '[]'::jsonb) AS course_progress,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(ws.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_weekly_summary ws
         LIMIT 1) AS weekly_summary,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(at.*) ORDER BY at.occurred_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_activity_timeline.occurred_at,
                    my_activity_timeline.activity_type,
                    my_activity_timeline.title,
                    my_activity_timeline.detail,
                    my_activity_timeline.activity_key,
                    my_activity_timeline.source_type,
                    my_activity_timeline.source_id
                   FROM my_activity_timeline
                  ORDER BY my_activity_timeline.occurred_at DESC
                 LIMIT 25) at), '[]'::jsonb) AS activity_timeline,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(ch.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_coaching_hub ch
         LIMIT 1) AS coaching_hub,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(asum.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_assignment_summary asum
         LIMIT 1) AS assignment_summary,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(mt.*) ORDER BY mt.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_message_threads.conversation_id,
                    my_message_threads.conversation_type,
                    my_message_threads.title,
                    my_message_threads.status,
                    my_message_threads.last_message_at,
                    my_message_threads.last_read_at,
                    my_message_threads.unread_count,
                    my_message_threads.last_message_preview,
                    my_message_threads.messages
                   FROM my_message_threads
                  ORDER BY my_message_threads.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST
                 LIMIT 6) mt), '[]'::jsonb) AS message_threads,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cr.*) ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_coaching_requests.appointment_id,
                    my_coaching_requests.status,
                    my_coaching_requests.requested_availability,
                    my_coaching_requests.client_notes,
                    my_coaching_requests.scheduled_start,
                    my_coaching_requests.scheduled_end,
                    my_coaching_requests.time_zone,
                    my_coaching_requests.format,
                    my_coaching_requests.location_url,
                    my_coaching_requests.assigned_to,
                    my_coaching_requests.assigned_coach_name,
                    my_coaching_requests.created_at,
                    my_coaching_requests.updated_at
                   FROM my_coaching_requests
                  ORDER BY my_coaching_requests.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 6) cr), '[]'::jsonb) AS coaching_requests,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ra.*) ORDER BY ra.first_touch_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_referral_activity.referral_id,
                    my_referral_activity.status,
                    my_referral_activity.source_channel,
                    my_referral_activity.first_touch_at,
                    my_referral_activity.converted_at,
                    my_referral_activity.referred_first_name,
                    my_referral_activity.referred_last_initial,
                    my_referral_activity.reward_status,
                    my_referral_activity.reward_type,
                    my_referral_activity.reward_value,
                    my_referral_activity.currency,
                    my_referral_activity.approved_at,
                    my_referral_activity.issued_at
                   FROM my_referral_activity
                  ORDER BY my_referral_activity.first_touch_at DESC
                 LIMIT 20) ra), '[]'::jsonb) AS referral_activity,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(fr.*) ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT my_family_requests.request_id,
                    my_family_requests.request_type,
                    my_family_requests.target_household_member_id,
                    my_family_requests.first_name,
                    my_family_requests.last_name,
                    my_family_requests.relationship_type,
                    my_family_requests.sex,
                    my_family_requests.date_of_birth,
                    my_family_requests.email,
                    my_family_requests.notes,
                    my_family_requests.status,
                    my_family_requests.staff_notes,
                    my_family_requests.reviewed_at,
                    my_family_requests.created_at,
                    my_family_requests.updated_at
                   FROM my_family_requests
                  ORDER BY my_family_requests.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 10) fr), '[]'::jsonb) AS family_requests;

views.name: my_family_requests
views.definition:
SELECT id AS request_id,
    request_type,
    target_household_member_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    relationship_type,
    sex,
    date_of_birth,
    email,
    notes,
    status,
    staff_notes,
    reviewed_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM family_change_requests fcr
  WHERE user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  ORDER BY created_at DESC;

views.name: admin_family_requests
views.definition:
SELECT fcr.id AS request_id,
    fcr.contact_id,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name)) AS member_name,
    c.email AS member_email,
    fcr.household_id,
    h.household_name,
    fcr.membership_id,
    cm.program_code,
    pc.name AS program_name,
    fcr.request_type,
    fcr.target_household_member_id,
    fcr.first_name,
    fcr.last_name,
    fcr.relationship_type,
    fcr.sex,
    fcr.date_of_birth,
    fcr.email,
    fcr.notes,
    fcr.status,
    fcr.staff_notes,
    fcr.reviewed_by,
    sa.display_name AS reviewed_by_name,
    fcr.reviewed_at,
    fcr.created_at,
    fcr.updated_at
   FROM family_change_requests fcr
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = fcr.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN households h ON h.id = fcr.household_id
     LEFT JOIN client_memberships cm ON cm.id = fcr.membership_id
     LEFT JOIN program_catalog pc ON pc.program_code = cm.program_code
     LEFT JOIN staff_access sa ON sa.user_id = fcr.reviewed_by
  WHERE ( SELECT private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'crm.view'::text) AS staff_has_permission) AND private.staff_can_access_contact(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), fcr.contact_id)
  ORDER BY (
        CASE fcr.status
            WHEN 'submitted'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'in_review'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'approved'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'completed'::text THEN 4
            WHEN 'declined'::text THEN 5
            ELSE 6
        END), fcr.created_at;

views.name: my_companion_question_types
views.definition:
SELECT question_type,
    label,
    description,
    handling_mode,
    requires_coach_assignment,
    sort_order
   FROM coach_companion_question_types qt
  WHERE active AND member_visible
  ORDER BY sort_order, label;

views.name: my_companion_requests
views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS request_id,
    r.question_type,
    qt.label AS question_type_label,
    r.question,
    r.handling_mode,
    r.status,
    r.final_answer,
    r.escalation_reason,
    r.assigned_coach_id,
    sd.display_name AS assigned_coach_name,
    r.answered_by_type,
    r.created_at,
    r.answered_at,
    r.updated_at
   FROM coach_companion_requests r
     LEFT JOIN coach_companion_question_types qt ON qt.question_type = r.question_type
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = r.assigned_coach_id
  WHERE r.requested_by_user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;

views.name: my_companion_summary
views.definition:
SELECT ca.user_id,
    ca.contact_id,
    ca.membership_id,
    count(r.id) AS total_questions,
    count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'retrieving'::text, 'draft_ready'::text])) AS processing_count,
    count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = ANY (ARRAY['coach_review'::text, 'escalated'::text])) AS coach_review_count,
    count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = ANY (ARRAY['answered'::text, 'resolved'::text])) AS answered_count,
    max(r.created_at) AS last_question_at,
    max(r.answered_at) AS last_answered_at
   FROM client_access ca
     LEFT JOIN coach_companion_requests r ON r.requested_by_user_id = ca.user_id
  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  GROUP BY ca.user_id, ca.contact_id, ca.membership_id;

views.name: my_health_data_snapshot
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.metric_key) o.metric_key,
    COALESCE(m.label, o.metric_key) AS label,
    m.category,
    o.value_numeric,
    o.value_boolean,
    COALESCE(o.unit, m.unit) AS unit,
    o.observed_at,
    o.provider_key,
    p.name AS provider_name
   FROM health_observations o
     LEFT JOIN health_metric_catalog m ON m.metric_key = o.metric_key
     LEFT JOIN health_integration_providers p ON p.provider_key = o.provider_key
  WHERE (o.contact_id IN ( SELECT ca.contact_id
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.status = 'active'::text))
  ORDER BY o.metric_key, o.observed_at DESC;

views.name: my_member_profile
views.definition:
SELECT p.user_id,
    c.id AS contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    c.phone,
    c.city,
    c.state,
    c.country,
    c.updated_at
   FROM profiles p
     JOIN contacts c ON c.id = p.contact_id
  WHERE p.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid));

views.name: my_app_bootstrap_v2
views.definition:
SELECT home,
    access,
    coach,
    upcoming_appointment,
    billing,
    agreements,
    family_hub,
    ambassador,
    recent_notifications,
    courses,
    resources,
    notification_preferences,
    coaching_sessions,
    invoices,
    payment_history,
    daily_actions,
    progress_snapshot,
    course_progress,
    weekly_summary,
    activity_timeline,
    coaching_hub,
    assignment_summary,
    message_threads,
    coaching_requests,
    referral_activity,
    family_requests,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(mp.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_member_profile mp
         LIMIT 1) AS member_profile,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(js.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_journey_status js
         LIMIT 1) AS journey_status,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(cs.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_companion_summary cs
         LIMIT 1) AS companion_summary,
    ( SELECT to_jsonb(mo.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM my_membership_overview mo
         LIMIT 1) AS membership_overview
   FROM my_app_bootstrap b;

views.name: my_health_metric_timeline
views.definition:
SELECT ho.contact_id,
    ho.membership_id,
    ho.metric_key,
    hmc.label AS metric_label,
    hmc.category,
    COALESCE(ho.unit, hmc.unit) AS unit,
    ho.value_numeric,
    ho.value_boolean,
    ho.observed_at AS recorded_at,
    'wearable'::text AS origin,
    ho.provider_key AS source_key,
    ho.connection_id,
    ho.metadata
   FROM health_observations ho
     LEFT JOIN health_metric_catalog hmc ON hmc.metric_key = ho.metric_key
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.contact_id = ho.contact_id AND ca.status = 'active'::text))
UNION ALL
 SELECT pe.contact_id,
    pe.membership_id,
    pe.metric_key,
    pmc.label AS metric_label,
    pmc.category,
    pmc.unit,
    pe.value_numeric,
    pe.value_boolean,
    pe.recorded_at,
    'manual'::text AS origin,
    pe.source AS source_key,
    NULL::uuid AS connection_id,
    pe.metadata
   FROM progress_entries pe
     LEFT JOIN progress_metric_catalog pmc ON pmc.metric_key = pe.metric_key
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.contact_id = pe.contact_id AND ca.status = 'active'::text));

views.name: my_health_metric_permissions
views.definition:
SELECT p.provider_key,
    p.name AS provider_name,
    p.provider_type,
    p.connection_mode,
    m.metric_key,
    m.label,
    m.category,
    m.unit,
    m.coaching_use,
    m.display_order,
    COALESCE(c.allowed, false) AS allowed,
    c.consented_at,
    c.revoked_at
   FROM health_integration_providers p
     JOIN health_metric_catalog m ON p.supported_metrics ? m.metric_key
     LEFT JOIN health_metric_consents c ON c.provider_key = p.provider_key AND c.metric_key = m.metric_key AND c.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
  WHERE p.active = true AND m.active = true;

views.name: my_app_bootstrap_v3
views.definition:
SELECT home,
    access,
    coach,
    upcoming_appointment,
    billing,
    agreements,
    family_hub,
    ambassador,
    recent_notifications,
    courses,
    resources,
    notification_preferences,
    coaching_sessions,
    invoices,
    payment_history,
    daily_actions,
    progress_snapshot,
    course_progress,
    weekly_summary,
    activity_timeline,
    coaching_hub,
    assignment_summary,
    message_threads,
    coaching_requests,
    referral_activity,
    family_requests,
    member_profile,
    journey_status,
    companion_summary,
    membership_overview,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(hc.*) ORDER BY hc.provider_name) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_health_connection_center hc), '[]'::jsonb) AS health_connections,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(hp.*) ORDER BY hp.display_order, hp.provider_name) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_health_metric_permissions hp), '[]'::jsonb) AS health_permissions,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(hs.*) ORDER BY hs.metric_key) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_health_data_snapshot hs), '[]'::jsonb) AS wearable_health_snapshot,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(hd.*) ORDER BY hd.category, hd.metric_key) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM my_health_dashboard_cards_30d hd), '[]'::jsonb) AS health_dashboard_cards
   FROM my_app_bootstrap_v2 b;

views.name: my_health_connection_center
views.definition:
SELECT p.provider_key,
    p.name AS provider_name,
    p.provider_type,
    p.connection_mode,
    p.supported_metrics,
    hc.id AS connection_id,
    COALESCE(hc.status, 'not_connected'::text) AS status,
    hc.connected_at,
    hc.last_sync_at,
    hc.last_successful_sync_at,
    hc.last_error,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
           FROM health_metric_consents c
          WHERE c.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND c.provider_key = p.provider_key AND c.allowed = true), 0) AS allowed_metric_count
   FROM health_integration_providers p
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.id,
            h.contact_id,
            h.membership_id,
            h.user_id,
            h.provider_key,
            h.status,
            h.external_account_reference,
            h.credential_reference,
            h.granted_scopes,
            h.connected_at,
            h.last_sync_at,
            h.last_successful_sync_at,
            h.last_error,
            h.sync_cursor,
            h.metadata,
            h.created_at,
            h.updated_at
           FROM health_integration_connections h
          WHERE h.provider_key = p.provider_key AND (h.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (h.contact_id IN ( SELECT ca.contact_id
                   FROM client_access ca
                  WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

views.name: my_health_dashboard_cards_30d
views.definition:
WITH ranked AS (
         SELECT t.contact_id,
            t.membership_id,
            t.metric_key,
            t.metric_label,
            t.category,
            t.unit,
            t.value_numeric,
            t.value_boolean,
            t.recorded_at,
            t.origin,
            t.source_key,
            t.connection_id,
            t.metadata,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.contact_id, t.metric_key ORDER BY t.recorded_at DESC, t.origin) AS rn_latest,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.contact_id, t.metric_key ORDER BY t.recorded_at, t.origin) AS rn_earliest
           FROM my_health_metric_timeline t
          WHERE t.value_numeric IS NOT NULL AND t.recorded_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)
        ), agg AS (
         SELECT ranked.contact_id,
            ranked.metric_key,
            max(ranked.metric_label) AS metric_label,
            max(ranked.category) AS category,
            max(ranked.unit) AS unit,
            max(ranked.value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE ranked.rn_latest = 1) AS current_value,
            max(ranked.recorded_at) FILTER (WHERE ranked.rn_latest = 1) AS current_recorded_at,
            max(ranked.value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE ranked.rn_earliest = 1) AS baseline_value,
            max(ranked.recorded_at) FILTER (WHERE ranked.rn_earliest = 1) AS baseline_recorded_at
           FROM ranked
          GROUP BY ranked.contact_id, ranked.metric_key
        )
 SELECT contact_id,
    metric_key,
    metric_label,
    category,
    unit,
    current_value,
    current_recorded_at,
    baseline_value,
    baseline_recorded_at,
    current_value - baseline_value AS absolute_change,
        CASE
            WHEN baseline_value IS NULL OR baseline_value = 0::numeric THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round((current_value - baseline_value) / abs(baseline_value) * 100::numeric, 2)
        END AS percent_change_30d
   FROM agg;

views.name: my_goal_progress
views.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.contact_id, t.metric_key) t.contact_id,
            t.metric_key,
            t.value_numeric,
            t.recorded_at,
            t.unit
           FROM my_health_metric_timeline t
          WHERE t.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY t.contact_id, t.metric_key, t.recorded_at DESC
        )
 SELECT g.id AS goal_id,
    g.contact_id,
    g.household_id,
    g.membership_id,
    g.scope,
    g.goal_key,
    g.title,
    g.description,
    g.baseline_value,
    g.target_value,
    g.target_unit,
    g.target_date,
    g.priority,
    g.status,
    l.value_numeric AS current_value,
    l.recorded_at AS current_recorded_at,
        CASE
            WHEN g.baseline_value IS NULL OR g.target_value IS NULL OR g.target_value = g.baseline_value OR l.value_numeric IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(GREATEST(0::numeric, LEAST(100::numeric, (l.value_numeric - g.baseline_value) / (g.target_value - g.baseline_value) * 100::numeric)), 1)
        END AS completion_percent,
        CASE
            WHEN g.status = 'completed'::text THEN 'completed'::text
            WHEN g.target_date IS NOT NULL AND g.target_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'past_due'::text
            WHEN l.value_numeric IS NULL THEN 'awaiting_data'::text
            ELSE 'in_progress'::text
        END AS progress_state
   FROM client_goals g
     LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.contact_id = g.contact_id AND l.metric_key = g.goal_key
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.contact_id = g.contact_id AND ca.status = 'active'::text))
  ORDER BY (
        CASE g.status
            WHEN 'active'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'paused'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'completed'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), g.priority, g.created_at DESC;

views.name: my_progress_insights
views.definition:
SELECT contact_id,
    metric_key,
    metric_label,
    category,
    unit,
    current_value,
    current_recorded_at,
    baseline_value,
    baseline_recorded_at,
    absolute_change,
    percent_change_30d,
        CASE
            WHEN absolute_change IS NULL THEN 'insufficient_data'::text
            WHEN absolute_change > 0::numeric THEN 'up'::text
            WHEN absolute_change < 0::numeric THEN 'down'::text
            ELSE 'stable'::text
        END AS direction,
        CASE
            WHEN absolute_change IS NULL THEN 'More data is needed to show a 30-day trend.'::text
            WHEN absolute_change > 0::numeric THEN (((metric_label || ' is up '::text) || TRIM(BOTH FROM to_char(abs(absolute_change), 'FM999999990.99'::text))) ||
            CASE
                WHEN unit IS NOT NULL THEN ' '::text || unit
                ELSE ''::text
            END) || ' across the available 30-day comparison.'::text
            WHEN absolute_change < 0::numeric THEN (((metric_label || ' is down '::text) || TRIM(BOTH FROM to_char(abs(absolute_change), 'FM999999990.99'::text))) ||
            CASE
                WHEN unit IS NOT NULL THEN ' '::text || unit
                ELSE ''::text
            END) || ' across the available 30-day comparison.'::text
            ELSE metric_label || ' is unchanged across the available 30-day comparison.'::text
        END AS insight_text
   FROM my_health_dashboard_cards_30d hd;

views.name: my_daily_plan_history_30d
views.definition:
WITH me AS (
         SELECT ca.contact_id
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.status = 'active'::text
          ORDER BY ca.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1
        ), days AS (
         SELECT generate_series((CURRENT_DATE - 29)::timestamp with time zone, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval)::date AS action_date
        ), habit_daily AS (
         SELECT d_1.action_date,
            count(h_1.id)::integer AS assigned,
            count(h_1.id) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(hc.value, 0::numeric) >= h_1.target_per_period)::integer AS completed
           FROM days d_1
             CROSS JOIN me
             LEFT JOIN client_habits h_1 ON h_1.contact_id = me.contact_id AND h_1.status = 'active'::text AND h_1.starts_on <= d_1.action_date AND (h_1.ends_on IS NULL OR h_1.ends_on >= d_1.action_date)
             LEFT JOIN habit_checkins hc ON hc.habit_id = h_1.id AND hc.contact_id = me.contact_id AND hc.checkin_date = d_1.action_date
          GROUP BY d_1.action_date
        ), meal_daily AS (
         SELECT d_1.action_date,
            count(mi.id)::integer AS assigned,
            count(mi.id) FILTER (WHERE mi.status = 'completed'::text)::integer AS completed
           FROM days d_1
             CROSS JOIN me
             LEFT JOIN client_meal_plan_items mi ON mi.contact_id = me.contact_id AND mi.scheduled_date = d_1.action_date
          GROUP BY d_1.action_date
        ), workout_daily AS (
         SELECT d_1.action_date,
            count(wa.id)::integer AS assigned,
            count(wa.id) FILTER (WHERE wa.status = 'completed'::text)::integer AS completed
           FROM days d_1
             CROSS JOIN me
             LEFT JOIN client_workout_assignments wa ON wa.contact_id = me.contact_id AND wa.scheduled_date = d_1.action_date
          GROUP BY d_1.action_date
        )
 SELECT d.action_date,
    COALESCE(h.assigned, 0) AS habits_assigned,
    COALESCE(h.completed, 0) AS habits_completed,
    COALESCE(m.assigned, 0) AS meals_assigned,
    COALESCE(m.completed, 0) AS meals_completed,
    COALESCE(w.assigned, 0) AS workouts_assigned,
    COALESCE(w.completed, 0) AS workouts_completed,
    COALESCE(h.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(m.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(w.assigned, 0) AS total_actions,
    COALESCE(h.completed, 0) + COALESCE(m.completed, 0) + COALESCE(w.completed, 0) AS completed_actions,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(h.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(m.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(w.assigned, 0)) = 0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round((COALESCE(h.completed, 0) + COALESCE(m.completed, 0) + COALESCE(w.completed, 0))::numeric / (COALESCE(h.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(m.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(w.assigned, 0))::numeric * 100::numeric, 1)
        END AS completion_percent,
    (COALESCE(h.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(m.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(w.assigned, 0)) > 0 AND (COALESCE(h.completed, 0) + COALESCE(m.completed, 0) + COALESCE(w.completed, 0)) >= (COALESCE(h.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(m.assigned, 0) + COALESCE(w.assigned, 0)) AS fully_completed
   FROM days d
     LEFT JOIN habit_daily h ON h.action_date = d.action_date
     LEFT JOIN meal_daily m ON m.action_date = d.action_date
     LEFT JOIN workout_daily w ON w.action_date = d.action_date
  ORDER BY d.action_date;

views.name: my_family_progress_dashboard
views.definition:
WITH access_rows AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ca.user_id,
            ca.household_id
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.status = 'active'::text AND ca.household_id IS NOT NULL
        ), family_members AS (
         SELECT hm.household_id,
            hm.id AS household_member_id,
            hm.contact_id,
            hm.relationship_type,
            hm.is_primary,
            hm.date_of_birth,
            c.first_name,
            c.last_name
           FROM household_members hm
             JOIN access_rows ar ON ar.household_id = hm.household_id
             JOIN contacts c ON c.id = hm.contact_id
          WHERE hm.status = 'active'::text
        ), latest_score AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (ws.contact_id, ws.score_type) ws.contact_id,
            ws.score_type,
            ws.score,
            ws.methodology_version,
            ws.calculated_at
           FROM wellness_score_snapshots ws
             JOIN family_members fm_1 ON fm_1.contact_id = ws.contact_id
          ORDER BY ws.contact_id, ws.score_type, ws.calculated_at DESC
        ), achievement_counts AS (
         SELECT ma.contact_id,
            count(*)::integer AS achievement_count,
            max(ma.unlocked_at) AS latest_achievement_at
           FROM member_achievements ma
             JOIN family_members fm_1 ON fm_1.contact_id = ma.contact_id
          GROUP BY ma.contact_id
        ), goal_counts AS (
         SELECT g.contact_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.status = 'active'::text)::integer AS active_goals,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.status = 'completed'::text)::integer AS completed_goals
           FROM client_goals g
             JOIN family_members fm_1 ON fm_1.contact_id = g.contact_id
          GROUP BY g.contact_id
        ), challenge_counts AS (
         SELECT ce.contact_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ce.status = 'active'::text)::integer AS active_challenges,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ce.status = 'completed'::text)::integer AS completed_challenges,
            COALESCE(sum(ce.points_earned), 0::bigint)::integer AS challenge_points
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
             JOIN family_members fm_1 ON fm_1.contact_id = ce.contact_id
          GROUP BY ce.contact_id
        )
 SELECT fm.household_id,
    fm.household_member_id,
    fm.contact_id,
    fm.first_name,
    fm.last_name,
    fm.relationship_type,
    fm.is_primary,
    fm.date_of_birth,
    ls.score_type,
    ls.score AS health_score,
    ls.methodology_version AS health_score_methodology_version,
    ls.calculated_at AS health_score_calculated_at,
    COALESCE(gc.active_goals, 0) AS active_goals,
    COALESCE(gc.completed_goals, 0) AS completed_goals,
    COALESCE(cc.active_challenges, 0) AS active_challenges,
    COALESCE(cc.completed_challenges, 0) AS completed_challenges,
    COALESCE(cc.challenge_points, 0) AS challenge_points,
    COALESCE(ac.achievement_count, 0) AS achievement_count,
    ac.latest_achievement_at,
    round(avg(ls.score) OVER (PARTITION BY fm.household_id, ls.score_type), 2) AS household_average_health_score
   FROM family_members fm
     LEFT JOIN latest_score ls ON ls.contact_id = fm.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN achievement_counts ac ON ac.contact_id = fm.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN goal_counts gc ON gc.contact_id = fm.contact_id
     LEFT JOIN challenge_counts cc ON cc.contact_id = fm.contact_id
  ORDER BY fm.is_primary DESC, fm.first_name, fm.last_name;

views.name: my_consistency_summary
views.definition:
WITH hist AS (
         SELECT my_daily_plan_history_30d.action_date,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.habits_assigned,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.habits_completed,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.meals_assigned,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.meals_completed,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.workouts_assigned,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.workouts_completed,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.total_actions,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.completed_actions,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.completion_percent,
            my_daily_plan_history_30d.fully_completed
           FROM my_daily_plan_history_30d
        ), numbered AS (
         SELECT h.action_date,
            h.habits_assigned,
            h.habits_completed,
            h.meals_assigned,
            h.meals_completed,
            h.workouts_assigned,
            h.workouts_completed,
            h.total_actions,
            h.completed_actions,
            h.completion_percent,
            h.fully_completed,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY h.action_date DESC) AS recency_rank
           FROM hist h
        ), current_streak AS (
         SELECT count(*)::integer AS streak
           FROM numbered n
          WHERE n.fully_completed = true AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM numbered newer
                  WHERE newer.action_date > n.action_date AND newer.total_actions > 0 AND newer.fully_completed = false)) AND n.action_date <= CURRENT_DATE
        ), islands AS (
         SELECT hist_1.action_date,
            hist_1.action_date - row_number() OVER (ORDER BY hist_1.action_date)::integer AS grp
           FROM hist hist_1
          WHERE hist_1.fully_completed = true
        ), best_streak AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(max(s.cnt), 0) AS streak
           FROM ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS cnt
                   FROM islands
                  GROUP BY islands.grp) s
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT hist_1.completion_percent
           FROM hist hist_1
          WHERE hist_1.action_date = CURRENT_DATE), 0::numeric) AS today_completion_percent,
    ( SELECT hist_1.total_actions
           FROM hist hist_1
          WHERE hist_1.action_date = CURRENT_DATE) AS today_actions,
    ( SELECT hist_1.completed_actions
           FROM hist hist_1
          WHERE hist_1.action_date = CURRENT_DATE) AS today_completed_actions,
    round(avg(completion_percent) FILTER (WHERE completion_percent IS NOT NULL), 1) AS average_completion_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE fully_completed)::integer AS fully_completed_days_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE total_actions > 0)::integer AS planned_days_30d,
    ( SELECT current_streak.streak
           FROM current_streak) AS current_full_completion_streak,
    ( SELECT best_streak.streak
           FROM best_streak) AS best_full_completion_streak_30d
   FROM hist;

views.name: admin_client_attention_center
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT c.id AS contact_id,
            c.first_name,
            c.last_name,
            cm.id AS membership_id,
            cm.program_code,
            pc.name AS program_name,
            cca.coach_user_id,
            sd.display_name AS coach_name,
            ( SELECT max(ch.submitted_at) AS max
                   FROM client_checkins ch
                  WHERE ch.contact_id = c.id AND (ch.status = ANY (ARRAY['submitted'::text, 'reviewed'::text]))) AS last_checkin_at,
            ( SELECT max(pe.recorded_at) AS max
                   FROM progress_entries pe
                  WHERE pe.contact_id = c.id) AS last_manual_progress_at,
            ( SELECT max(ho.observed_at) AS max
                   FROM health_observations ho
                  WHERE ho.contact_id = c.id) AS last_synced_health_at,
            ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
                   FROM client_goals g
                  WHERE g.contact_id = c.id AND g.status = 'active'::text) AS active_goals,
            ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
                   FROM client_goals g
                  WHERE g.contact_id = c.id AND g.status = 'active'::text AND g.target_date IS NOT NULL AND g.target_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_goals,
            ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
                   FROM client_assignments a
                  WHERE a.contact_id = c.id AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['assigned'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AND a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.due_at < now()) AS overdue_assignments,
            ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
                   FROM follow_up_tasks t
                  WHERE t.contact_id = c.id AND t.status = 'open'::text AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < now()) AS overdue_staff_tasks
           FROM contacts c
             JOIN client_access ca ON ca.contact_id = c.id AND ca.status = 'active'::text
             LEFT JOIN client_memberships cm ON cm.id = ca.membership_id
             LEFT JOIN program_catalog pc ON pc.program_code = cm.program_code
             LEFT JOIN client_coach_assignments cca ON cca.contact_id = c.id AND cca.role = 'primary'::text AND cca.status = 'active'::text
             LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = cca.coach_user_id
          WHERE private.staff_can_access_contact(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), c.id)
        ), signals AS (
         SELECT b.contact_id,
            b.first_name,
            b.last_name,
            b.membership_id,
            b.program_code,
            b.program_name,
            b.coach_user_id,
            b.coach_name,
            b.last_checkin_at,
            b.last_manual_progress_at,
            b.last_synced_health_at,
            b.active_goals,
            b.overdue_goals,
            b.overdue_assignments,
            b.overdue_staff_tasks,
            GREATEST(COALESCE(b.last_manual_progress_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone), COALESCE(b.last_synced_health_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) AS last_progress_at,
            array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN b.overdue_staff_tasks > 0 THEN 'overdue_staff_tasks'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.overdue_assignments > 0 THEN 'overdue_client_assignments'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.overdue_goals > 0 THEN 'overdue_goals'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.last_checkin_at IS NULL THEN 'no_checkin_yet'::text
                    WHEN b.last_checkin_at < (now() - '14 days'::interval) THEN 'checkin_stale'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN GREATEST(COALESCE(b.last_manual_progress_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone), COALESCE(b.last_synced_health_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) = '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone THEN 'no_progress_yet'::text
                    WHEN GREATEST(COALESCE(b.last_manual_progress_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone), COALESCE(b.last_synced_health_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) < (now() - '14 days'::interval) THEN 'progress_stale'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text) AS attention_signals
           FROM base b
        )
 SELECT contact_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    membership_id,
    program_code,
    program_name,
    coach_user_id,
    coach_name,
    last_checkin_at,
    last_manual_progress_at,
    last_synced_health_at,
    active_goals,
    overdue_goals,
    overdue_assignments,
    overdue_staff_tasks,
    last_progress_at,
    attention_signals,
    cardinality(attention_signals) AS attention_signal_count,
        CASE
            WHEN overdue_staff_tasks > 0 THEN 'urgent'::text
            WHEN overdue_assignments > 0 OR overdue_goals > 0 THEN 'high'::text
            WHEN ('checkin_stale'::text = ANY (attention_signals)) OR ('progress_stale'::text = ANY (attention_signals)) OR ('no_checkin_yet'::text = ANY (attention_signals)) OR ('no_progress_yet'::text = ANY (attention_signals)) THEN 'normal'::text
            ELSE 'low'::text
        END AS attention_priority
   FROM signals s;
