views.name: my_coaching_momentum
views.definition:
WITH me AS (
         SELECT ca.contact_id,
            ca.membership_id
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.status = 'active'::text
          ORDER BY ca.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1
        ), recent_plan AS (
         SELECT avg(h.completion_percent) FILTER (WHERE h.completion_percent IS NOT NULL AND h.action_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6)) AS avg_7d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.total_actions > 0 AND h.action_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6))::integer AS planned_days_7d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.fully_completed AND h.action_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6))::integer AS full_days_7d
           FROM my_daily_plan_history_30d h
        ), last_checkin AS (
         SELECT max(c.submitted_at) AS submitted_at
           FROM client_checkins c
             JOIN me me_1 ON me_1.contact_id = c.contact_id
          WHERE c.status = ANY (ARRAY['submitted'::text, 'reviewed'::text])
        ), last_progress AS (
         SELECT max(t.recorded_at) AS recorded_at
           FROM my_health_metric_timeline t
             JOIN me me_1 ON me_1.contact_id = t.contact_id
        ), goals AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE g_1.status = 'active'::text)::integer AS active_goals,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE g_1.status = 'active'::text AND g_1.target_date < CURRENT_DATE)::integer AS overdue_goals
           FROM client_goals g_1
             JOIN me me_1 ON me_1.contact_id = g_1.contact_id
        )
 SELECT me.contact_id,
    me.membership_id,
    round(rp.avg_7d, 1) AS plan_completion_7d,
    rp.planned_days_7d,
    rp.full_days_7d,
    lc.submitted_at AS last_checkin_at,
    lp.recorded_at AS last_progress_at,
    g.active_goals,
    g.overdue_goals,
        CASE
            WHEN rp.planned_days_7d >= 3 AND COALESCE(rp.avg_7d, 100::numeric) < 50::numeric THEN 'needs_attention'::text
            WHEN lc.submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND lc.submitted_at < (now() - '14 days'::interval) THEN 'checkin_due'::text
            WHEN lp.recorded_at IS NOT NULL AND lp.recorded_at < (now() - '14 days'::interval) THEN 'progress_due'::text
            WHEN g.overdue_goals > 0 THEN 'goal_follow_up'::text
            WHEN rp.planned_days_7d >= 3 AND COALESCE(rp.avg_7d, 0::numeric) >= 80::numeric THEN 'strong_momentum'::text
            ELSE 'steady'::text
        END AS momentum_state
   FROM me
     CROSS JOIN recent_plan rp
     CROSS JOIN last_checkin lc
     CROSS JOIN last_progress lp
     CROSS JOIN goals g;

views.name: admin_companion_knowledge_readiness
views.definition:
SELECT count(*)::integer AS total_sources,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'::text)::integer AS approved_sources,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'approved'::text)::integer AS nonapproved_sources,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'::text AND approved_at IS NULL)::integer AS approved_missing_timestamp,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'::text AND COALESCE(length(TRIM(BOTH FROM content_text)), 0) = 0)::integer AS approved_missing_content,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'::text AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM coach_companion_knowledge_chunks ch
          WHERE ch.source_id = coach_companion_knowledge_sources.id AND ch.active AND ch.embedding IS NOT NULL)))::integer AS approved_sources_with_embeddings,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM coach_companion_knowledge_chunks ch
          WHERE ch.source_id = coach_companion_knowledge_sources.id AND ch.active AND ch.embedding IS NOT NULL)))::integer AS approved_sources_without_embeddings
   FROM coach_companion_knowledge_sources
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'companion.manage'::text);

views.name: admin_companion_operations_summary
views.definition:
SELECT count(*)::integer AS total_requests,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))::integer AS requests_24h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval))::integer AS requests_7d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))::integer AS requests_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'retrieving'::text, 'draft_ready'::text]))::integer AS processing_requests,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['coach_review'::text, 'escalated'::text]))::integer AS review_backlog,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['answered'::text, 'resolved'::text]))::integer AS answered_requests,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE handling_mode = 'block_and_escalate'::text)::integer AS blocked_or_escalated_requests,
    round(avg(retrieval_confidence) FILTER (WHERE retrieval_confidence IS NOT NULL), 3) AS avg_retrieval_confidence,
    round(avg(answer_confidence) FILTER (WHERE answer_confidence IS NOT NULL), 3) AS avg_answer_confidence,
    round(avg(EXTRACT(epoch FROM answered_at - created_at) / 60::numeric) FILTER (WHERE answered_at IS NOT NULL), 1) AS avg_minutes_to_answer,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE answered_by_type = 'companion'::text)::integer AS ai_answered,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE answered_by_type = ANY (ARRAY['coach'::text, 'staff'::text]))::integer AS human_answered
   FROM coach_companion_requests
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'companion.manage'::text);

views.name: admin_companion_usage_summary_30d
views.definition:
SELECT count(*)::integer AS total_events_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'question_submitted'::text)::integer AS questions_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'answer_generated'::text)::integer AS generated_answers_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'answer_delivered'::text)::integer AS delivered_answers_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'escalated'::text)::integer AS escalations_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'coach_reviewed'::text)::integer AS coach_reviews_30d,
    COALESCE(sum(input_tokens), 0::bigint) AS input_tokens_30d,
    COALESCE(sum(output_tokens), 0::bigint) AS output_tokens_30d,
    COALESCE(sum(estimated_cost_micros), 0::numeric)::bigint AS estimated_cost_micros_30d
   FROM coach_companion_usage_events
  WHERE occurred_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval) AND private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'companion.manage'::text);

views.name: admin_companion_source_health
views.definition:
SELECT s.id AS source_id,
    s.source_key,
    s.title,
    s.source_type,
    s.version,
    s.status,
    s.approved_at,
    count(ch.id)::integer AS total_chunks,
    count(ch.id) FILTER (WHERE ch.active)::integer AS active_chunks,
    count(ch.id) FILTER (WHERE ch.active AND ch.embedding IS NOT NULL)::integer AS embedded_chunks,
    count(ch.id) FILTER (WHERE ch.active AND ch.embedding IS NULL)::integer AS missing_embeddings,
    max(ch.embedding_updated_at) AS last_embedding_at,
    max(r.captured_at) AS last_revision_at
   FROM coach_companion_knowledge_sources s
     LEFT JOIN coach_companion_knowledge_chunks ch ON ch.source_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN coach_companion_source_revisions r ON r.source_id = s.id
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'companion.manage'::text)
  GROUP BY s.id, s.source_key, s.title, s.source_type, s.version, s.status, s.approved_at
  ORDER BY (
        CASE s.status
            WHEN 'approved'::text THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END), s.title;

views.name: admin_companion_quality_summary
views.definition:
SELECT count(*)::integer AS feedback_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE helpful = true)::integer AS helpful_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE helpful = false)::integer AS not_helpful_count,
    round(100::numeric * count(*) FILTER (WHERE helpful = true)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 1) AS helpful_percent,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback_reason = 'incorrect'::text)::integer AS incorrect_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback_reason = 'not_relevant'::text)::integer AS not_relevant_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback_reason = 'unclear'::text)::integer AS unclear_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback_reason = 'missing_context'::text)::integer AS missing_context_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback_reason = 'too_generic'::text)::integer AS too_generic_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback_reason = 'needs_coach'::text)::integer AS needs_coach_count
   FROM coach_companion_answer_feedback
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'companion.manage'::text);

views.name: admin_companion_ingestion_queue
views.definition:
SELECT j.id AS job_id,
    j.source_id,
    s.source_key,
    s.title,
    s.version,
    s.status AS source_status,
    s.ingestion_status AS source_ingestion_status,
    j.job_type,
    j.status AS job_status,
    j.requested_by,
    sd.display_name AS requested_by_name,
    j.started_at,
    j.completed_at,
    j.chunk_count,
    j.embedded_chunk_count,
    j.error_message,
    j.created_at,
    j.updated_at
   FROM coach_companion_ingestion_jobs j
     JOIN coach_companion_knowledge_sources s ON s.id = j.source_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_directory sd ON sd.user_id = j.requested_by
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'companion.manage'::text)
  ORDER BY (
        CASE j.status
            WHEN 'failed'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'processing'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'queued'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END), j.created_at;

views.name: admin_companion_sources_needing_review
views.definition:
SELECT id AS source_id,
    source_key,
    title,
    source_type,
    version,
    status,
    ingestion_status,
    approved_at,
    review_due_at,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'approved'::text AND review_due_at IS NOT NULL AND review_due_at < now() THEN 'review_overdue'::text
            WHEN ingestion_status = 'failed'::text THEN 'ingestion_failed'::text
            WHEN status = 'draft'::text AND ingestion_status = 'ready'::text THEN 'ready_for_approval'::text
            WHEN status = 'draft'::text AND ingestion_status = 'queued'::text THEN 'awaiting_ingestion'::text
            WHEN ingestion_status = 'stale'::text THEN 'stale'::text
            ELSE 'other'::text
        END AS attention_reason
   FROM coach_companion_knowledge_sources s
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'companion.manage'::text) AND (status = 'approved'::text AND review_due_at IS NOT NULL AND review_due_at < now() OR (ingestion_status = ANY (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'stale'::text])) OR status = 'draft'::text AND (ingestion_status = ANY (ARRAY['ready'::text, 'queued'::text])))
  ORDER BY (
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'approved'::text AND review_due_at IS NOT NULL AND review_due_at < now() THEN 1
            WHEN ingestion_status = 'failed'::text THEN 2
            WHEN ingestion_status = 'stale'::text THEN 3
            WHEN status = 'draft'::text AND ingestion_status = 'ready'::text THEN 4
            ELSE 5
        END), updated_at;

views.name: my_weekly_progress_story
views.definition:
WITH me AS (
         SELECT ca.user_id,
            ca.contact_id,
            ca.membership_id
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.status = 'active'::text
          ORDER BY ca.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1
        ), this_week AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h_1.action_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND h_1.action_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND h_1.total_actions > 0)::integer AS planned_days,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE h_1.action_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND h_1.action_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND h_1.fully_completed)::integer AS fully_completed_days,
            round(avg(h_1.completion_percent) FILTER (WHERE h_1.action_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6) AND h_1.action_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND h_1.completion_percent IS NOT NULL), 1) AS avg_completion
           FROM my_daily_plan_history_30d h_1
        ), prior_week AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h_1.action_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 13) AND h_1.action_date <= (CURRENT_DATE - 7) AND h_1.total_actions > 0)::integer AS planned_days,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE h_1.action_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 13) AND h_1.action_date <= (CURRENT_DATE - 7) AND h_1.fully_completed)::integer AS fully_completed_days,
            round(avg(h_1.completion_percent) FILTER (WHERE h_1.action_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 13) AND h_1.action_date <= (CURRENT_DATE - 7) AND h_1.completion_percent IS NOT NULL), 1) AS avg_completion
           FROM my_daily_plan_history_30d h_1
        ), weekly AS (
         SELECT my_weekly_summary.user_id,
            my_weekly_summary.contact_id,
            my_weekly_summary.period_start,
            my_weekly_summary.period_end,
            my_weekly_summary.habit_checkins,
            my_weekly_summary.active_habit_days,
            my_weekly_summary.workouts_completed,
            my_weekly_summary.meals_completed,
            my_weekly_summary.meal_adherence,
            my_weekly_summary.progress_entries,
            my_weekly_summary.goals_completed,
            my_weekly_summary.challenges_completed,
            my_weekly_summary.challenge_points_earned,
            my_weekly_summary.courses_completed
           FROM my_weekly_summary
        ), achievements AS (
         SELECT count(*)::integer AS unlocked_count,
            COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('achievement_key', a_1.achievement_key, 'title', a_1.title, 'description', a_1.description, 'icon_key', a_1.icon_key, 'unlocked_at', a_1.unlocked_at) ORDER BY a_1.unlocked_at DESC) FILTER (WHERE a_1.unlocked_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
           FROM my_achievements a_1
        ), goals AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE gp.status = 'active'::text)::integer AS active_goals,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE gp.progress_state = 'past_due'::text)::integer AS past_due_goals,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE gp.completion_percent >= 75::numeric AND gp.status = 'active'::text)::integer AS goals_near_completion,
            COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('goal_id', gp.goal_id, 'title', gp.title, 'completion_percent', gp.completion_percent, 'progress_state', gp.progress_state, 'target_date', gp.target_date) ORDER BY gp.priority, gp.title) FILTER (WHERE gp.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'paused'::text])), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
           FROM my_goal_progress gp
        ), upcoming AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_id', u_1.source_id, 'item_type', u_1.item_type, 'title', u_1.title, 'starts_at', u_1.starts_at, 'ends_at', u_1.ends_at, 'item_date', u_1.item_date, 'all_day', u_1.all_day, 'location_url', u_1.location_url, 'metadata', u_1.metadata) ORDER BY u_1.item_date, u_1.starts_at), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
           FROM ( SELECT my_up_next.contact_id,
                    my_up_next.household_id,
                    my_up_next.source_id,
                    my_up_next.item_type,
                    my_up_next.title,
                    my_up_next.status,
                    my_up_next.starts_at,
                    my_up_next.ends_at,
                    my_up_next.item_date,
                    my_up_next.all_day,
                    my_up_next.location_url,
                    my_up_next.metadata
                   FROM my_up_next
                  WHERE my_up_next.item_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND my_up_next.item_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 7)
                  ORDER BY my_up_next.item_date, my_up_next.starts_at
                 LIMIT 12) u_1
        ), health AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('metric_key', i.metric_key, 'metric_label', i.metric_label, 'unit', i.unit, 'current_value', i.current_value, 'absolute_change', i.absolute_change, 'percent_change_30d', i.percent_change_30d, 'direction', i.direction, 'insight_text', i.insight_text) ORDER BY i.category, i.metric_label), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
           FROM my_progress_insights i
          WHERE i.current_recorded_at >= (now() - '14 days'::interval)
        ), momentum AS (
         SELECT my_coaching_momentum.contact_id,
            my_coaching_momentum.membership_id,
            my_coaching_momentum.plan_completion_7d,
            my_coaching_momentum.planned_days_7d,
            my_coaching_momentum.full_days_7d,
            my_coaching_momentum.last_checkin_at,
            my_coaching_momentum.last_progress_at,
            my_coaching_momentum.active_goals,
            my_coaching_momentum.overdue_goals,
            my_coaching_momentum.momentum_state
           FROM my_coaching_momentum
         LIMIT 1
        )
 SELECT me.user_id,
    me.contact_id,
    me.membership_id,
    CURRENT_DATE - 6 AS period_start,
    CURRENT_DATE AS period_end,
    tw.planned_days,
    tw.fully_completed_days,
    tw.avg_completion AS plan_completion_7d,
    pw.avg_completion AS prior_plan_completion_7d,
        CASE
            WHEN tw.avg_completion IS NULL OR pw.avg_completion IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(tw.avg_completion - pw.avg_completion, 1)
        END AS completion_change_vs_prior_week,
    w.habit_checkins,
    w.active_habit_days,
    w.workouts_completed,
    w.meals_completed,
    w.meal_adherence,
    w.progress_entries,
    w.goals_completed,
    w.challenges_completed,
    w.challenge_points_earned,
    w.courses_completed,
    a.unlocked_count AS achievements_unlocked,
    a.items AS achievements,
    g.active_goals,
    g.past_due_goals,
    g.goals_near_completion,
    g.items AS goals,
    h.items AS progress_insights,
    u.items AS upcoming_7d,
    m.momentum_state,
    m.last_checkin_at,
    m.last_progress_at,
        CASE
            WHEN tw.avg_completion IS NULL THEN 'Your week is ready to begin.'::text
            WHEN tw.avg_completion >= 90::numeric THEN 'You completed nearly all of your planned actions this week.'::text
            WHEN tw.avg_completion >= 75::numeric THEN 'You completed most of your planned actions this week.'::text
            WHEN tw.avg_completion >= 50::numeric THEN 'You made steady progress on your plan this week.'::text
            ELSE 'There are several opportunities to reconnect with your plan this week.'::text
        END AS summary_headline,
        CASE
            WHEN pw.avg_completion IS NULL OR tw.avg_completion IS NULL THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (tw.avg_completion - pw.avg_completion) >= 10::numeric THEN 'Your plan completion increased compared with the prior week.'::text
            WHEN (tw.avg_completion - pw.avg_completion) <= '-10'::integer::numeric THEN 'Your plan completion decreased compared with the prior week.'::text
            ELSE 'Your plan completion was similar to the prior week.'::text
        END AS comparison_text
   FROM me
     CROSS JOIN this_week tw
     CROSS JOIN prior_week pw
     CROSS JOIN weekly w
     CROSS JOIN achievements a
     CROSS JOIN goals g
     CROSS JOIN upcoming u
     CROSS JOIN health h
     LEFT JOIN momentum m ON m.contact_id = me.contact_id;

SELECT count(*)::integer AS action_count,

views.name: my_calendar_feed_60d
views.definition:
WITH access_rows AS (
         SELECT ca.user_id,
            ca.contact_id,
            ca.household_id,
            ca.membership_id
           FROM client_access ca
          WHERE ca.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ca.status = 'active'::text
        ), appointments AS (
         SELECT a.contact_id,
            ca.household_id,
            a.id AS source_id,
            'appointment'::text AS item_type,
            COALESCE(a.appointment_type, 'Appointment'::text) AS title,
            a.status,
            a.scheduled_start AS starts_at,
            a.scheduled_end AS ends_at,
            a.scheduled_start::date AS item_date,
            false AS all_day,
            a.location_url,
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'journey_appointment', 'format', a.format, 'assigned_to', a.assigned_to) AS metadata
           FROM journey_appointments a
             JOIN access_rows ca ON ca.contact_id = a.contact_id
          WHERE a.scheduled_start >= (now() - '7 days'::interval) AND a.scheduled_start < (now() + '60 days'::interval) AND a.status <> 'cancelled'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT cs.contact_id,
            ca.household_id,
            cs.id,
            'coaching_session'::text AS text,
            'Coaching Session'::text AS text,
            cs.status,
            cs.scheduled_start,
            cs.scheduled_end,
            cs.scheduled_start::date AS scheduled_start,
            false,
            cs.location_url,
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'coaching_session', 'session_number', cs.session_number, 'format', cs.format, 'coach_user_id', cs.coach_user_id) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM coaching_sessions cs
             JOIN access_rows ca ON ca.contact_id = cs.contact_id
          WHERE cs.scheduled_start >= (now() - '7 days'::interval) AND cs.scheduled_start < (now() + '60 days'::interval) AND cs.status <> 'cancelled'::text
        ), workouts AS (
         SELECT wa.contact_id,
            ca.household_id,
            wa.id AS source_id,
            'workout'::text AS item_type,
            wt.title,
            wa.status,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS starts_at,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS ends_at,
            wa.scheduled_date AS item_date,
            true AS all_day,
            NULL::text AS location_url,
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'workout_assignment', 'workout_id', wa.workout_id, 'category', wt.category, 'difficulty', wt.difficulty, 'duration_minutes', wt.duration_minutes) AS metadata
           FROM client_workout_assignments wa
             JOIN access_rows ca ON ca.contact_id = wa.contact_id
             JOIN workout_templates wt ON wt.id = wa.workout_id
          WHERE wa.scheduled_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 7) AND wa.scheduled_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 60) AND wa.status <> 'cancelled'::text
        ), meals AS (
         SELECT mi.contact_id,
            ca.household_id,
            mi.id AS source_id,
            'meal'::text AS item_type,
            COALESCE(r.title, mi.custom_title, 'Meal'::text) AS title,
            mi.status,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS starts_at,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS ends_at,
            mi.scheduled_date AS item_date,
            true AS all_day,
            NULL::text AS location_url,
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'meal_plan_item', 'meal_slot', mi.meal_slot, 'recipe_id', mi.recipe_id, 'adherence_percent', mi.adherence_percent) AS metadata
           FROM client_meal_plan_items mi
             JOIN access_rows ca ON ca.contact_id = mi.contact_id
             LEFT JOIN recipes r ON r.id = mi.recipe_id
          WHERE mi.scheduled_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 7) AND mi.scheduled_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 60)
        ), goals AS (
         SELECT g.contact_id,
            COALESCE(g.household_id, ca.household_id) AS household_id,
            g.id AS source_id,
            'goal_due'::text AS item_type,
            g.title,
            g.status,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS starts_at,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS ends_at,
            g.target_date AS item_date,
            true AS all_day,
            NULL::text AS location_url,
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'client_goal', 'scope', g.scope, 'goal_key', g.goal_key, 'priority', g.priority, 'target_value', g.target_value, 'target_unit', g.target_unit) AS metadata
           FROM client_goals g
             JOIN access_rows ca ON ca.contact_id = g.contact_id
          WHERE g.target_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 7) AND g.target_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + 60) AND (g.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'paused'::text]))
        ), challenges AS (
         SELECT ce.contact_id,
            COALESCE(ce.household_id, ca.household_id) AS household_id,
            ce.id AS source_id,
            'challenge_end'::text AS item_type,
            wc.title,
            ce.status,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS starts_at,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS ends_at,
            wc.ends_on AS item_date,
            true AS all_day,
            NULL::text AS location_url,
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'challenge_enrollment', 'challenge_id', wc.id, 'scope', ce.scope, 'completion_percent', ce.completion_percent, 'points_earned', ce.points_earned, 'target_value', wc.target_value, 'unit', wc.unit) AS metadata
           FROM challenge_enrollments ce
             JOIN access_rows ca ON ca.contact_id = ce.contact_id OR ca.household_id IS NOT NULL AND ca.household_id = ce.household_id
             JOIN wellness_challenges wc ON wc.id = ce.challenge_id
          WHERE wc.ends_on >= (CURRENT_DATE - 7) AND wc.ends_on <= (CURRENT_DATE + 60) AND (ce.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'paused'::text]))
        )
 SELECT appointments.contact_id,
    appointments.household_id,
    appointments.source_id,
    appointments.item_type,
    appointments.title,
    appointments.status,
    appointments.starts_at,
    appointments.ends_at,
    appointments.item_date,
    appointments.all_day,
    appointments.location_url,
    appointments.metadata
   FROM appointments
UNION ALL
 SELECT workouts.contact_id,
    workouts.household_id,
    workouts.source_id,
    workouts.item_type,
    workouts.title,
    workouts.status,
    workouts.starts_at,
    workouts.ends_at,
    workouts.item_date,
    workouts.all_day,
    workouts.location_url,
    workouts.metadata
   FROM workouts
UNION ALL
 SELECT meals.contact_id,
    meals.household_id,
    meals.source_id,
    meals.item_type,
    meals.title,
    meals.status,
    meals.starts_at,
    meals.ends_at,
    meals.item_date,
    meals.all_day,
    meals.location_url,
    meals.metadata
   FROM meals
UNION ALL
 SELECT goals.contact_id,
    goals.household_id,
    goals.source_id,
    goals.item_type,
    goals.title,
    goals.status,
    goals.starts_at,

   FROM goals
UNION ALL
 SELECT challenges.contact_id,

   FROM challenges;

views.name: my_next_best_actions
views.definition:
WITH candidates AS (
         SELECT 10 AS priority_rank,
            'assignment_overdue'::text AS action_type,
            a.id AS source_id,
            a.title,
            COALESCE(a.instructions, 'Complete your overdue coaching assignment.'::text) AS description,
            a.due_at,
            '/app/coaching'::text AS link_url,
            jsonb_build_object('assignment_type', a.assignment_type, 'status', a.status, 'assigned_by_name', a.assigned_by_name) AS metadata
           FROM my_client_assignments a
          WHERE (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['assigned'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AND a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.due_at < now()
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 20,
            'appointment_upcoming'::text,
            ap.appointment_id,
            'Upcoming '::text || replace(COALESCE(ap.appointment_type, 'appointment'::text), '_'::text, ' '::text),
                CASE
                    WHEN ap.assigned_coach_name IS NOT NULL THEN ('Your next session with '::text || ap.assigned_coach_name) || ' is coming up.'::text
                    ELSE 'Your next scheduled session is coming up.'::text
                END AS "case",
            ap.scheduled_start,
            '/app/coaching'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('scheduled_start', ap.scheduled_start, 'scheduled_end', ap.scheduled_end, 'format', ap.format, 'location_url', ap.location_url, 'coach_name', ap.assigned_coach_name) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM my_member_upcoming_appointment ap
          WHERE ap.scheduled_start <= (now() + '24:00:00'::interval)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 30,
            'workout_today'::text,
            w.workout_assignment_id,
            w.title,
            COALESCE(w.description, 'Complete today''s assigned workout.'::text) AS "coalesce",
            CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone AS "current_date",
            '/app/workouts'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('workout_id', w.workout_id, 'category', w.category, 'difficulty', w.difficulty, 'duration_minutes', w.duration_minutes, 'status', w.status) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM my_upcoming_workouts w
          WHERE w.scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE AND w.status <> 'completed'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 40,
            'meal_today'::text,
            m.meal_item_id,
            m.title,
            ('Review or complete your '::text || COALESCE(m.meal_slot, 'meal'::text)) || ' plan for today.'::text,
            CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone AS "current_date",
            '/app/nutrition'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('meal_slot', m.meal_slot, 'recipe_id', m.recipe_id, 'status', m.status, 'adherence_percent', m.adherence_percent) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM my_upcoming_meals m
          WHERE m.scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE AND m.status <> 'completed'::text
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 50,
            'habit_today'::text,
            (h.value ->> 'habit_id'::text)::uuid AS uuid,
            h.value ->> 'title'::text,
            'Complete today''s habit target.'::text,
            CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone AS "current_date",
            '/app/today'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('category', h.value ->> 'category'::text, 'target', h.value ->> 'target'::text, 'unit', h.value ->> 'unit'::text, 'today_value', h.value ->> 'today_value'::text) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM my_daily_action_center dac,
            LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(dac.habits) h(value)
          WHERE COALESCE((h.value ->> 'completed_today'::text)::boolean, false) = false
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 60,
            'goal_follow_up'::text,
            gp.goal_id,
            gp.title,
                CASE
                    WHEN gp.progress_state = 'past_due'::text THEN 'This goal is past its target date. Review it with your coach or update the plan.'::text
                    WHEN gp.progress_state = 'awaiting_data'::text THEN 'Add progress data so this goal can be tracked.'::text
                    ELSE 'Keep moving toward this active goal.'::text
                END AS "case",
            gp.target_date::timestamp with time zone AS target_date,
            '/app/progress'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('completion_percent', gp.completion_percent, 'progress_state', gp.progress_state, 'target_value', gp.target_value, 'target_unit', gp.target_unit) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM my_goal_progress gp
          WHERE gp.status = 'active'::text AND (gp.progress_state = ANY (ARRAY['past_due'::text, 'awaiting_data'::text]))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 70,
            'continue_course'::text,
            c.enrollment_id,
            c.title,
            'Continue your active ReVitalized course.'::text,
            COALESCE(c.last_activity_at, c.started_at, c.created_at) AS "coalesce",
            '/app/courses'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('course_id', c.course_id, 'progress_percent', c.progress_percent, 'last_lesson_id', c.last_lesson_id) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM ( SELECT mc.enrollment_id,
                    mc.course_id,
                    mc.title,
                    mc.description,
                    mc.estimated_minutes,
                    mc.thumbnail_url,
                    mc.status,
                    mc.progress_percent,
                    mc.last_lesson_id,
                    mc.last_activity_at,
                    mc.started_at,
                    mc.completed_at,
                    now() AS created_at
                   FROM my_courses mc
                  WHERE mc.status = 'active'::text
                  ORDER BY mc.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST, mc.title
                 LIMIT 1) c
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 80,
            'ask_revitalized_follow_up'::text,
            r.request_id,
            'Review your Ask ReVitalized answer'::text,
            'A recent Ask ReVitalized response is ready for you.'::text,
            COALESCE(r.answered_at, r.updated_at) AS "coalesce",
            '/app/ask-revitalized'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('question_type', r.question_type, 'status', r.status, 'answered_by_type', r.answered_by_type) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM my_companion_requests r
          WHERE (r.status = ANY (ARRAY['answered'::text, 'resolved'::text])) AND r.answered_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM my_companion_feedback f
                  WHERE f.request_id = r.request_id))
        )
 SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY priority_rank, due_at, title)::integer AS action_order,
    priority_rank,
    action_type,
    source_id,
    title,
    description,
    due_at,
    link_url,
    metadata
   FROM candidates
  ORDER BY priority_rank, due_at, title
 LIMIT 12;

views.name: my_sync_status
views.definition:
SELECT now() AS server_time,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))::integer AS mutations_24h,
    max(created_at) AS last_successful_mutation_at,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('idempotency_key', r.idempotency_key, 'mutation_type', r.mutation_type, 'response_payload', r.response_payload, 'created_at', r.created_at) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT member_mutation_receipts_1.id,
                    member_mutation_receipts_1.user_id,
                    member_mutation_receipts_1.contact_id,
                    member_mutation_receipts_1.device_id,
                    member_mutation_receipts_1.idempotency_key,
                    member_mutation_receipts_1.mutation_type,
                    member_mutation_receipts_1.request_hash,
                    member_mutation_receipts_1.response_payload,
                    member_mutation_receipts_1.created_at
                   FROM member_mutation_receipts member_mutation_receipts_1
                  WHERE member_mutation_receipts_1.user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))
                  ORDER BY member_mutation_receipts_1.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 20) r), '[]'::jsonb) AS recent_mutations
   FROM member_mutation_receipts
  WHERE user_id = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid));

views.name: admin_mobile_adoption_summary
views.definition:
SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= (now() - '1 day'::interval))::integer AS dau,
    count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval))::integer AS wau,
    count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))::integer AS mau,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))::integer AS sessions_24h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval))::integer AS sessions_7d,
    round(avg(EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(ended_at, last_seen_at) - started_at) / 60::numeric) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)), 1) AS avg_session_minutes_30d
   FROM member_app_sessions s
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'analytics.view'::text);

views.name: admin_mobile_feature_usage_30d
views.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(feature_key, route_key, event_key) AS usage_key,
    count(*)::integer AS event_count,
    count(DISTINCT user_id)::integer AS unique_members,
    max(occurred_at) AS last_event_at
   FROM member_app_events e
  WHERE occurred_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval) AND private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'analytics.view'::text)
  GROUP BY (COALESCE(feature_key, route_key, event_key))
  ORDER BY (count(DISTINCT user_id)::integer) DESC, (count(*)::integer) DESC, (COALESCE(feature_key, route_key, event_key));

views.name: admin_mobile_versions
views.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(platform, 'unknown'::text) AS platform,
    COALESCE(app_version, 'unknown'::text) AS app_version,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE revoked_at IS NULL)::integer AS active_devices,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))::integer AS active_devices_30d,
    max(last_seen_at) AS last_seen_at
   FROM member_devices d
  WHERE private.staff_has_permission(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'analytics.view'::text)
  GROUP BY (COALESCE(platform, 'unknown'::text)), (COALESCE(app_version, 'unknown'::text))
  ORDER BY (COALESCE(platform, 'unknown'::text)), (count(*) FILTER (WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))::integer) DESC, (COALESCE(app_version, 'unknown'::text));

views.name: admin_mobile_operations_center
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT to_jsonb(a.*) AS to_jsonb
           FROM admin_mobile_adoption_summary a
         LIMIT 1) AS adoption,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v.*) ORDER BY v.platform, v.active_devices_30d DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM admin_mobile_versions v), '[]'::jsonb) AS versions,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f.*) ORDER BY f.unique_members DESC, f.event_count DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT admin_mobile_feature_usage_30d.usage_key,
                    admin_mobile_feature_usage_30d.event_count,
                    admin_mobile_feature_usage_30d.unique_members,
                    admin_mobile_feature_usage_30d.last_event_at
                   FROM admin_mobile_feature_usage_30d
                 LIMIT 50) f), '[]'::jsonb) AS feature_usage_30d;

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.provision_client_foundation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_household_id uuid;
  v_membership_id uuid;
  v_user_id uuid;
  v_sex text;
  v_full_name text;
  v_program text;
  v_membership_status text;
  v_household_status text;
begin
  if NEW.payment_status <> 'paid' or NEW.agreement_status <> 'signed'
     or NEW.access_status not in ('ready','active') then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  v_program := coalesce(NEW.program_code,'');
  if not exists(select 1 from public.program_catalog where program_code=v_program and active) then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  select concat_ws(' ',first_name,last_name)
  into v_full_name
  from public.contacts
  where id=NEW.contact_id;

  select lower(wa.answer #>> '{}')
  into v_sex
  from public.workflow_records wr
  join public.workflow_answers wa on wa.workflow_id=wr.id and wa.question_key='sex'
  where wr.contact_id=NEW.contact_id
    and wr.workflow_type='enrollment'
  order by wr.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if v_sex not in ('male','female') then
    v_sex := null;
  end if;

  v_household_status := case when v_sex is not null then 'active' else 'draft' end;

  insert into public.households(
    household_type,status,primary_contact_id,household_name,created_by,updated_at
  )
  values(
    'individual',v_household_status,NEW.contact_id,
    nullif(trim(v_full_name),'') || ' Household',
    NEW.created_by,now()
  )
  on conflict (primary_contact_id) do update
  set updated_at=now()
  returning id into v_household_id;

  insert into public.household_members(
    household_id,contact_id,relationship_type,sex,is_primary,status,updated_at
  )
  values(
    v_household_id,NEW.contact_id,'self',v_sex,true,'active',now()
  )
  on conflict (contact_id) do update
  set household_id=excluded.household_id,
      relationship_type='self',
      sex=coalesce(excluded.sex,public.household_members.sex),
      is_primary=true,
      status='active',
      updated_at=now();

  v_membership_status := case when NEW.access_status='active' then 'active' else 'pending' end;

  insert into public.client_memberships(
    household_id,primary_contact_id,activation_id,program_code,status,
    billing_choice,amount_cents,currency,commitment_months,starts_at,commitment_ends_at,
    assigned_coach_id,created_by,metadata,updated_at
  )
  values(
    v_household_id,NEW.contact_id,NEW.id,v_program,v_membership_status,
    NEW.billing_choice,NEW.amount_cents,NEW.currency,NEW.commitment_months,
    coalesce(NEW.paid_at,now()),
    case
      when NEW.commitment_months is not null
        then coalesce(NEW.paid_at,now()) + make_interval(months=>NEW.commitment_months)
      else null
    end,
    (select assigned_to from public.contact_journeys where id=NEW.journey_id),
    NEW.created_by,
    jsonb_build_object('journey_id',NEW.journey_id),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (activation_id) do update
  set status=excluded.status,
      billing_choice=excluded.billing_choice,
      amount_cents=excluded.amount_cents,
      currency=excluded.currency,
      commitment_months=excluded.commitment_months,
      assigned_coach_id=coalesce(excluded.assigned_coach_id,public.client_memberships.assigned_coach_id),
      updated_at=now()
  returning id into v_membership_id;

  insert into public.membership_entitlements(
    membership_id,entitlement_key,label,limit_value,reset_cadence,metadata
  )
  select
    v_membership_id,t.entitlement_key,t.label,t.limit_value,t.reset_cadence,t.metadata
  from public.program_entitlement_templates t
  where t.program_code=v_program and t.active
  on conflict (membership_id,entitlement_key) do update
  set label=excluded.label,
      limit_value=excluded.limit_value,
      reset_cadence=excluded.reset_cadence,
      metadata=excluded.metadata,
      status='active',
      updated_at=now();

  select user_id into v_user_id
  from public.profiles
  where contact_id=NEW.contact_id
  limit 1;

  insert into public.client_access(
    contact_id,household_id,membership_id,user_id,status,ready_at,activated_at,updated_at
  )
  values(
    NEW.contact_id,v_household_id,v_membership_id,v_user_id,
    case when NEW.access_status='active' and v_user_id is not null then 'active' else 'ready' end,
    now(),
    case when NEW.access_status='active' and v_user_id is not null then now() else null end,
    now()
  )
  on conflict (contact_id) do update
  set household_id=excluded.household_id,
      membership_id=excluded.membership_id,
      user_id=coalesce(public.client_access.user_id,excluded.user_id),
      status=case
        when NEW.access_status='active' and coalesce(public.client_access.user_id,excluded.user_id) is not null then 'active'
        when public.client_access.status='active' then 'active'
        else 'ready'
      end,
      ready_at=coalesce(public.client_access.ready_at,now()),
      activated_at=case
        when NEW.access_status='active' and coalesce(public.client_access.user_id,excluded.user_id) is not null
          then coalesce(public.client_access.activated_at,now())
        else public.client_access.activated_at
      end,
      updated_at=now();

  insert into public.contact_activity(contact_id,activity_type,title,detail,metadata)
  values(
    NEW.contact_id,'client_foundation_ready','Client membership foundation ready',
    (select name from public.program_catalog where program_code=v_program),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'membership_id',v_membership_id,
      'household_id',v_household_id,
      'activation_id',NEW.id,
      'access_status',NEW.access_status
    )
  );

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

  limit least(match_count,20);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_journey_from_activation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
begin
  if NEW.payment_status='paid' and NEW.paid_at is null then
    update public.journey_enrollment_activations
    set paid_at=now(),updated_at=now()
    where id=NEW.id;
    NEW.paid_at := now();
  end if;

  if NEW.payment_status in ('paid','waived')
     and NEW.agreement_status in ('signed','waived') then
    update public.contact_journey_steps
    set status='completed',
        completion_source=case
          when NEW.payment_status='waived' or NEW.agreement_status='waived'
            then 'manual_financial_override'
          else 'payment_and_agreement'
        end,
        completed_at=coalesce(completed_at,now()),
        updated_at=now()
    where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
      and step_key='payment_agreement'
      and status not in ('completed','skipped','waived');
  end if;

  if NEW.access_status='active' then
    update public.contact_journey_steps
    set status='completed',
        completion_source=coalesce(NEW.access_completion_method,'member_access_activated'),
        completed_at=coalesce(completed_at,now()),
        updated_at=now()
    where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
      and step_key='backend_activation'
      and status not in ('completed','skipped','waived');
  end if;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

      values(new.contact_id,'webinar_registration','Registered for Founders Webinar',

             jsonb_build_object('registration_id',new.id,'status',new.status));
    elsif TG_OP='UPDATE' and (new.status is distinct from old.status or new.payment_status is distinct from old.payment_status) then

      values(new.contact_id,'workflow_started',
             case new.workflow_type when 'vitality_assessment' then 'Started Vitality Assessment' else 'Started Enrollment' end,
             concat('Status: ',new.status),
             jsonb_build_object('workflow_id',new.id,'workflow_type',new.workflow_type));

             jsonb_build_object('workflow_id',new.id,'workflow_type',new.workflow_type,'status',new.status));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_contact_journey(p_contact_id uuid, p_journey_key text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_existing public.contact_journeys%rowtype;
  v_journey_id uuid;
  v_first_step text;
  v_vitality_completed boolean := false;
begin
  if p_journey_key not in ('coaching_application','direct_membership','assessment_first') then
    raise exception 'Unsupported journey key';
  end if;

  select * into v_existing
  from public.contact_journeys
  where contact_id=p_contact_id
    and status in ('active','paused','nurture')
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1
  for update;

  if found and v_existing.journey_key = p_journey_key then
    update public.contact_journeys
      set metadata = coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb),
          last_activity_at=now(),
          updated_at=now()
    where id=v_existing.id;
    return v_existing.id;
  elsif found then
    update public.contact_journeys
      set status='converted',
          completed_at=now(),
          updated_at=now(),
          metadata=coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('converted_to',p_journey_key)
    where id=v_existing.id;
  end if;

  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.workflow_records
    where contact_id=p_contact_id
      and workflow_type='vitality_assessment'
      and status='completed'
  ) into v_vitality_completed;

  insert into public.contact_journeys(contact_id,journey_key,metadata)
  values(p_contact_id,p_journey_key,coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb))
  returning id into v_journey_id;

  insert into public.contact_journey_steps(
    journey_id,step_key,step_order,name,step_type,required,status,due_at,metadata
  )
  select
    v_journey_id,d.step_key,d.step_order,d.name,d.step_type,d.required,
    case
      when d.step_key='vitality_assessment' and v_vitality_completed then 'completed'
      when p_journey_key in ('coaching_application','direct_membership') and d.step_key='application_capture' then 'completed'
      when p_journey_key='assessment_first' and d.step_key='vitality_assessment' then 'in_progress'
      else 'pending'
    end,
    case
      when p_journey_key='assessment_first' and d.step_key='vitality_assessment' and d.default_due_hours is not null
        then now() + make_interval(hours => d.default_due_hours)
      else null
    end,
    d.metadata
  from public.journey_step_definitions d
  where d.journey_key=p_journey_key
  order by d.step_order;

  select s.step_key into v_first_step
  from public.contact_journey_steps s
  where s.journey_id=v_journey_id
    and s.required
    and s.status not in ('completed','skipped')
  order by s.step_order
  limit 1;

  if v_first_step is null then
    select s.step_key into v_first_step
    from public.contact_journey_steps s
    where s.journey_id=v_journey_id
      and s.status not in ('completed','skipped')
    order by s.step_order
    limit 1;
  end if;

  update public.contact_journey_steps s
  set status='in_progress',
      started_at=coalesce(started_at,now()),
      due_at=case
        when due_at is null and d.default_due_hours is not null
          then now() + make_interval(hours => d.default_due_hours)
        else due_at
      end,
      updated_at=now()
  from public.journey_step_definitions d
  where s.journey_id=v_journey_id
    and s.step_key=v_first_step
    and d.journey_key=p_journey_key
    and d.step_key=s.step_key;

  update public.contact_journeys
  set current_step_key=v_first_step,
      progress_percent=(
        select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where status in ('completed','skipped')) / nullif(count(*),0))::int
        from public.contact_journey_steps
        where journey_id=v_journey_id
      ),
      next_action_at=(
        select due_at from public.contact_journey_steps
        where journey_id=v_journey_id and step_key=v_first_step
      ),
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_journey_id;

  return v_journey_id;
end;
$function$

functions.name: create_appointment_reminder_actions
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.create_appointment_reminder_actions()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  a record;
  v_email_template uuid;
  v_sms_template uuid;
  v_step_id uuid;
  v_email_exists boolean;
  v_sms_exists boolean;
  v_sms_allowed boolean;
  v_count integer := 0;
  v_step_key text;
begin
  for a in
    select
      ja.*,
      c.email,
      c.phone,
      cj.current_step_key
    from public.journey_appointments ja
    join public.contacts c on c.id=ja.contact_id
    join public.contact_journeys cj on cj.id=ja.journey_id
    where ja.status='scheduled'
      and ja.scheduled_start is not null
      and ja.scheduled_start > now()
      and ja.scheduled_start <= now() + interval '24 hours'
  loop
    v_step_key := case
      when a.appointment_type='consultation' then 'consultation'
      else 'application_interview'
    end;

    select id into v_step_id
    from public.contact_journey_steps
    where journey_id=a.journey_id and step_key=v_step_key
    limit 1;

    select id into v_email_template
    from public.journey_action_templates
    where template_key=case
      when a.appointment_type='consultation' then 'consult-reminder-email'
      else 'appointment-reminder-email'
    end
    limit 1;

    select id into v_sms_template
    from public.journey_action_templates
    where template_key=case
      when a.appointment_type='consultation' then 'consult-reminder-sms'
      else 'appointment-reminder-sms'
    end
    limit 1;

    select exists(
      select 1
      from public.journey_step_actions x
      where x.journey_id=a.journey_id
        and x.action_type='email'
        and x.template_id=v_email_template
        and x.metadata->>'appointment_id'=a.id::text
        and x.status not in ('cancelled')
    ) into v_email_exists;

    if a.email is not null and not v_email_exists then
      insert into public.journey_step_actions(
        contact_id,journey_id,journey_step_id,action_type,status,assigned_to,due_at,
        template_id,subject,body,created_by,metadata
      )
      select
        a.contact_id,a.journey_id,v_step_id,'email','assigned',a.assigned_to,
        greatest(now(),a.scheduled_start-interval '24 hours'),
        t.id,t.subject,t.body,null,
        jsonb_build_object('appointment_id',a.id,'reminder','24_hour')
      from public.journey_action_templates t
      where t.id=v_email_template;

      v_count := v_count + 1;
    end if;

    select exists(
      select 1 from public.contact_sms_preferences p
      where p.contact_id=a.contact_id and p.status='opted_in'
    ) into v_sms_allowed;

    select exists(
      select 1
      from public.journey_step_actions x
      where x.journey_id=a.journey_id
        and x.action_type='sms'
        and x.template_id=v_sms_template
        and x.metadata->>'appointment_id'=a.id::text
        and x.status not in ('cancelled')
    ) into v_sms_exists;

    if a.phone is not null and v_sms_allowed and not v_sms_exists then
      insert into public.journey_step_actions(
        contact_id,journey_id,journey_step_id,action_type,status,assigned_to,due_at,
        template_id,body,created_by,metadata
      )
      select
        a.contact_id,a.journey_id,v_step_id,'sms','assigned',a.assigned_to,
        greatest(now(),a.scheduled_start-interval '24 hours'),
        t.id,t.body,null,
        jsonb_build_object('appointment_id',a.id,'reminder','24_hour')
      from public.journey_action_templates t
      where t.id=v_sms_template;

      v_count := v_count + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  return v_count;
end;
$function$

functions.name: sync_journey_from_appointment
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_journey_from_appointment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_schedule_step text;
  v_event_step text;
begin
  if NEW.appointment_type='application_interview' then
    v_schedule_step := 'application_interview_schedule';
    v_event_step := 'application_interview';
  elsif NEW.appointment_type='consultation' then
    v_schedule_step := 'consultation_schedule';
    v_event_step := 'consultation';
  else
    return NEW;
  end if;

  if NEW.status='scheduled'
     and (TG_OP='INSERT' or OLD.status is distinct from NEW.status or OLD.scheduled_start is distinct from NEW.scheduled_start) then
    update public.contact_journey_steps
    set status='completed',
        completion_source='appointment_scheduled',
        completed_at=coalesce(completed_at,now()),
        updated_at=now()
    where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
      and step_key=v_schedule_step
      and status not in ('completed','skipped');

    update public.follow_up_tasks
    set status='completed',completed_at=coalesce(completed_at,now())
    where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
      and journey_step_id=NEW.journey_step_id
      and status='open'
      and task_type in ('scheduling','journey','task');

    insert into public.contact_activity(contact_id,activity_type,title,detail,metadata)
    values(
      NEW.contact_id,'appointment_scheduled',
      case when NEW.appointment_type='application_interview' then 'Application interview scheduled' else 'Consultation scheduled' end,
      case when NEW.scheduled_start is not null then 'Scheduled for ' || NEW.scheduled_start::text else null end,
      jsonb_build_object('appointment_id',NEW.id,'journey_id',NEW.journey_id,'assigned_to',NEW.assigned_to)
    );
  end if;

  if NEW.status='completed'
     and (TG_OP='INSERT' or OLD.status is distinct from NEW.status) then
    update public.contact_journey_steps
    set status='completed',
        completion_source='appointment_completed',
        completed_at=coalesce(completed_at,now()),
        updated_at=now()
    where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
      and step_key=v_event_step
      and status not in ('completed','skipped');

    update public.follow_up_tasks
    set status='completed',completed_at=coalesce(completed_at,now())
    where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
      and status='open'
      and (
        journey_step_id=NEW.journey_step_id
        or lower(title) like '%' || lower(case when NEW.appointment_type='consultation' then 'consultation' else 'application interview' end) || '%'
      );

    update public.journey_appointments
    set completed_at=coalesce(completed_at,now()),updated_at=now()
    where id=NEW.id and completed_at is null;
  end if;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.handle_appointment_exception()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_schedule_step text;
  v_event_step text;
  v_event_type text;
  v_task_title text;
begin
  if TG_OP <> 'UPDATE' or OLD.status is not distinct from NEW.status then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  if NEW.status not in ('cancelled','no_show') then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  if NEW.appointment_type='application_interview' then
    v_schedule_step := 'application_interview_schedule';
    v_event_step := 'application_interview';
  elsif NEW.appointment_type='consultation' then
    v_schedule_step := 'consultation_schedule';
    v_event_step := 'consultation';
  else
    return NEW;
  end if;

  v_event_type := case when NEW.status='no_show' then 'appointment_no_show' else 'appointment_cancelled' end;
  v_task_title := case
    when NEW.status='no_show' then
      case when NEW.appointment_type='consultation'
        then 'Personal follow-up after missed consultation'
        else 'Personal follow-up after missed application interview'
      end
    else
      case when NEW.appointment_type='consultation'
        then 'Help reschedule cancelled consultation'
        else 'Help reschedule cancelled application interview'
      end
  end;

  update public.contact_journey_steps
  set status='in_progress',
      completed_at=null,
      completion_source=null,
      started_at=coalesce(started_at,now()),
      due_at=now()+interval '48 hours',
      updated_at=now()
  where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
    and step_key=v_schedule_step;

  update public.contact_journey_steps
  set status='pending',
      completed_at=null,
      completion_source=null,
      updated_at=now()
  where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
    and step_key=v_event_step
    and status <> 'completed';

  update public.contact_journeys
  set current_step_key=v_schedule_step,
      next_action_at=now()+interval '48 hours',
      last_activity_at=now(),
      updated_at=now()
  where id=NEW.journey_id;

  insert into public.journey_events(
    contact_id,journey_id,step_id,event_type,source,actor_user_id,metadata,dedupe_key
  )
  values(
    NEW.contact_id,NEW.journey_id,NEW.journey_step_id,v_event_type,'appointment',
    (select auth.uid()),
    jsonb_build_object('appointment_id',NEW.id,'appointment_type',NEW.appointment_type),
    v_event_type || ':' || NEW.id::text
  )
  on conflict (dedupe_key) do nothing;

  insert into public.follow_up_tasks(
    contact_id,assigned_to,title,due_at,status,priority,task_type,
    journey_id,journey_step_id,instructions
  )
  select
    NEW.contact_id,
    coalesce(NEW.assigned_to,cj.assigned_to,c.assigned_to),
    v_task_title,
    now()+interval '1 day',
    'open',
    case when NEW.status='no_show' then 'high' else 'normal' end,
    'call',
    NEW.journey_id,
    s.id,
    case
      when NEW.status='no_show'
        then 'Reach out personally and gently. Check that everything is okay, answer questions, and offer to reschedule without pressure.'
      else 'Reach out personally and help them find a new time that works.'
    end
  from public.contact_journeys cj
  join public.contacts c on c.id=NEW.contact_id
  join public.contact_journey_steps s
    on s.journey_id=NEW.journey_id and s.step_key=v_schedule_step
  where cj.id=NEW.journey_id
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.follow_up_tasks t
      where t.contact_id=NEW.contact_id
        and t.title=v_task_title
        and t.status='open'
    );

  update public.contacts
  set follow_up_status='needs_follow_up',
      next_follow_up_at=now()+interval '1 day',
      consultation_status=case
        when NEW.appointment_type='consultation' then 'cancelled'
        else consultation_status
      end,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=NEW.contact_id;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.create_coaching_session_prep_task()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_due timestamptz;
begin
  if NEW.status <> 'scheduled' or NEW.scheduled_start is null then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  v_due := greatest(now(),NEW.scheduled_start - interval '24 hours');

  insert into public.follow_up_tasks(
    contact_id,assigned_to,title,due_at,status,priority,task_type,instructions
  )
  select
    NEW.contact_id,
    NEW.coach_user_id,
    'Prepare for coaching session',
    v_due,
    'open',
    case when NEW.scheduled_start <= now()+interval '24 hours' then 'high' else 'normal' end,
    'coaching',
    'Review the client’s latest goals, habits, progress entries, weekly check-in, open assignments and prior coaching notes before the session.'
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from public.follow_up_tasks t
    where t.contact_id=NEW.contact_id
      and t.title='Prepare for coaching session'
      and t.status='open'
      and t.assigned_to=NEW.coach_user_id
      and abs(extract(epoch from (coalesce(t.due_at,v_due)-v_due))) < 300
  );

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_journey_after_step_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_journey public.contact_journeys%rowtype;
  v_next public.contact_journey_steps%rowtype;
  v_progress integer;
begin
  select * into v_journey
  from public.contact_journeys
  where id=NEW.journey_id;

  if TG_OP='UPDATE' and OLD.status is distinct from NEW.status then
    if NEW.status in ('completed','waived') and NEW.completed_at is null then
      update public.contact_journey_steps
      set completed_at=now(),updated_at=now()
      where id=NEW.id;
      NEW.completed_at := now();
    end if;

    if NEW.status in ('completed','skipped','waived') then
      insert into public.journey_events(
        contact_id,journey_id,step_id,event_type,source,actor_user_id,metadata,dedupe_key
      )
      values(
        v_journey.contact_id,NEW.journey_id,NEW.id,'step_completed',
        coalesce(NEW.completion_source,'staff'),
        (select auth.uid()),
        jsonb_build_object('step_key',NEW.step_key,'step_name',NEW.name,'status',NEW.status),
        'step-completed:' || NEW.id::text || ':' || NEW.status
      )
      on conflict (dedupe_key) do nothing;

      update public.journey_automation_jobs
      set status='cancelled',processed_at=now(),
          result=jsonb_build_object('reason','step_completed_before_job_ran')
      where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
        and status='queued'
        and payload->>'required_step_key'=NEW.step_key;
    end if;
  end if;

  select round(
    100.0 * count(*) filter (where status in ('completed','skipped','waived'))
    / nullif(count(*),0)
  )::int
  into v_progress
  from public.contact_journey_steps
  where journey_id=NEW.journey_id;

  select * into v_next
  from public.contact_journey_steps
  where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
    and required
    and status not in ('completed','skipped','waived')
  order by step_order
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    select * into v_next
    from public.contact_journey_steps
    where journey_id=NEW.journey_id
      and status not in ('completed','skipped','waived')
    order by step_order
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if v_next.id is null then
    update public.contact_journeys
    set current_step_key=null,progress_percent=100,status='completed',
        completed_at=coalesce(completed_at,now()),next_action_at=null,
        last_activity_at=now(),updated_at=now()
    where id=NEW.journey_id;
  else
    if v_next.status='pending' then
      update public.contact_journey_steps s
      set status='in_progress',
          started_at=coalesce(s.started_at,now()),
          due_at=case
            when s.due_at is null and d.default_due_hours is not null
              then now() + make_interval(hours => d.default_due_hours)
            else s.due_at
          end,
          updated_at=now()
      from public.contact_journeys j
      join public.journey_step_definitions d
        on d.journey_key=j.journey_key
       and d.step_key=v_next.step_key
      where s.id=v_next.id
        and j.id=NEW.journey_id;

      select * into v_next
      from public.contact_journey_steps
      where id=v_next.id;
    end if;

    update public.contact_journeys
    set current_step_key=v_next.step_key,
        progress_percent=coalesce(v_progress,0),
        next_action_at=v_next.due_at,
        last_activity_at=now(),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=NEW.journey_id;
  end if;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_course_progress()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_course_id uuid;
  v_total integer;
  v_completed integer;
  v_percent integer;
begin
  select course_id into v_course_id
  from public.client_course_enrollments
  where id=NEW.enrollment_id;

  select count(*)
  into v_total
  from public.learning_lessons l
  join public.learning_modules m on m.id=l.module_id
  where m.course_id=v_course_id
    and m.active
    and l.status='published'
    and l.requires_completion;

  select count(*)
  into v_completed
  from public.lesson_progress lp
  join public.learning_lessons l on l.id=lp.lesson_id
  join public.learning_modules m on m.id=l.module_id
  where lp.enrollment_id=NEW.enrollment_id
    and m.course_id=v_course_id
    and l.requires_completion
    and lp.status='completed';

  v_percent := case
    when v_total=0 then 0
    else round(100.0*v_completed/v_total)::int
  end;

  update public.client_course_enrollments
  set progress_percent=v_percent,
      last_lesson_id=NEW.lesson_id,
      last_activity_at=coalesce(NEW.last_activity_at,now()),
      started_at=coalesce(started_at,NEW.first_started_at,now()),
      status=case when v_total>0 and v_completed>=v_total then 'completed' else status end,
      completed_at=case when v_total>0 and v_completed>=v_total then coalesce(completed_at,now()) else completed_at end,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=NEW.enrollment_id;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_member_message_metadata()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  p record;
  v_sender_name text;
begin
  update public.member_conversations
  set last_message_at=NEW.created_at,updated_at=NEW.created_at
  where id=NEW.conversation_id;

  select coalesce(sa.display_name,c.first_name,'ReVitalized Member')
  into v_sender_name
  from auth.users u
  left join public.staff_access sa on sa.user_id=u.id
  left join public.profiles pr on pr.user_id=u.id
  left join public.contacts c on c.id=pr.contact_id
  where u.id=NEW.sender_user_id;

  for p in
    select *
    from public.member_conversation_participants
    where conversation_id=NEW.conversation_id
      and user_id<>NEW.sender_user_id
      and left_at is null
      and not muted
  loop
    insert into public.member_notifications(
      user_id,contact_id,notification_type,title,body,link_url,
      source_type,source_id
    )
    values(
      p.user_id,
      p.contact_id,
      'new_message',
      'New message from ' || coalesce(v_sender_name,'ReVitalized Academy'),
      left(NEW.body,240),
      case when p.participant_type='member' then '/member/' else '/portal/' end,
      'member_message',
      NEW.id
    );
  end loop;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ensure_household_conversation(p_household_id uuid, p_membership_id uuid, p_created_by uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_conversation_id uuid;
  r record;
begin
  if p_household_id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select id into v_conversation_id
  from public.member_conversations
  where household_id=p_household_id
    and conversation_type='family'
    and status='active'
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if v_conversation_id is null then
    insert into public.member_conversations(
      conversation_type,household_id,membership_id,title,status,created_by
    )
    values(
      'family',p_household_id,p_membership_id,
      'Your ReVitalized Family Conversation','active',p_created_by
    )
    returning id into v_conversation_id;
  end if;

  for r in
    select distinct ca.user_id,hm.contact_id
    from public.household_members hm
    join public.client_access ca on ca.contact_id=hm.contact_id
    where hm.household_id=p_household_id
      and hm.status='active'
      and ca.user_id is not null
      and ca.status='active'
  loop
    insert into public.member_conversation_participants(
      conversation_id,user_id,participant_type,contact_id
    )
    values(v_conversation_id,r.user_id,'member',r.contact_id)
    on conflict (conversation_id,user_id) do update
    set left_at=null,participant_type='member',contact_id=excluded.contact_id;
  end loop;

  return v_conversation_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.create_companion_review(p_request_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_request public.coach_companion_requests%rowtype;
  v_review_id uuid;
  v_coach uuid;
begin
  select * into v_request
  from public.coach_companion_requests
  where id=p_request_id;

  if v_request.id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select coach_user_id into v_coach
  from public.client_coach_assignments
  where contact_id=v_request.contact_id
    and role='primary'
    and status='active'
  limit 1;

  insert into public.coach_companion_reviews(
    request_id,contact_id,assigned_to,status,review_reason
  )
  values(
    v_request.id,v_request.contact_id,coalesce(v_request.assigned_coach_id,v_coach),'open',p_reason
  )
  on conflict (request_id) do update
  set assigned_to=coalesce(public.coach_companion_reviews.assigned_to,excluded.assigned_to),
      status=case when public.coach_companion_reviews.status='resolved' then 'resolved' else 'open' end,
      review_reason=excluded.review_reason,
      updated_at=now()
  returning id into v_review_id;

  update public.coach_companion_requests
  set status='coach_review',
      assigned_coach_id=coalesce(assigned_coach_id,v_coach),
      escalation_reason=p_reason,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_request.id;

  insert into public.follow_up_tasks(
    contact_id,assigned_to,title,due_at,status,priority,task_type,instructions
  )
  select
    v_request.contact_id,
    coalesce(v_request.assigned_coach_id,v_coach),
    'Coach Companion review needed',
    now()+interval '1 day',
    'open',
    case
      when v_request.handling_mode='block_and_escalate' then 'high'
      else 'normal'
    end,
    'review',
    'Review the member’s Coach Companion question and provide or approve an appropriate response. The AI layer did not send an autonomous answer.'
  where not exists (
    select 1 from public.follow_up_tasks t
    where t.contact_id=v_request.contact_id
      and t.title='Coach Companion review needed'
      and t.status='open'
  );

  return v_review_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.staff_has_permission(p_user_id uuid, p_permission_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
  select case
    when exists(
      select 1
      from public.staff_access sa
      where sa.user_id=p_user_id
        and sa.status='active'
        and sa.role='coach'
        and sa.onboarding_status='pending'
    ) then false
    else coalesce(
      (
        select spo.allowed
        from public.staff_permission_overrides spo
        where spo.user_id=p_user_id
          and spo.permission_key=p_permission_key
      ),
      (
        select srpd.allowed
        from public.staff_access sa
        join public.staff_role_permission_defaults srpd
          on srpd.role=sa.role
         and srpd.permission_key=p_permission_key
        where sa.user_id=p_user_id
          and sa.status='active'
      ),
      false
    )
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_referral_status_from_contact()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  r record;
  p public.referral_programs%rowtype;
begin
  if TG_OP='UPDATE' and OLD.lifecycle_stage is not distinct from NEW.lifecycle_stage then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  if NEW.lifecycle_stage='applicant' then
    update public.referrals
    set status='applicant',updated_at=now()
    where referred_contact_id=NEW.id
      and status in ('referred','engaged');
  elsif NEW.lifecycle_stage='client' then
    update public.referrals
    set status='converted',
        converted_at=coalesce(converted_at,now()),
        updated_at=now()
    where referred_contact_id=NEW.id
      and status not in ('converted','cancelled','ineligible');

    for r in
      select *
      from public.referrals
      where referred_contact_id=NEW.id
        and status='converted'
        and referrer_contact_id is not null
    loop
      if r.referral_program_id is not null then
        select * into p
        from public.referral_programs
        where id=r.referral_program_id
          and status='published';

        if p.id is not null and coalesce(p.reward_type,'none')<>'none' then
          insert into public.referral_rewards(
            referral_id,referrer_contact_id,reward_type,reward_value,currency,status
          )
          select
            r.id,r.referrer_contact_id,p.reward_type,p.reward_value,p.currency,'pending'
          where not exists(
            select 1 from public.referral_rewards rr where rr.referral_id=r.id
          );
        end if;
      end if;
    end loop;
  elsif NEW.lifecycle_stage in ('assessment_lead','webinar_lead') then
    update public.referrals
    set status='engaged',updated_at=now()
    where referred_contact_id=NEW.id
      and status='referred';
  end if;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$
