CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.queue_upcoming_appointment_reminders()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  r record;
  v_count integer:=0;
  v_title text;
  v_body text;
  v_source_type text;
begin
  -- Journey appointments: 24-hour reminders.
  for r in
    select
      ja.id as source_id,
      ja.contact_id,
      ca.user_id,
      ja.appointment_type,
      ja.scheduled_start,
      ja.format
    from public.journey_appointments ja
    join public.client_access ca on ca.contact_id=ja.contact_id
    where ca.status='active'
      and ca.user_id is not null
      and ja.status='scheduled'
      and ja.scheduled_start between now()+interval '23 hours 45 minutes'
                                 and now()+interval '24 hours 15 minutes'
  loop
    v_title:='ReVitalized appointment reminder';
    v_body:='Your '||initcap(replace(r.appointment_type,'_',' '))||
      ' is scheduled for '||to_char(r.scheduled_start at time zone 'UTC','Mon DD at HH12:MI AM')||
      ' UTC'||
      case when r.format is not null then ' · '||initcap(r.format) else '' end||'.';
    v_source_type:='journey_appointment_24h';

    insert into public.member_notifications(
      user_id,contact_id,notification_type,title,body,link_url,source_type,source_id
    )
    values(
      r.user_id,r.contact_id,'appointment_reminder',v_title,v_body,
      '/member/',v_source_type,r.source_id
    )
    on conflict (user_id,notification_type,source_type,source_id)
      where source_id is not null
    do nothing;

    if found then v_count:=v_count+1; end if;
  end loop;

  -- Journey appointments: 2-hour reminders.
  for r in
    select
      ja.id as source_id,
      ja.contact_id,
      ca.user_id,
      ja.appointment_type,
      ja.scheduled_start,
      ja.format
    from public.journey_appointments ja
    join public.client_access ca on ca.contact_id=ja.contact_id
    where ca.status='active'
      and ca.user_id is not null
      and ja.status='scheduled'
      and ja.scheduled_start between now()+interval '1 hour 45 minutes'
                                 and now()+interval '2 hours 15 minutes'
  loop
    v_title:='Your ReVitalized appointment is coming up';
    v_body:='Your '||initcap(replace(r.appointment_type,'_',' '))||
      ' starts in about 2 hours.';
    v_source_type:='journey_appointment_2h';

    insert into public.member_notifications(
      user_id,contact_id,notification_type,title,body,link_url,source_type,source_id
    )
    values(
      r.user_id,r.contact_id,'appointment_reminder',v_title,v_body,
      '/member/',v_source_type,r.source_id
    )
    on conflict (user_id,notification_type,source_type,source_id)
      where source_id is not null
    do nothing;

    if found then v_count:=v_count+1; end if;
  end loop;

  -- Coaching sessions: 24-hour and 2-hour reminders.
  for r in
    select
      cs.id as source_id,
      cs.contact_id,
      ca.user_id,
      cs.scheduled_start,
      cs.format,
      '24h'::text as reminder_window
    from public.coaching_sessions cs
    join public.client_access ca on ca.contact_id=cs.contact_id
    where ca.status='active'
      and ca.user_id is not null
      and cs.status='scheduled'
      and cs.scheduled_start between now()+interval '23 hours 45 minutes'
                                 and now()+interval '24 hours 15 minutes'
    union all
    select
      cs.id,cs.contact_id,ca.user_id,cs.scheduled_start,cs.format,'2h'
    from public.coaching_sessions cs
    join public.client_access ca on ca.contact_id=cs.contact_id
    where ca.status='active'
      and ca.user_id is not null
      and cs.status='scheduled'
      and cs.scheduled_start between now()+interval '1 hour 45 minutes'
                                 and now()+interval '2 hours 15 minutes'
  loop
    if r.reminder_window='24h' then
      v_title:='ReVitalized coaching reminder';
      v_body:='Your coaching session is scheduled for '||
        to_char(r.scheduled_start at time zone 'UTC','Mon DD at HH12:MI AM')||
        ' UTC'||
        case when r.format is not null then ' · '||initcap(r.format) else '' end||'.';
      v_source_type:='coaching_session_24h';
    else
      v_title:='Your ReVitalized coaching session is coming up';
      v_body:='Your coaching session starts in about 2 hours.';
      v_source_type:='coaching_session_2h';
    end if;

    insert into public.member_notifications(
      user_id,contact_id,notification_type,title,body,link_url,source_type,source_id
    )
    values(
      r.user_id,r.contact_id,'coaching_reminder',v_title,v_body,
      '/member/',v_source_type,r.source_id
    )
    on conflict (user_id,notification_type,source_type,source_id)
      where source_id is not null
    do nothing;

    if found then v_count:=v_count+1; end if;
  end loop;

  return v_count;
end;
$function$

functions.name: apply_billing_event_to_subscription
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.apply_billing_event_to_subscription()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  s public.membership_subscriptions%rowtype;
  p public.billing_plans%rowtype;
begin
  select * into s from public.membership_subscriptions where id=NEW.subscription_id;
  if s.id is null then return NEW; end if;

  select * into p from public.billing_plans where id=s.billing_plan_id;

  if NEW.event_type='payment_succeeded' then
    update public.membership_subscriptions
    set status='active',
        failed_payment_count=0,
        grace_period_ends_at=null,
        last_payment_at=NEW.occurred_at,
        last_payment_amount_cents=NEW.amount_cents,
        next_charge_at=case
          when p.billing_interval='weekly' then NEW.occurred_at + (p.interval_count||' week')::interval
          when p.billing_interval='monthly' then NEW.occurred_at + (p.interval_count||' month')::interval
          else next_charge_at
        end,
        updated_at=now()
    where id=s.id;

  elsif NEW.event_type='payment_failed' then
    update public.membership_subscriptions
    set status='past_due',
        failed_payment_count=failed_payment_count+1,
        last_failure_at=NEW.occurred_at,
        grace_period_ends_at=coalesce(grace_period_ends_at,NEW.occurred_at + coalesce(p.grace_days,3)*interval '1 day'),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=s.id;

  elsif NEW.event_type='subscription_cancelled' then
    update public.membership_subscriptions
    set status='cancelled',
        cancelled_at=coalesce(cancelled_at,NEW.occurred_at),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=s.id;

  elsif NEW.event_type='subscription_completed' then
    update public.membership_subscriptions
    set status='completed',
        ended_at=coalesce(ended_at,NEW.occurred_at),
        next_charge_at=null,
        updated_at=now()
    where id=s.id;

  elsif NEW.event_type='subscription_paused' then
    update public.membership_subscriptions
    set status='paused',updated_at=now()
    where id=s.id;

  elsif NEW.event_type='subscription_resumed' then
    update public.membership_subscriptions
    set status='active',updated_at=now()
    where id=s.id;
  end if;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS trigger

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
begin
  if OLD.status='published'
     and (
       OLD.content_text is distinct from NEW.content_text
       or OLD.version is distinct from NEW.version
       or OLD.agreement_key is distinct from NEW.agreement_key
     ) then
    raise exception 'Published agreement content/version is immutable. Create a new version instead.';
  end if;
  return NEW;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.issue_required_agreements_for_membership()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  r record;
begin
  if NEW.status not in ('pending','active') then return NEW; end if;

  for r in
    select at.id,at.agreement_key,at.version,at.content_hash
    from public.program_agreement_requirements par
    join public.agreement_templates at on at.id=par.agreement_template_id
    where par.program_code=NEW.program_code
      and par.active
      and par.required
      and at.status='published'
    order by par.sort_order
  loop
    insert into public.client_agreements(
      contact_id,membership_id,activation_id,agreement_template_id,
      agreement_key,template_version,content_hash,status,created_by
    )
    values(
      NEW.primary_contact_id,NEW.id,NEW.activation_id,r.id,
      r.agreement_key,r.version,r.content_hash,'not_sent',NEW.created_by
    )
    on conflict (contact_id,agreement_template_id) do update
    set membership_id=excluded.membership_id,
        activation_id=coalesce(excluded.activation_id,public.client_agreements.activation_id),
        updated_at=now();
  end loop;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_client_agreement_to_activation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_pending integer;
  v_declined integer;
begin
  if NEW.activation_id is null then return NEW; end if;

  select
    count(*) filter (where ca.status not in ('signed','waived')),
    count(*) filter (where ca.status='declined')
  into v_pending,v_declined
  from public.client_agreements ca
  where ca.activation_id=NEW.activation_id;

  if v_declined>0 then
    update public.journey_enrollment_activations
    set agreement_status='declined',updated_at=now()
    where id=NEW.activation_id;
  elsif v_pending=0 then
    update public.journey_enrollment_activations
    set agreement_status='signed',
        agreement_signed_at=coalesce(agreement_signed_at,now()),
        agreement_completion_method=coalesce(agreement_completion_method,'revitalized_esign'),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=NEW.activation_id;
  else
    update public.journey_enrollment_activations
    set agreement_status=case
      when exists(select 1 from public.client_agreements x where x.activation_id=NEW.activation_id and x.status in ('sent','viewed')) then 'sent'
      else 'not_sent'
    end,
    updated_at=now()
    where id=NEW.activation_id;
  end if;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.backfill_program_agreement_requirement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  m record;
  t public.agreement_templates%rowtype;
begin
  if not NEW.active or not NEW.required then return NEW; end if;

  select * into t
  from public.agreement_templates
  where id=NEW.agreement_template_id
    and status='published';

  if t.id is null then return NEW; end if;

  for m in
    select cm.*
    from public.client_memberships cm
    where cm.program_code=NEW.program_code
      and cm.status in ('pending','active')
  loop
    insert into public.client_agreements(
      contact_id,membership_id,activation_id,agreement_template_id,
      agreement_key,template_version,content_hash,status,created_by
    )
    values(
      m.primary_contact_id,m.id,m.activation_id,t.id,
      t.agreement_key,t.version,t.content_hash,'not_sent',m.created_by
    )
    on conflict (contact_id,agreement_template_id) do update
    set membership_id=excluded.membership_id,
        activation_id=coalesce(excluded.activation_id,public.client_agreements.activation_id),
        updated_at=now();
  end loop;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_my_notification_preferences(p_preferences jsonb)
 RETURNS notification_preferences
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_tz text;
  v_result public.notification_preferences%rowtype;
begin
  if p_preferences is null or jsonb_typeof(p_preferences) <> 'object' then
    raise exception 'Preferences must be a JSON object';
  end if;

  v_tz := nullif(trim(p_preferences->>'time_zone'),'');
  if v_tz is not null
     and not exists(select 1 from pg_timezone_names where name=v_tz) then
    raise exception 'Invalid time zone';
  end if;

  insert into public.notification_preferences(user_id)
  values((select auth.uid()))
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  update public.notification_preferences np
  set
    in_app_messages = coalesce((p_preferences->>'in_app_messages')::boolean,np.in_app_messages),
    email_messages = coalesce((p_preferences->>'email_messages')::boolean,np.email_messages),
    sms_messages = coalesce((p_preferences->>'sms_messages')::boolean,np.sms_messages),
    email_coaching_reminders = coalesce((p_preferences->>'email_coaching_reminders')::boolean,np.email_coaching_reminders),
    sms_coaching_reminders = coalesce((p_preferences->>'sms_coaching_reminders')::boolean,np.sms_coaching_reminders),
    email_program_updates = coalesce((p_preferences->>'email_program_updates')::boolean,np.email_program_updates),
    sms_program_updates = coalesce((p_preferences->>'sms_program_updates')::boolean,np.sms_program_updates),
    email_billing_alerts = coalesce((p_preferences->>'email_billing_alerts')::boolean,np.email_billing_alerts),
    sms_billing_alerts = coalesce((p_preferences->>'sms_billing_alerts')::boolean,np.sms_billing_alerts),
    quiet_hours_enabled = coalesce((p_preferences->>'quiet_hours_enabled')::boolean,np.quiet_hours_enabled),
    quiet_hours_start = case
      when p_preferences ? 'quiet_hours_start'
      then nullif(p_preferences->>'quiet_hours_start','')::time
      else np.quiet_hours_start
    end,
    quiet_hours_end = case
      when p_preferences ? 'quiet_hours_end'
      then nullif(p_preferences->>'quiet_hours_end','')::time
      else np.quiet_hours_end
    end,
    time_zone = case
      when p_preferences ? 'time_zone' then v_tz
      else np.time_zone
    end,
    updated_at = now()
  where np.user_id=(select auth.uid())
  returning * into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_my_meal_item(p_item_id uuid, p_status text, p_adherence_percent numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_status not in ('planned','completed','skipped','substituted') then
    raise exception 'Unsupported meal status';
  end if;

  if p_adherence_percent is not null
     and (p_adherence_percent<0 or p_adherence_percent>100) then
    raise exception 'Adherence must be between 0 and 100';
  end if;

  update public.client_meal_plan_items mi
  set status=p_status,
      adherence_percent=p_adherence_percent,
      completed_at=case
        when p_status='completed' then coalesce(mi.completed_at,now())
        when p_status in ('planned','skipped','substituted') then null
        else mi.completed_at
      end
  where mi.id=p_item_id
    and mi.contact_id in (
      select ca.contact_id
      from public.client_access ca
      where ca.user_id=(select auth.uid())
    );

  return found;
end;

AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid;
begin
  if NEW.status<>'assigned' then return NEW; end if;

  if TG_OP='UPDATE'
     and OLD.status='assigned'
     and OLD.title=NEW.title
     and OLD.due_at is not distinct from NEW.due_at then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  select ca.user_id
  into v_user_id
  from public.client_access ca
  where ca.contact_id=NEW.contact_id
    and ca.user_id is not null
  limit 1;

  if v_user_id is null then return NEW; end if;

  insert into public.member_notifications(
    user_id,contact_id,notification_type,title,body,status,source_type,source_id
  )

    v_user_id,
    NEW.contact_id,
    'assignment_available',
    'New coaching assignment',
    NEW.title,
    'unread',
    'assignment',
    NEW.id
  )
  on conflict (user_id,notification_type,source_type,source_id)
    where source_id is not null
  do update set
    title=excluded.title,
    body=excluded.body,
    status='unread',
    read_at=null,
    created_at=now();

  return NEW;
end;

  select exists(

    where sa.user_id=p_user_id

      and private.staff_has_permission(p_user_id,'crm.view')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reconcile_membership_entitlements(p_membership_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_program_code text;
  v_status text;
begin
  select cm.program_code, cm.status
  into v_program_code, v_status
  from public.client_memberships cm
  where cm.id = p_membership_id;

  if v_program_code is null then
    return;
  end if;

  update public.membership_entitlements me
  set status = 'inactive',
      updated_at = now()
  where me.membership_id = p_membership_id
    and (
      v_status not in ('active','pending')
      or not exists (
        select 1
        from public.program_entitlement_templates pet
        where pet.program_code = v_program_code
          and pet.entitlement_key = me.entitlement_key
          and pet.active
      )
    );

  if v_status in ('active','pending') then
    insert into public.membership_entitlements(
      membership_id, entitlement_key, label, status, limit_value,
      reset_cadence, metadata, updated_at
    )
    select
      p_membership_id,
      pet.entitlement_key,
      pet.label,
      'active',
      pet.limit_value,
      pet.reset_cadence,
      pet.metadata,
      now()
    from public.program_entitlement_templates pet
    where pet.program_code = v_program_code
      and pet.active
    on conflict (membership_id, entitlement_key) do update
    set label = excluded.label,
        status = 'active',
        limit_value = excluded.limit_value,
        reset_cadence = excluded.reset_cadence,
        metadata = excluded.metadata,
        updated_at = now();
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reconcile_membership_course_access(p_membership_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_contact_id uuid;
  v_program_code text;
  v_membership_status text;
  v_created_by uuid;
begin
  select cm.primary_contact_id, cm.program_code, cm.status, cm.created_by
  into v_contact_id, v_program_code, v_membership_status, v_created_by
  from public.client_memberships cm
  where cm.id = p_membership_id;

  if v_contact_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  update public.client_course_enrollments cce
  set status = 'cancelled',
      updated_at = now()
  where cce.membership_id = p_membership_id
    and cce.source = 'program'
    and cce.status in ('active','paused')
    and (
      v_membership_status <> 'active'
      or not exists (
        select 1
        from public.program_course_access pca
        join public.learning_courses lc
          on lc.id = pca.course_id
         and lc.status = 'published'
        where pca.program_code = v_program_code
          and pca.course_id = cce.course_id
          and pca.active
      )
    );

  if v_membership_status = 'active' then
    insert into public.client_course_enrollments(
      contact_id,membership_id,course_id,source,status,assigned_by,updated_at
    )
    select
      v_contact_id,
      p_membership_id,
      pca.course_id,
      'program',
      'active',
      v_created_by,
      now()
    from public.program_course_access pca
    join public.learning_courses lc
      on lc.id = pca.course_id
     and lc.status = 'published'
    where pca.program_code = v_program_code
      and pca.active
    on conflict (contact_id,course_id) do update
    set membership_id = excluded.membership_id,
        status = case
          when public.client_course_enrollments.status='completed' then 'completed'
          else 'active'
        end,
        source = case
          when public.client_course_enrollments.source in ('coach','manual') then public.client_course_enrollments.source
          else 'program'
        end,
        updated_at = now();
  end if;
end;
$function$

declare
  v_user_id uuid;
  v_title text;
  v_body text;
begin
  if NEW.status <> 'scheduled' or NEW.scheduled_start is null then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  select ca.user_id
  into v_user_id
  from public.client_access ca
  where ca.contact_id=NEW.contact_id
    and ca.user_id is not null
  limit 1;

  if v_user_id is null then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  v_title := case NEW.appointment_type
    when 'coaching_session' then 'Coaching session scheduled'
    when 'consultation' then 'Consultation scheduled'
    when 'application_interview' then 'Interview scheduled'
    else 'Appointment scheduled'
  end;

  v_body := 'Your appointment is scheduled for ' ||
            to_char(NEW.scheduled_start at time zone coalesce(NEW.time_zone,'UTC'),
                    'Mon FMDD, YYYY at FMHH12:MI AM');

  insert into public.member_notifications(
    user_id,contact_id,notification_type,title,body,link_url,status,source_type,source_id
  )
  values(
    v_user_id,
    NEW.contact_id,
    'appointment_scheduled',
    v_title,
    v_body,
    NEW.location_url,
    'unread',
    'appointment',
    NEW.id
  )
  on conflict (user_id,notification_type,source_type,source_id)
    where source_id is not null
  do update set
    title=excluded.title,
    body=excluded.body,
    link_url=excluded.link_url,
    status='unread',
    read_at=null,
    created_at=now();

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

  where pra.resource_id=p_resource_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reconcile_membership_challenge_access(p_membership_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_contact_id uuid;
  v_household_id uuid;
  v_program_code text;
  v_status text;
  v_created_by uuid;
begin
  select cm.primary_contact_id,cm.household_id,cm.program_code,cm.status,cm.created_by
  into v_contact_id,v_household_id,v_program_code,v_status,v_created_by
  from public.client_memberships cm
  where cm.id=p_membership_id;

  if v_contact_id is null then return; end if;

  update public.challenge_enrollments ce
  set status='withdrawn',
      updated_at=now()
  where ce.membership_id=p_membership_id
    and ce.status in ('active','paused')
    and not exists(
      select 1
      from public.program_challenge_access pca
      join public.wellness_challenges wc
        on wc.id=pca.challenge_id
       and wc.status='published'
      where pca.program_code=v_program_code
        and pca.challenge_id=ce.challenge_id
        and pca.active
    );

  if v_status='active' then
    insert into public.challenge_enrollments(
      challenge_id,contact_id,household_id,membership_id,scope,status,enrolled_by
    )
    select
      pca.challenge_id,
      v_contact_id,
      null,
      p_membership_id,
      'individual',
      'active',
      v_created_by
    from public.program_challenge_access pca
    join public.wellness_challenges wc
      on wc.id=pca.challenge_id
     and wc.status='published'
    where pca.program_code=v_program_code
      and pca.active
    on conflict (challenge_id,contact_id)
      where scope='individual' and contact_id is not null
    do update set
      membership_id=excluded.membership_id,
      status=case
        when public.challenge_enrollments.status='completed' then 'completed'
        else 'active'
      end,
      updated_at=now();
  end if;
end;
$function$

  insert into public.member_notifications(
    user_id,contact_id,notification_type,title,body,status,source_type,source_id
  )
  values(
    NEW.user_id,
    NEW.contact_id,

    'family_request',

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.refresh_household_type(p_household_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
  v_has_spouse boolean;
  v_type text;
begin
  select
    count(*),
    bool_or(hm.relationship_type in ('husband','wife'))
  into v_count,v_has_spouse
  from public.household_members hm
  where hm.household_id=p_household_id
    and hm.status='active';

  v_type:=case
    when coalesce(v_count,0)<=1 then 'individual'
    when v_count=2 and coalesce(v_has_spouse,false) then 'couple'
    else 'family'
  end;

  update public.households
  set household_type=v_type,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=p_household_id;
end;
$function$

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.build_companion_context_snapshot(p_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_request public.coach_companion_requests%rowtype;
  v_type_allows_personal boolean := false;
  v_pref public.ai_advisor_personalization_preferences%rowtype;
  v_personal_enabled boolean := false;
  v_payload jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_request
  from public.coach_companion_requests
  where id=p_request_id;

  if v_request.id is null then
    raise exception 'Companion request not found';
  end if;

  select coalesce(qt.allow_personal_context,false)
    into v_type_allows_personal
  from public.coach_companion_question_types qt
  where qt.question_type=v_request.question_type;

  select * into v_pref
  from public.ai_advisor_personalization_preferences p
  where p.user_id=v_request.requested_by_user_id;

  v_personal_enabled :=
    v_type_allows_personal
    and coalesce(v_pref.personalization_enabled,false);

  v_payload := jsonb_build_object(
    'request_id',v_request.id,
    'question_type',v_request.question_type,
    'captured_at',now(),
    'question_type_allows_personal_context',v_type_allows_personal,
    'member_personalization_enabled',coalesce(v_pref.personalization_enabled,false),
    'personal_context_used',v_personal_enabled
  );

  if v_personal_enabled then
    if coalesce(v_pref.allow_program_context,true) then
      v_payload := v_payload || jsonb_build_object(
        'member',
        coalesce((
          select jsonb_build_object(
            'contact_id',c.id,
            'first_name',c.first_name,
            'program_code',cm.program_code,
            'program_name',pc.name,
            'membership_status',cm.status,
            'assigned_coach_name',sd.display_name
          )
          from public.contacts c
          left join public.client_memberships cm on cm.id=v_request.membership_id
          left join public.program_catalog pc on pc.program_code=cm.program_code
          left join public.staff_directory sd on sd.user_id=cm.assigned_coach_id
          where c.id=v_request.contact_id
          limit 1
        ),'{}'::jsonb)
      );
    end if;

    if coalesce(v_pref.allow_daily_plan,true) then
      v_payload := v_payload || jsonb_build_object(
        'daily_plan',
        coalesce((
          select jsonb_build_object(
            'action_date',dac.action_date,
            'habits',dac.habits,
            'meals',dac.meals,
            'workouts',dac.workouts,
            'challenges',dac.challenges,
            'continue_course',dac.continue_course,
            'habit_count',dac.habit_count,
            'habits_completed_today',dac.habits_completed_today,
            'meal_count',dac.meal_count,
            'workout_count',dac.workout_count
          )
          from public.my_daily_action_center dac
          where dac.contact_id=v_request.contact_id
          limit 1
        ),'{}'::jsonb),
        'consistency',
        coalesce((
          select to_jsonb(cs.*)
          from public.my_consistency_summary cs
          limit 1
        ),'{}'::jsonb)
      );
    end if;

    if coalesce(v_pref.allow_goals,true) then
      v_payload := v_payload || jsonb_build_object(
        'goals',
        coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'goal_id',gp.goal_id,
              'goal_key',gp.goal_key,
              'title',gp.title,
              'target_value',gp.target_value,
              'target_unit',gp.target_unit,
              'target_date',gp.target_date,
              'current_value',gp.current_value,
              'completion_percent',gp.completion_percent,
              'progress_state',gp.progress_state
            )
            order by gp.priority,gp.title
          )
          from public.my_goal_progress gp
          where gp.contact_id=v_request.contact_id
            and gp.status in ('active','paused')
        ),'[]'::jsonb)
      );
    end if;

    if coalesce(v_pref.allow_course_progress,true) then
      v_payload := v_payload || jsonb_build_object(
        'courses',
        coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'course_id',mc.course_id,
              'title',mc.title,
              'status',mc.status,
              'progress_percent',mc.progress_percent,
              'last_activity_at',mc.last_activity_at
            )
            order by mc.last_activity_at desc nulls last
          )
          from public.my_courses mc
          where mc.status in ('active','completed')
        ),'[]'::jsonb)
      );
    end if;

    if coalesce(v_pref.allow_coaching_momentum,true) then
      v_payload := v_payload || jsonb_build_object(
        'coaching_momentum',
        coalesce((
          select to_jsonb(cm.*)
          from public.my_coaching_momentum cm
          where cm.contact_id=v_request.contact_id
          limit 1
        ),'{}'::jsonb)
      );
    end if;

    if coalesce(v_pref.allow_health_summary,false) then
      v_payload := v_payload || jsonb_build_object(
        'health_summary',
        coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'metric_key',hd.metric_key,
              'metric_label',hd.metric_label,
              'unit',hd.unit,
              'current_value',hd.current_value,
              'percent_change_30d',hd.percent_change_30d,
              'current_recorded_at',hd.current_recorded_at
            )
            order by hd.category,hd.metric_key
          )
          from public.my_health_dashboard_cards_30d hd
          where hd.contact_id=v_request.contact_id
        ),'[]'::jsonb)
      );
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.coach_companion_context_snapshots(
    request_id,contact_id,membership_id,question_type,
    personal_context_allowed,context_version,context_payload
  )
  values(
    v_request.id,v_request.contact_id,v_request.membership_id,v_request.question_type,
    v_personal_enabled,'v2',v_payload
  )
  on conflict(request_id) do update
  set personal_context_allowed=excluded.personal_context_allowed,
      context_version=excluded.context_version,
      context_payload=excluded.context_payload,
      generated_at=now();

  return v_payload;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reset_entitlement_period_if_needed(p_entitlement_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_row public.membership_entitlements%rowtype;
  v_reset boolean := false;
begin
  select * into v_row
  from public.membership_entitlements
  where id=p_entitlement_id
  for update;

  if v_row.id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  if v_row.period_started_at is null then
    update public.membership_entitlements
    set period_started_at=now(),
        used_value=coalesce(used_value,0),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_row.id;
    return;
  end if;

  v_reset := case lower(coalesce(v_row.reset_cadence,''))
    when 'daily' then v_row.period_started_at < date_trunc('day',now())
    when 'weekly' then v_row.period_started_at < date_trunc('week',now())
    when 'monthly' then v_row.period_started_at < date_trunc('month',now())
    when 'yearly' then v_row.period_started_at < date_trunc('year',now())
    else false
  end;

  if v_reset then
    update public.membership_entitlements
    set used_value=0,
        period_started_at=now(),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_row.id;
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.consume_ai_advisor_entitlement(p_membership_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ent public.membership_entitlements%rowtype;
begin
  select *
    into v_ent
  from public.membership_entitlements
  where membership_id=p_membership_id
    and entitlement_key='ai_advisor'
    and status='active'
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1
  for update;

  if v_ent.id is null then
    raise exception 'Ask ReVitalized is not included with this membership';
  end if;

  perform private.reset_entitlement_period_if_needed(v_ent.id);

  select *
    into v_ent
  from public.membership_entitlements
  where id=v_ent.id
  for update;

  if v_ent.limit_value is not null
     and coalesce(v_ent.used_value,0)>=v_ent.limit_value then
    raise exception 'Ask ReVitalized usage allowance has been reached for the current period';
  end if;

  update public.membership_entitlements
  set used_value=coalesce(used_value,0)+1,
      period_started_at=coalesce(period_started_at,now()),
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_ent.id
  returning * into v_ent;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'entitlement_id',v_ent.id,
    'used_value',v_ent.used_value,
    'limit_value',v_ent.limit_value,
    'reset_cadence',v_ent.reset_cadence,
    'period_started_at',v_ent.period_started_at
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_my_ai_advisor_personalization(p_personalization_enabled boolean, p_allow_program_context boolean DEFAULT true, p_allow_daily_plan boolean DEFAULT true, p_allow_goals boolean DEFAULT true, p_allow_course_progress boolean DEFAULT true, p_allow_coaching_momentum boolean DEFAULT true, p_allow_health_summary boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_contact_id uuid;
begin
  select ca.contact_id into v_contact_id
  from public.client_access ca
  where ca.user_id=(select auth.uid())
    and ca.status='active'
  order by ca.updated_at desc
  limit 1;

  if v_contact_id is null then
    raise exception 'Active member access is required';
  end if;

  insert into public.ai_advisor_personalization_preferences(
    user_id,contact_id,personalization_enabled,
    allow_program_context,allow_daily_plan,allow_goals,
    allow_course_progress,allow_coaching_momentum,allow_health_summary,
    consented_at,revoked_at,updated_at
  )
  values(
    (select auth.uid()),v_contact_id,p_personalization_enabled,
    p_allow_program_context,p_allow_daily_plan,p_allow_goals,
    p_allow_course_progress,p_allow_coaching_momentum,p_allow_health_summary,
    case when p_personalization_enabled then now() else null end,
    case when not p_personalization_enabled then now() else null end,
    now()
  )
  on conflict(user_id) do update
  set contact_id=excluded.contact_id,
      personalization_enabled=excluded.personalization_enabled,
      allow_program_context=excluded.allow_program_context,
      allow_daily_plan=excluded.allow_daily_plan,
      allow_goals=excluded.allow_goals,
      allow_course_progress=excluded.allow_course_progress,
      allow_coaching_momentum=excluded.allow_coaching_momentum,
      allow_health_summary=excluded.allow_health_summary,
      consented_at=case
        when excluded.personalization_enabled
          and not ai_advisor_personalization_preferences.personalization_enabled
        then now()
        else ai_advisor_personalization_preferences.consented_at
      end,
      revoked_at=case
        when not excluded.personalization_enabled then now()
        else null
      end,
      updated_at=now();

  return true;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_my_device(p_device_key text, p_platform text, p_push_provider text DEFAULT 'native'::text, p_push_token text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_push_enabled boolean DEFAULT true, p_app_version text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_os_version text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_device_model text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_locale text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_time_zone text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_contact_id uuid;
  v_device_id uuid;
begin
  if coalesce(length(trim(p_device_key)),0)<3 or length(trim(p_device_key))>255 then
    raise exception 'A valid device key is required';
  end if;

  if p_platform not in ('ios','android','web') then
    raise exception 'Invalid device platform';
  end if;

  if p_push_provider not in ('native','firebase','apns','goodbarber','webpush','other') then
    raise exception 'Invalid push provider';
  end if;

  select ca.contact_id into v_contact_id
  from public.client_access ca
  where ca.user_id=(select auth.uid())
    and ca.status='active'
  order by ca.updated_at desc
  limit 1;

  insert into public.member_devices(
    user_id,contact_id,device_key,platform,push_provider,push_token,push_enabled,
    app_version,os_version,device_model,locale,time_zone,last_seen_at,
    push_token_updated_at,revoked_at,metadata
  )
  values(
    (select auth.uid()),v_contact_id,trim(p_device_key),p_platform,p_push_provider,
    nullif(trim(p_push_token),''),p_push_enabled,
    nullif(trim(p_app_version),''),nullif(trim(p_os_version),''),
    nullif(trim(p_device_model),''),nullif(trim(p_locale),''),
    nullif(trim(p_time_zone),''),now(),
    case when nullif(trim(p_push_token),'') is not null then now() else null end,
    null,coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb)
  )
  on conflict(user_id,device_key) do update
  set contact_id=excluded.contact_id,
      platform=excluded.platform,
      push_provider=excluded.push_provider,
      push_token=excluded.push_token,
      push_enabled=excluded.push_enabled,
      app_version=excluded.app_version,
      os_version=excluded.os_version,
      device_model=excluded.device_model,
      locale=excluded.locale,
      time_zone=excluded.time_zone,
      last_seen_at=now(),
      push_token_updated_at=case
        when public.member_devices.push_token is distinct from excluded.push_token then now()
        else public.member_devices.push_token_updated_at
      end,
      revoked_at=null,
      metadata=excluded.metadata
  returning id into v_device_id;

  return v_device_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.queue_push_delivery()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_prefs public.notification_preferences%rowtype;
  v_wants_push boolean := true;
  v_scheduled_for timestamptz;
begin
  select * into v_prefs
  from public.notification_preferences
  where user_id=new.user_id;

  if v_prefs.user_id is null then
    insert into public.notification_preferences(user_id)
    values(new.user_id)
    on conflict(user_id) do nothing;

    select * into v_prefs
    from public.notification_preferences
    where user_id=new.user_id;
  end if;

  if new.notification_type='new_message' then
    v_wants_push:=coalesce(v_prefs.push_messages,true);
  elsif new.notification_type in (
    'appointment_reminder','appointment_scheduled','coaching_reminder',
    'coaching_session','assignment_available','assignment_completed',
    'companion_answer_ready'
  ) then
    v_wants_push:=coalesce(v_prefs.push_coaching_reminders,true);
  elsif new.notification_type in (
    'program_update','account_active','course_assigned','course_available',
    'course_completed','resource_assigned','resource_available',
    'challenge_available','challenge_completed','goal_completed',
    'achievement_unlocked','agreement_sent','agreement_viewed',
    'agreement_signed','agreement_declined','referral_engaged',
    'referral_applicant','referral_converted','referral_reward_approved',
    'referral_reward_issued','family_request_in_review',
    'family_request_approved','family_request_completed',
    'family_request_declined'
  ) then
    v_wants_push:=coalesce(v_prefs.push_program_updates,true);
  elsif new.notification_type='billing_alert'
     or new.notification_type like 'billing_%' then
    v_wants_push:=coalesce(v_prefs.push_billing_alerts,true);
  else
    v_wants_push:=true;
  end if;

  if not v_wants_push then
    return new;
  end if;

  v_scheduled_for:=private.notification_scheduled_for(new.user_id);

  insert into public.push_delivery_jobs(
    notification_id,device_id,user_id,contact_id,provider,push_token,
    title,body,link_url,status,block_reason,scheduled_for
  )
  select
    new.id,
    d.id,
    new.user_id,
    new.contact_id,
    d.push_provider,
    d.push_token,
    new.title,
    new.body,
    new.link_url,
    case
      when d.push_enabled=false then 'blocked'
      when d.revoked_at is not null then 'blocked'
      when d.push_token is null then 'blocked'
      else 'queued'
    end,
    case
      when d.push_enabled=false then 'device_push_disabled'
      when d.revoked_at is not null then 'device_revoked'
      when d.push_token is null then 'missing_push_token'
      else null
    end,
    v_scheduled_for
  from public.member_devices d
  where d.user_id=new.user_id
    and d.revoked_at is null
  on conflict(notification_id,device_id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_my_app_session(p_session_key text, p_device_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_platform text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_app_version text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_contact_id uuid;
  v_session_id uuid;
begin
  if coalesce(length(trim(p_session_key)),0)<8 then
    raise exception 'A valid session key is required';
  end if;

  select ca.contact_id into v_contact_id
  from public.client_access ca
  where ca.user_id=(select auth.uid())
    and ca.status='active'
  order by ca.updated_at desc
  limit 1;

  if p_device_id is not null
     and not exists (
       select 1 from public.member_devices d
       where d.id=p_device_id
         and d.user_id=(select auth.uid())
         and d.revoked_at is null
     ) then
    raise exception 'Device is not available to the current member';
  end if;

  insert into public.member_app_sessions(
    user_id,contact_id,device_id,session_key,platform,app_version,
    started_at,last_seen_at,ended_at
  )
  values(
    (select auth.uid()),v_contact_id,p_device_id,trim(p_session_key),
    nullif(trim(p_platform),''),nullif(trim(p_app_version),''),
    now(),now(),null
  )
  on conflict(user_id,session_key) do update
  set contact_id=excluded.contact_id,
      device_id=coalesce(excluded.device_id,public.member_app_sessions.device_id),
      platform=coalesce(excluded.platform,public.member_app_sessions.platform),
      app_version=coalesce(excluded.app_version,public.member_app_sessions.app_version),
      last_seen_at=now(),
      ended_at=null
  returning id into v_session_id;

  perform private.touch_member_device(p_device_id);
  return v_session_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.disconnect_my_health_provider(p_provider_key text, p_revoke_all_metric_consents boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_contact_id uuid;
begin
  select ca.contact_id into v_contact_id
  from public.client_access ca
  where ca.user_id=(select auth.uid())
    and ca.status='active'
  order by ca.updated_at desc
  limit 1;

  if v_contact_id is null then
    raise exception 'Active member access is required';
  end if;

  update public.health_integration_connections
  set status='disconnected',
      last_error=null,
      credential_reference=null,
      granted_scopes='{}'::jsonb,
      updated_at=now()
  where contact_id=v_contact_id
    and user_id=(select auth.uid())
    and provider_key=p_provider_key;

  if p_revoke_all_metric_consents then
    update public.health_metric_consents
    set allowed=false,
        revoked_at=now(),
        updated_at=now()
    where user_id=(select auth.uid())
      and contact_id=v_contact_id
      and provider_key=p_provider_key
      and allowed=true;
  end if;

  return true;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sign_my_client_agreement(p_client_agreement_id uuid, p_signer_name text, p_signature_type text DEFAULT 'typed'::text, p_user_agent text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_expected_content_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_agreement public.client_agreements%rowtype;
  v_contact public.contacts%rowtype;
  v_acceptance_id uuid;
  v_signature_count integer;
  v_effective_hash text;
begin
  if p_signature_type<>'typed' then
    raise exception 'Self-service agreement signing supports typed signatures only';
  end if;

  if coalesce(length(trim(p_signer_name)),0)<2 then
    raise exception 'Signer name is required';
  end if;

  select ca.* into v_agreement
  from public.client_agreements ca
  where ca.id=p_client_agreement_id
    and ca.contact_id in (
      select access.contact_id
      from public.client_access access
      where access.user_id=(select auth.uid())
        and access.status='active'
    )
  for update;

  if v_agreement.id is null then
    raise exception 'Client agreement not found';
  end if;

  if v_agreement.status in ('waived','declined') then
    raise exception 'This agreement cannot be signed in its current status';
  end if;

  if v_agreement.status='signed' then
    select aa.id into v_acceptance_id
    from public.agreement_acceptances aa
    where aa.client_agreement_id=v_agreement.id
      and aa.signer_role='primary_client'
    limit 1;

    if v_acceptance_id is not null then
      return v_acceptance_id;
    end if;
  end if;

  v_effective_hash:=coalesce(v_agreement.rendered_content_hash,v_agreement.content_hash);

  if p_expected_content_hash is not null
     and p_expected_content_hash is distinct from v_effective_hash then
    raise exception 'Agreement content changed. Reload the agreement before signing';
  end if;

  select c.* into v_contact
  from public.contacts c
  where c.id=v_agreement.contact_id;

  insert into public.agreement_acceptances(
    client_agreement_id,
    contact_id,
    signed_by_user_id,
    signer_name,
    signer_email,
    signature_type,
    accepted_terms,
    content_hash,
    signed_at,
    user_agent,
    metadata,
    signer_role
  )
  values(
    v_agreement.id,
    v_agreement.contact_id,
    (select auth.uid()),
    trim(p_signer_name),
    v_contact.email,
    'typed',
    true,
    v_effective_hash,
    now(),
    nullif(trim(p_user_agent),''),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source','member_app',
      'agreement_key',v_agreement.agreement_key,
      'template_version',v_agreement.template_version
    ),
    'primary_client'
  )
  on conflict(client_agreement_id,signer_role) do update
  set signer_name=excluded.signer_name,
      signer_email=excluded.signer_email,
      signed_by_user_id=excluded.signed_by_user_id,
      signature_type=excluded.signature_type,
      accepted_terms=true,
      content_hash=excluded.content_hash,
      signed_at=now(),
      user_agent=excluded.user_agent,
      metadata=excluded.metadata
  returning id into v_acceptance_id;

  select count(*)::integer into v_signature_count
  from public.agreement_acceptances aa
  where aa.client_agreement_id=v_agreement.id
    and aa.signer_role in ('primary_client','secondary_client');

  update public.client_agreements
  set status=case
        when v_signature_count>=greatest(coalesce(required_client_signatures,1),1)
          then 'signed'
        else 'viewed'
      end,
      viewed_at=coalesce(viewed_at,now()),
      signed_at=case
        when v_signature_count>=greatest(coalesce(required_client_signatures,1),1)
          then coalesce(signed_at,now())
        else signed_at
      end,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_agreement.id;

  return v_acceptance_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sign_my_staff_agreement(p_staff_agreement_id uuid, p_signer_name text, p_signature_type text DEFAULT 'typed'::text, p_user_agent text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_expected_content_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare
  v_agreement public.staff_agreements%rowtype;
  v_email text;
  v_acceptance_id uuid;
  v_effective_hash text;
begin
  if p_signature_type<>'typed' then
    raise exception 'Self-service staff agreement signing supports typed signatures only';
  end if;

  if coalesce(length(trim(p_signer_name)),0)<2 then
    raise exception 'Signer name is required';
  end if;

  select sa.* into v_agreement
  from public.staff_agreements sa
  where sa.id=p_staff_agreement_id
    and sa.staff_user_id=(select auth.uid())
  for update;

  if v_agreement.id is null then
    raise exception 'Staff agreement not found';
  end if;

  if v_agreement.status in ('waived','declined') then
    raise exception 'This agreement cannot be signed in its current status';
  end if;

  v_effective_hash:=coalesce(v_agreement.rendered_content_hash,v_agreement.content_hash);

  if p_expected_content_hash is not null
     and p_expected_content_hash is distinct from v_effective_hash then
    raise exception 'Agreement content changed. Reload the agreement before signing';
  end if;

  select u.email into v_email
  from auth.users u
  where u.id=(select auth.uid());

  insert into public.staff_agreement_acceptances(
    staff_agreement_id,
    staff_user_id,
    signer_name,
    signer_email,
    signature_type,
    accepted_terms,
    content_hash,
    signed_at,
    user_agent,
    metadata
  )
  values(
    v_agreement.id,
    (select auth.uid()),
    trim(p_signer_name),
    v_email,
    'typed',
    true,
    v_effective_hash,
    now(),
    nullif(trim(p_user_agent),''),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source','staff_portal',
      'agreement_key',v_agreement.agreement_key,
      'template_version',v_agreement.template_version
    )
  )
  on conflict(staff_agreement_id) do update
  set signer_name=excluded.signer_name,
      signer_email=excluded.signer_email,
      signature_type='typed',
      accepted_terms=true,
      content_hash=excluded.content_hash,
      signed_at=now(),
      user_agent=excluded.user_agent,
      metadata=excluded.metadata
  returning id into v_acceptance_id;

  update public.staff_agreements
  set status='signed',
      viewed_at=coalesce(viewed_at,now()),
      signed_at=coalesce(signed_at,now()),
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_agreement.id;

  return v_acceptance_id;
end;
$function$
